theorem det_arrowMatrix_inverse (d : ℝ) (B : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ)
    (r : ∀ c, V c) (a f : C → ℝ) (hB : ∀ c, (B c).det ≠ 0) :
    (arrowMatrix d B r a f).det =
      (∏ c, (B c).det) * (d - ∑ c, a c * (B c)⁻¹ (r c) (r c) * f c) := by
  have hd : (Matrix.blockDiagonal' B).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [det_dependent_blocks]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun c _ => hB c)

    Matrix.invertibleOfIsUnitDet _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd)
  rw [arrowMatrix, Matrix.det_fromBlocks₂₂, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv,
    inverse_dependent_blocks B hB, det_dependent_blocks, Matrix.det_unique, Matrix.sub_apply,
    Matrix.of_apply, arrow_sandwich]

/-- Denominator-free edge/cofactor formula. Nonzero determinants are needed only

theorem det_arrowMatrix_cofactors (d : ℝ) (B : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ)
    (r : ∀ c, V c) (a f : C → ℝ) (hB : ∀ c, (B c).det ≠ 0) :
    (arrowMatrix d B r a f).det = d * (∏ c, (B c).det) -

  rw [det_arrowMatrix_inverse d B r a f hB, mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  · ring
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro c _
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j => (B j).det) (Finset.mem_univ c),
      Matrix.inv_def]
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    field_simp [hB c]
    <;> ring

noncomputable section

variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] [LinearOrder C] {V : C → Type*}
  [∀ c, Fintype (V c)] [∀ c, DecidableEq (V c)]

lemma scalar_sub_arrow (d s : ℝ) (B : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ)
    (r : ∀ c, V c) (a f : C → ℝ) :

      arrowMatrix (s-d) (fun c => Matrix.scalar (V c) s - B c) r (-a) (-f) := by
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | ⟨c,i⟩ <;> rcases j with j | ⟨e,j⟩
  · cases i; cases j; simp [arrowMatrix, Matrix.scalar_apply]
  · cases i; simp [arrowMatrix, arrowRow, Matrix.scalar_apply, neg_ite]
  · cases j; simp [arrowMatrix, arrowColumn, Matrix.scalar_apply, neg_ite]
  · have h := congrArg (fun M => M ⟨c,i⟩ ⟨e,j⟩) (scalar_sub_dependent_blocks B s)
    simpa only [arrowMatrix, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂, Matrix.sub_apply,
      Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Sum.inr.injEq] using h

nonzero-rate, simple-spectrum, or coprimality assumptions. -/
theorem charpoly_arrowMatrix (d : ℝ) (B : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ)
    (r : ∀ c, V c) (a f : C → ℝ) :
    (arrowMatrix d B r a f).charpoly = (X - Polynomial.C d) * (∏ c, (B c).charpoly) -
      ∑ c, Polynomial.C (a c * f c) * diagonalCofactor (B c) (r c) *
        ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, (B j).charpoly := by
  have hp : (∏ c, (B c).charpoly).Monic :=
    Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun c _ => Matrix.charpoly_monic _)
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (infinite_nonroots _ hp.ne_zero).mono
  intro s hs
  have hB : ∀ c, (Matrix.scalar (V c) s - B c).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro c
    have hn : (∏ c, ((B c).charpoly).eval s) ≠ 0 := by simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Polynomial.eval_prod] using hs
    rw [← Matrix.eval_charpoly]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mp hn c (Finset.mem_univ c)
  have h := det_arrowMatrix_cofactors (s-d)
    (fun c => Matrix.scalar (V c) s - B c) r (-a) (-f) hB
  simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Matrix.eval_charpoly, scalar_sub_arrow,
    Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_prod,
    Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C,
    eval_diagonalCofactor, Pi.neg_apply, neg_mul_neg] using h

    (A : Matrix Unit Unit K) (B : Matrix Unit W K) (C : Matrix W Unit K) (D : Matrix W W K) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D).adjugate (.inl ()) (.inl ()) = D.det := by
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
  have hm : (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D).updateRow (.inl ()) (Pi.single (.inl ()) 1) =
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 C D := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [Pi.single_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [hm, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, Matrix.det_one, one_mul]

/-- The actual root cofactor is the product of the actual child characteristic polynomials. -/
theorem cofactor_arrowMatrix (d : ℝ) (B : ∀ c, Matrix (V c) (V c) ℝ)
    (r : ∀ c, V c) (a f : C → ℝ) :
    diagonalCofactor (arrowMatrix d B r a f) (.inl ()) = ∏ c, (B c).charpoly := by
  rw [diagonalCofactor, arrowMatrix, Matrix.charmatrix_fromBlocks, adjugate_root_block]
  exact charpoly_dependent_blocks B

end HydrologyTree

lemma root_outward_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t) (x : TreeRates n) :
    compartmentMatrix t x c.val 0 = outwardByVertex x.2 c.val := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula t x c.val 0 c.property.1]
  simp only [ite_eq_right c.property.1, c.property.2, ite_true, zero_add]

      (physicalBranchMatrix t x) (branchRootVertex t) (fun c => x.1 c.val)
      (fun c => outwardByVertex x.2 c.val) := by
  unfold physicalRootBlockMatrix arrowMatrix
  congr 1
  · ext u ⟨c,v⟩
    cases u
    simp [rootInwardRow, arrowRow, root_inward_child, branchRootVertex, Subtype.ext_iff]
  · ext ⟨c,v⟩ u
    cases u
    simp [rootOutwardColumn, arrowColumn, root_outward_child, branchRootVertex, Subtype.ext_iff]

lemma diagonalCofactor_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (e : κ ≃ ι) (i : κ) :
    diagonalCofactor (A.submatrix e e) i = diagonalCofactor A (e i) := by
  change diagonalCofactor (A.reindex e.symm e.symm) i = _
  rw [diagonalCofactor, Matrix.charmatrix_reindex, Matrix.adjugate_reindex]

    diagonalCofactor A 0 = (A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).charpoly := by
  unfold diagonalCofactor
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, add_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Fin.succAbove_zero]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j; simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq]
  · simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_ne, h]

def childCharacteristic {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) : ℝ[X] :=
  physicalCharacteristic (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)

def childCofactor {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) : ℝ[X] :=
  physicalRootCofactor (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)

/-- Root cofactor of the original matrix equals the product of all actual child denominators. -/
theorem physicalRootCofactor_child_product {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    physicalRootCofactor t x = ∏ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c := by
  have h := congrArg (fun M => diagonalCofactor M (.inl ())) (physical_root_block_decomposition t x)
  rw [diagonalCofactor_reindex, rootPartitionEquiv_root, diagonalCofactor_zero,
    physicalRootBlock_eq_arrow] at h

  apply (cofactor_arrowMatrix (-(rateChart t x).1 0) (physicalBranchMatrix t x)
    (branchRootVertex t) (fun c => x.1 c.val) (fun c => outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)).trans

  intro c _
  exact physicalBranch_charpoly_eq t c x

  simp only [map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, physicalBranch_charpoly_eq,
    physicalBranch_cofactor_eq, childCharacteristic, childCofactor, physicalCharacteristic] at hh ⊢

  congr 3

all positivity and extraction properties are derived here. -/

namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Strict positivity of all physical rates, including the root leak. -/
def PositiveRateVector {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  (∀ v, 0 < x.1 v) ∧ ∀ e, 0 < x.2 e

def assemblePositiveRates {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (l : ℝ)
    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) : TreeRates n :=
  (ratePartitionEquiv t).symm (l,fun c => (f c,y c))

lemma assembledRates_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (l : ℝ)
    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) :
    (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).1 0 = l := by
  have h := congrArg Prod.fst ((ratePartitionEquiv t).apply_symm_apply (l,fun c => (f c,y c)))
  exact h

lemma assembledRates_extract {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (l : ℝ)
    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) (c : RootChild t) :
    outwardByVertex (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).2 c.val = f c ∧
      childRates t c (assemblePositiveRates t l f y) = y c := by
  have h := congrArg (fun z : PartitionedRates t => z.2 c)
    ((ratePartitionEquiv t).apply_symm_apply (l,fun c => (f c,y c)))
  change (ratePartitionEquiv t (assemblePositiveRates t l f y)).2 c = (f c,y c) at h
  rw [ratePartition_child] at h
  exact Prod.mk.inj h

    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) (c : RootChild t) :
    childRates t c (assemblePositiveRates t l f y) = y c := (assembledRates_extract t l f y c).2

lemma assembledRates_connector {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (l : ℝ)
    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) (c : RootChild t) :
    outwardByVertex (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).2 c.val = f c :=
  (assembledRates_extract t l f y c).1

lemma assembledRates_child_leak {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (l : ℝ)
    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) (c : RootChild t) :
    (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).1 c.val = (y c).1 0 := by
  rw [← childRates_leak t c (assemblePositiveRates t l f y),assembledRates_child]

    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) :
    (rateChart t (assemblePositiveRates t l f y)).1 0 = l+∑ c, f c := by
  change (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).1 0 + parentCLM t (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).2 0 = _
  rw [assembledRates_root,rootConnectors_sum]
  simp only [assembledRates_connector]

    (f : RootChild t → ℝ) (y : ChildStates t) (hl : 0 < l)
    (hf : ∀ c, 0 < f c) (hy : ∀ c, PositiveRateVector (y c)) :
    PositiveRateVector (assemblePositiveRates t l f y) := by
  constructor
  · intro v
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun e => ?_) v
    · rwa [assembledRates_root]
    · obtain ⟨⟨c,i⟩,he⟩ := (numberedEdgeEquiv t).surjective e
      rw [← he]
      change 0 < (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).1 (numberedEdgeIndex t ⟨c,i⟩).succ

      change 0 < (childRates t c (assemblePositiveRates t l f y)).1 i

    obtain ⟨⟨c,i⟩,he⟩ := (numberedEdgeEquiv t).surjective e
    rw [← he,outward_at_numbered_child t (assemblePositiveRates t l f y).2 c i]
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · rw [childEnumeration_zero]
      exact (assembledRates_connector t l f y c).symm ▸ hf c
    · change 0 < (childRates t c (assemblePositiveRates t l f y)).2 j
      rw [assembledRates_child]
      exact (hy c).2 j

edge. No sign or nonzero-rate hypothesis restricts this transport. -/

namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev GraphRates {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) := ℝ × (G.Dart → ℝ)

variable {V : Type*} {n : ℕ} {G : SimpleGraph V} {o : V}

def treeDartOfPresentation (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o) : Fin n ⊕ Fin n → G.Dart
  | .inl i => ⟨(p.vertices i.succ,p.vertices (p.tree.parent i)),
      (p.adj_iff _ _).mp ⟨i,Or.inr ⟨rfl,rfl⟩⟩⟩
  | .inr i => ⟨(p.vertices (p.tree.parent i),p.vertices i.succ),
      (p.adj_iff _ _).mp ⟨i,Or.inl ⟨rfl,rfl⟩⟩⟩

lemma treeDartOfPresentation_injective (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o) :
    Function.Injective (treeDartOfPresentation p) := by
  intro a b h
  have hf := congrArg (fun d : G.Dart => d.fst) h
  have hs := congrArg (fun d : G.Dart => d.snd) h
  cases a with
  | inl i =>
    cases b with
    | inl j =>
      dsimp only [treeDartOfPresentation] at hf hs
      exact congrArg Sum.inl (Fin.succ_injective _ (p.vertices.injective hf))
    | inr j =>
      dsimp only [treeDartOfPresentation] at hf hs
      exact False.elim (no_reversed_tree_edges p.tree i j
        ⟨(p.vertices.injective hs).symm,(p.vertices.injective hf).symm⟩)
  | inr i =>
    cases b with
    | inl j =>
      dsimp only [treeDartOfPresentation] at hf hs
      exact False.elim (no_reversed_tree_edges p.tree i j
        ⟨(p.vertices.injective hf).symm,(p.vertices.injective hs).symm⟩)
    | inr j =>
      dsimp only [treeDartOfPresentation] at hf hs
      exact congrArg Sum.inr (Fin.succ_injective _ (p.vertices.injective hs))

lemma treeDartOfPresentation_surjective (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o) :
    Function.Surjective (treeDartOfPresentation p) := by
  intro d
  have ha : (orderedTreeGraph p.tree).Adj (p.vertices.symm d.fst) (p.vertices.symm d.snd) :=
    (p.adj_iff _ _).mpr (by simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using d.adj)
  obtain ⟨i,⟨h1,h2⟩ | ⟨h1,h2⟩⟩ := ha
  · refine ⟨.inr i,?_⟩
    apply SimpleGraph.Dart.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · simpa only [treeDartOfPresentation,Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using (congrArg p.vertices h1).symm
    · simpa only [treeDartOfPresentation,Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using (congrArg p.vertices h2).symm
  · refine ⟨.inl i,?_⟩
    apply SimpleGraph.Dart.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · simpa only [treeDartOfPresentation,Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using (congrArg p.vertices h2).symm
    · simpa only [treeDartOfPresentation,Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using (congrArg p.vertices h1).symm

def treeDartEquiv (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o) : (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) ≃ G.Dart :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (treeDartOfPresentation p)
    ⟨treeDartOfPresentation_injective p,treeDartOfPresentation_surjective p⟩

def graphRateEquiv (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o) : TreeRates n ≃ₗ[ℝ] GraphRates G where
  toFun x := (x.1 0,fun d => Sum.elim (fun i => x.1 i.succ) x.2 ((treeDartEquiv p).symm d))
  invFun y := (Fin.cons y.1 (fun i => y.2 (treeDartEquiv p (.inl i))),
    fun i => y.2 (treeDartEquiv p (.inr i)))
  left_inv x := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext v

@[simp] lemma graphRateEquiv_leak (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o) (x : TreeRates n) :

@[simp] lemma graphRateEquiv_outward (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o) (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :

  · rintro ⟨h0,hd⟩

    · intro v

      simpa only [graphRateEquiv_inward] using hd (treeDartEquiv p (.inl i))
    · intro i
      simpa only [graphRateEquiv_outward] using hd (treeDartEquiv p (.inr i))
  · rintro ⟨ha,hf⟩
    refine ⟨ha 0,?_⟩
    intro d
    obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := (treeDartEquiv p).surjective d
    cases i with
    | inl i => simpa only [graphRateEquiv_inward] using ha i.succ
    | inr i => simpa only [graphRateEquiv_outward] using hf i

import HydrologyTree.Resolvent

/-! The actual graph-conservative matrix is defined independently of any
presentation. Equality after the rate and vertex transports is proved. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]

def graphTransfer (y : GraphRates G) (d : G.Dart) : Matrix V V ℝ :=
  y.2 d • (Matrix.single d.snd d.fst (1 : ℝ)-Matrix.single d.fst d.fst (1 : ℝ))

def graphCompartmentMatrix (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (o : V) (y : GraphRates G) :
    Matrix V V ℝ := (∑ d : G.Dart, graphTransfer y d)-y.1 • Matrix.single o o (1 : ℝ)

lemma graph_single_transport {n : ℕ} (e : Fin (n+1) ≃ V) (u v : Fin (n+1)) (c : ℝ) :
    (Matrix.single (e u) (e v) c).submatrix e e=Matrix.single u v c := by
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.single_apply,Matrix.submatrix_apply]

lemma graphTransfer_inward_transport {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    (graphTransfer (graphRateEquiv p x) (treeDartEquiv p (.inl i))).submatrix p.vertices p.vertices =
      x.1 i.succ • (Matrix.single (p.tree.parent i) i.succ (1 : ℝ)-Matrix.single i.succ i.succ (1 : ℝ)) := by
  have hrate := graphRateEquiv_inward p x i
  ext u v
  simp only [graphTransfer,Matrix.submatrix_apply,Matrix.smul_apply,Matrix.sub_apply,hrate]
  change x.1 i.succ • ((Matrix.single (p.vertices (p.tree.parent i)) (p.vertices i.succ) (1 : ℝ))
      (p.vertices u) (p.vertices v) - (Matrix.single (p.vertices i.succ) (p.vertices i.succ) (1 : ℝ))
      (p.vertices u) (p.vertices v)) = _
  simp [Matrix.single_apply]

lemma graphTransfer_outward_transport {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    (graphTransfer (graphRateEquiv p x) (treeDartEquiv p (.inr i))).submatrix p.vertices p.vertices =
      x.2 i • (Matrix.single i.succ (p.tree.parent i) (1 : ℝ)-
        Matrix.single (p.tree.parent i) (p.tree.parent i) (1 : ℝ)) := by
  have hrate := graphRateEquiv_outward p x i
  ext u v
  simp only [graphTransfer,Matrix.submatrix_apply,Matrix.smul_apply,Matrix.sub_apply,hrate]
  change x.2 i • ((Matrix.single (p.vertices i.succ) (p.vertices (p.tree.parent i)) (1 : ℝ))
      (p.vertices u) (p.vertices v) -
      (Matrix.single (p.vertices (p.tree.parent i)) (p.vertices (p.tree.parent i)) (1 : ℝ))
      (p.vertices u) (p.vertices v)) = _
  simp [Matrix.single_apply]

theorem graphCompartmentMatrix_transport {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (x : TreeRates n) :
    (graphCompartmentMatrix G o (graphRateEquiv p x)).submatrix p.vertices p.vertices =
      compartmentMatrix p.tree x := by
  have hsum : (∑ d : G.Dart, (graphTransfer (graphRateEquiv p x) d).submatrix p.vertices p.vertices) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, edgeMatrix p.tree x i := by
    rw [← (treeDartEquiv p).sum_comp (fun d => (graphTransfer (graphRateEquiv p x) d).submatrix p.vertices p.vertices),
      Fintype.sum_sum_type]
    simp only [graphTransfer_inward_transport,graphTransfer_outward_transport]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl
  ext u v
  have hs := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ => M u v) hsum
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply,Matrix.submatrix_apply] at hs
  simp only [graphCompartmentMatrix,Matrix.submatrix_apply,Matrix.sub_apply,Matrix.sum_apply,
    Matrix.smul_apply,graphRateEquiv_leak,compartmentMatrix]
  rw [hs]
  simp [← p.root_eq,Matrix.single_apply]

def graphCharacteristic (o : V) (y : GraphRates G) : ℝ[X] :=
  (graphCompartmentMatrix G o y).charpoly

def graphRootCofactor (o : V) (y : GraphRates G) : ℝ[X] :=
  diagonalCofactor (graphCompartmentMatrix G o y) o

def graphRootResponse (o : V) (y : GraphRates G) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Matrix.scalar V s-graphCompartmentMatrix G o y)⁻¹ o o

lemma graphCharacteristic_transport {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (x : TreeRates n) : graphCharacteristic o (graphRateEquiv p x)=physicalCharacteristic p.tree x := by
  rw [graphCharacteristic,← charpoly_submatrix_equiv _ p.vertices,graphCompartmentMatrix_transport]
  rfl

lemma diagonalCofactor_submatrix_equiv {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (e : Fin (n+1) ≃ V) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    diagonalCofactor (A.submatrix e e) i=diagonalCofactor A (e i) := by
  have h : Matrix.charmatrix (A.submatrix e e)=(Matrix.charmatrix A).submatrix e e :=
    Matrix.charmatrix_reindex A e.symm
  rw [diagonalCofactor,h,Matrix.adjugate_submatrix_equiv_self]
  rfl

lemma diagonalCofactor_physical_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    diagonalCofactor (compartmentMatrix t x) 0=physicalRootCofactor t x := by
  have hroot : (Matrix.charmatrix (compartmentMatrix t x)).adjugate 0 0 =
      ((Matrix.charmatrix (compartmentMatrix t x)).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).det := by
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix]
    simp
  rw [diagonalCofactor,hroot]
  change ((Matrix.charmatrix (compartmentMatrix t x)).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).det =
    (Matrix.charmatrix ((compartmentMatrix t x).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ)).det
  congr 1
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i=j
  · subst j
    simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq]
  · simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_ne,h]

lemma graphRootCofactor_transport {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (x : TreeRates n) : graphRootCofactor o (graphRateEquiv p x)=physicalRootCofactor p.tree x := by
  have h := diagonalCofactor_submatrix_equiv (graphCompartmentMatrix G o (graphRateEquiv p x)) p.vertices 0
  simpa only [graphCompartmentMatrix_transport,p.root_eq,diagonalCofactor_physical_root,
    graphRootCofactor] using h.symm

lemma scalar_sub_equiv_transport {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix V V ℝ) (e : Fin (n+1) ≃ V) (s : ℝ) :
    (Matrix.scalar V s-A).submatrix e e=Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s-A.submatrix e e := by
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.submatrix_apply,Matrix.scalar_apply,Matrix.diagonal_apply]

/-- Exact root inverse entry transport; its physical interpretation is made
only off characteristic roots, without using totalized values at poles. -/
theorem graphRootResponse_transport {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (x : TreeRates n) (s : ℝ) :
    graphRootResponse o (graphRateEquiv p x) s=physicalRootResponse p.tree x s := by
  have h := Matrix.inv_submatrix_equiv (Matrix.scalar V s-graphCompartmentMatrix G o (graphRateEquiv p x))
    p.vertices p.vertices
  rw [scalar_sub_equiv_transport,graphCompartmentMatrix_transport] at h
  have he := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ => M 0 0) h
  simpa only [Matrix.submatrix_apply,p.root_eq,graphRootResponse,physicalRootResponse] using he.symm

end HydrologyTree

import Mathlib.Analysis.ODE.ExistUnique
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLin

/-! Actual finite-dimensional linear forced ODEs and global uniqueness.
No transfer-function or solution-existence hypothesis is used in the uniqueness proof. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

def matrixOperator (A : Matrix I I ℝ) : (I → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (I → ℝ) :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap A.mulVecLin

@[simp] lemma matrixOperator_apply (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (z : I → ℝ) :
    matrixOperator A z = A *ᵥ z := rfl

/-- The actual classical state equation, at every real time. -/
def IsForcedMatrixSolution (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (b : I → ℝ)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ → I → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt z (A *ᵥ z s + u s • b) s

/-- Global uniqueness for the actual forced matrix ODE with any common forcing.
No sign, stability or diagonalizability restriction is imposed on A. -/
theorem forcedMatrixSolution_unique (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (b : I → ℝ)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (z y : ℝ → I → ℝ) (a : ℝ)
    (hz : IsForcedMatrixSolution A b u z) (hy : IsForcedMatrixSolution A b u y)
    (ha : z a = y a) : z=y := by
  apply ODE_solution_unique_univ (s := fun _ => Set.univ)
    (K := ‖matrixOperator A‖₊) (t₀ := a)
    (v := fun s v => matrixOperator A v + u s • b)
  · intro s p hp q hq
    simpa only [edist_add_right] using (matrixOperator A).lipschitzWith p q
  · intro s
    exact ⟨hz s,Set.mem_univ _⟩
  · intro s
    exact ⟨hy s,Set.mem_univ _⟩
  · exact ha

end HydrologyTree

/-! A finite modal coordinate witness for an actual root-driven matrix system.
Its existence for the physical tree is separately proved, not assumed globally. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

structure RootModalData {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ) where
  rates : Fin (n+1) → ℝ
  amplitudes : Fin (n+1) → ℝ
  synthesis : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ
  analysis : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ
  synth_analysis : synthesis*analysis=1
  analysis_synth : analysis*synthesis=1
  intertwine : A*synthesis=synthesis*Matrix.diagonal (fun i => -rates i)
  input_analysis : analysis *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1=amplitudes
  root_output : ∀ y : Fin (n+1) → ℝ,
    (synthesis*ᵥy) 0 = ∑ i, amplitudes i*y i


variable {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ} (M : RootModalData A)

lemma rootModal_synthesis_input : M.synthesis *ᵥ M.amplitudes=Pi.single 0 1 := by
  rw [← M.input_analysis,Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,M.synth_analysis,Matrix.one_mulVec]

lemma rootModal_synthesis_rhs (y : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (u : ℝ) :
    M.synthesis *ᵥ (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => -M.rates i)*ᵥ y + u • M.amplitudes) =
      A *ᵥ (M.synthesis*ᵥy)+u • Pi.single 0 1 := by
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_add,Matrix.mulVec_smul,Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    ← M.intertwine,rootModal_synthesis_input M,Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Constructed detailed-balance weights of the actual finite physical tree.
These weights are not added as an existence hypothesis. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def balanceWeight {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (v : Fin (n+1)) : ℝ :=
  if hv : v = 0 then 1 else
    balanceWeight t x (parentVertex t v) * outwardByVertex x.2 v / x.1 v
termination_by v.val
decreasing_by exact parentVertex_lt t v hv

@[simp] theorem balanceWeight_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    balanceWeight t x 0 = 1 := by
  rw [balanceWeight]
  simp

lemma balanceWeight_succ {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (e : Fin n) :
    balanceWeight t x e.succ = balanceWeight t x (t.parent e) * x.2 e / x.1 e.succ := by
  rw [balanceWeight]
  simp only [Fin.succ_ne_zero, dite_false]
  rfl

/-- Every constructed weight is strictly positive for positive internal rates;
the root leak need not be positive or nonzero. -/
theorem balanceWeight_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) : 0 < balanceWeight t x v := by
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hv : v = 0
    · subst v
      rw [balanceWeight_zero]
      norm_num
    · let e : Fin n := v.pred hv
      have he : e.succ = v := Fin.succ_pred v hv
      have hlt : (t.parent e).val < v.val := by
        rw [← he]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (t.parent_le e)
      rw [← he, balanceWeight_succ]
      exact div_pos (mul_pos (ih (t.parent e) hlt) (hf e)) (ha e)

/-- Exact opposed-edge detailed balance, supplied by the construction. -/
theorem balanceWeight_edge {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) (e : Fin n) :
    x.1 e.succ * balanceWeight t x e.succ = x.2 e * balanceWeight t x (t.parent e) := by
  rw [balanceWeight_succ]
  field_simp [ha e]
  <;> ring

end HydrologyTree

import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef

/-! The actual weighted compartment matrix is a grounded tree Dirichlet form.
All matrix equalities and the quadratic identity are proved edge by edge. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

lemma single_mul_weight_diagonal (i j : I) (r : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ) :
    Matrix.single i j r * Matrix.diagonal w = Matrix.single i j (r*w j) := by
  ext u v
  rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  by_cases hi : i = u <;> by_cases hj : j = v <;>
    simp [Matrix.single_apply,hi,hj]

/-- The rank-one Laplacian form (e_i-e_j)(e_i-e_j)^T. -/
def edgeGram (i j : I) : Matrix I I ℝ :=
  Matrix.single i i 1 + Matrix.single j j 1 - Matrix.single i j 1 - Matrix.single j i 1

lemma edgeGram_transpose (i j : I) : (edgeGram i j).transpose = edgeGram i j := by
  ext u v
  simp only [edgeGram, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.sub_apply,
    Matrix.single_apply]
  simp [and_comm]
  <;> ring

lemma edgeGram_energy (i j : I) (z : I → ℝ) :
    z ⬝ᵥ (edgeGram i j *ᵥ z) = (z i-z j)^2 := by
  simp only [edgeGram, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_sub, dotProduct_add,
    Matrix.single_mulVec_eq, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_single_one, one_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

/-- Actual weighted negative generator, not an assumed symmetric proxy. -/
def weightedNegativeGenerator {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  -(compartmentMatrix t x * Matrix.diagonal (balanceWeight t x))

lemma edge_weighted_matrix {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) (e : Fin n) :
    edgeMatrix t x e * Matrix.diagonal (balanceWeight t x) =
      -(x.2 e * balanceWeight t x (t.parent e)) • edgeGram (t.parent e) e.succ := by
  rw [edgeMatrix, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.sub_mul]
  simp only [single_mul_weight_diagonal, one_mul, smul_sub, Matrix.smul_single,
    smul_eq_mul, balanceWeight_edge t x ha e]
  simp only [edgeGram, smul_sub, smul_add, Matrix.smul_single, smul_eq_mul,
    mul_one]
  simp only [← Matrix.single_neg]
  abel

/-- Edgewise exact decomposition. All positive rates will be supplied only when
needed for positivity; here inward rates merely need to be nonzero. -/
theorem weightedNegativeGenerator_decomposition {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) :
    weightedNegativeGenerator t x = x.1 0 • Matrix.single 0 0 1 +
      ∑ e : Fin n, (x.2 e * balanceWeight t x (t.parent e)) • edgeGram (t.parent e) e.succ := by
  rw [weightedNegativeGenerator, compartmentMatrix, Matrix.sub_mul,
    Finset.sum_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, single_mul_weight_diagonal, balanceWeight_zero]
  simp only [one_mul]
  simp_rw [edge_weighted_matrix t x ha, neg_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  abel

/-- Exact energy identity for the constructed physical matrix. -/
theorem weightedNegativeGenerator_energy {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) (z : VertexValues n) :
    z ⬝ᵥ (weightedNegativeGenerator t x *ᵥ z) = x.1 0 * (z 0)^2 +
      ∑ e : Fin n, (x.2 e * balanceWeight t x (t.parent e)) * (z (t.parent e)-z e.succ)^2 := by
  rw [weightedNegativeGenerator_decomposition t x ha, Matrix.add_mulVec, dotProduct_add]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.single_mulVec_eq, dotProduct_smul,
    dotProduct_single_one, one_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  · ring
  · rw [Matrix.sum_mulVec, dotProduct_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro e _
    rw [Matrix.smul_mulVec, dotProduct_smul, edgeGram_energy]
    rfl

/-- Symmetry is derived from the actual generator and the proved weights. -/
theorem weightedNegativeGenerator_isHermitian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) : (weightedNegativeGenerator t x).IsHermitian := by
  rw [Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm]
  change (weightedNegativeGenerator t x).transpose = weightedNegativeGenerator t x
  rw [weightedNegativeGenerator_decomposition t x ha]
  simp [Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_sum, Matrix.transpose_smul,
    edgeGram_transpose]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Strict positivity of the constructed physical tree energy.
Connectedness is proved from the actual parent inequalities, not assumed. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- A value constant across every edge and zero at the root vanishes everywhere. -/
theorem zero_of_tree_edge_equalities {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (z : VertexValues n)
    (hz0 : z 0 = 0) (hzedge : ∀ e : Fin n, z (t.parent e) = z e.succ) : z = 0 := by
  funext v
  change z v = 0
  induction v using (measure Fin.val).wf.induction with
  | h v ih =>
    by_cases hv : v = 0
    · rwa [hv]
    · let e : Fin n := v.pred hv
      have he : e.succ = v := Fin.succ_pred v hv
      have hlt : (t.parent e).val < v.val := by
        rw [← he]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (t.parent_le e)
      rw [← he, ← hzedge e]
      exact ih (t.parent e) hlt

def groundedTreeEnergy {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (g : Fin n → ℝ) (ell : ℝ)
    (z : VertexValues n) : ℝ := ell*(z 0)^2 + ∑ e : Fin n, g e*(z (t.parent e)-z e.succ)^2

/-- Exact strict positivity, also including the one-vertex tree. -/
theorem groundedTreeEnergy_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (g : Fin n → ℝ) (ell : ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ e, 0 < g e) (hell : 0 < ell) (z : VertexValues n) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    0 < groundedTreeEnergy t g ell z := by
  have hterms (e : Fin n) : 0 ≤ g e*(z (t.parent e)-z e.succ)^2 :=
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hg e)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ e : Fin n, g e*(z (t.parent e)-z e.succ)^2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun e _ => hterms e)
  have hroot : 0 ≤ ell*(z 0)^2 := mul_nonneg hell.le (sq_nonneg _)
  by_contra h
  have ht : ell*(z 0)^2 + (∑ e : Fin n, g e*(z (t.parent e)-z e.succ)^2) ≤ 0 :=
    le_of_not_gt h
  have hr0 : ell*(z 0)^2 = 0 := by linarith
  have hz0 : z 0 = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hr0).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hell))
  have hs0 : (∑ e : Fin n, g e*(z (t.parent e)-z e.succ)^2) = 0 := by linarith
  apply hz
  apply zero_of_tree_edge_equalities t z hz0
  intro e
  have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) => hterms j)
    (Finset.mem_univ e)
  rw [hs0] at hle
  have he0 := le_antisymm hle (hterms e)
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp he0).resolve_left (ne_of_gt (hg e))))

/-- A positive-leak, positive-internal-rate physical tree has a positive-definite
weighted negative generator, with the weighting constructed explicitly. -/
theorem weightedNegativeGenerator_posDef {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ)
    (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) : (weightedNegativeGenerator t x).PosDef := by
  have hane : ∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0 := fun e => ne_of_gt (ha e)
  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos (weightedNegativeGenerator_isHermitian t x hane)
  intro z hz
  simp only [star_trivial]
  rw [weightedNegativeGenerator_energy t x hane]
  exact groundedTreeEnergy_pos t (fun e => x.2 e * balanceWeight t x (t.parent e))
    (x.1 0) (fun e => mul_pos (hf e) (balanceWeight_pos t x ha hf _)) hell z hz

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.GroundedPositivity
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt

/-! Actual positive diagonal similarity to a negative definite symmetric matrix.
The change of basis and its inverse are explicitly constructed from rates. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def sqrtWeightDiagonal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal (fun v => Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v))

def invSqrtWeightDiagonal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal (fun v => (Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v))⁻¹)

lemma sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    sqrtWeightDiagonal t x * invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x = 1 := by
  rw [sqrtWeightDiagonal, invSqrtWeightDiagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  have hpos (v : Fin (n+1)) : 0 < Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (balanceWeight_pos t x ha hf v)
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, ne_of_gt (hpos i)]
  · simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, h]

lemma invSqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_sqrt {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x * sqrtWeightDiagonal t x = 1 := by
  have h := Matrix.commute_diagonal
    (fun v : Fin (n+1) => (Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v))⁻¹)
    (fun v : Fin (n+1) => Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v))
  change invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x * sqrtWeightDiagonal t x =
    sqrtWeightDiagonal t x * invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x at h
  rw [h]
  exact sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf

lemma weight_mul_invSqrt {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    Matrix.diagonal (balanceWeight t x) * invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x = sqrtWeightDiagonal t x := by
  rw [invSqrtWeightDiagonal, sqrtWeightDiagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  congr 1
  funext v
  have hs : Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (balanceWeight_pos t x ha hf v))
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (balanceWeight_pos t x ha hf v).le
  change balanceWeight t x v / Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v) = Real.sqrt (balanceWeight t x v)
  apply (div_eq_iff hs).mpr
  nlinarith [hsq]

/-- The actual congruence form whose positivity is linked to the physical generator. -/
def symmetricNegativeGenerator {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x * weightedNegativeGenerator t x * invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x

lemma invSqrtWeightDiagonal_hermitian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x)ᴴ = invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x := by
  simp [invSqrtWeightDiagonal]

/-- Positivity of the actual symmetrized negative generator. -/
theorem symmetricNegativeGenerator_posDef {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ)
    (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) : (symmetricNegativeGenerator t x).PosDef := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x).mulVec := by
    intro z w h
    have hh := congrArg (fun v => sqrtWeightDiagonal t x *ᵥ v) h
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf,
      Matrix.one_mulVec] using hh
  have h := (weightedNegativeGenerator_posDef t x hell ha hf).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hinj
  simpa only [invSqrtWeightDiagonal_hermitian, symmetricNegativeGenerator] using h

/-- Exact similarity identity, including the explicit inverse change of basis. -/
theorem physical_negative_similarity {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    symmetricNegativeGenerator t x =
      -(invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x * compartmentMatrix t x * sqrtWeightDiagonal t x) := by
  rw [symmetricNegativeGenerator, weightedNegativeGenerator, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul]
  congr 1
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, weight_mul_invSqrt t x ha hf]

/-- Actual characteristic polynomial equals that of a negative-definite symmetric
matrix. This is a proved similarity, not an assumption about real eigenvalues. -/
theorem physical_charpoly_symmetric {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    physicalCharacteristic t x = (-symmetricNegativeGenerator t x).charpoly := by
  rw [physical_negative_similarity t x ha hf, neg_neg]
  rw [Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf]
  simp [physicalCharacteristic]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.SymmetricGenerator
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.PosDef

/-! Strictly negative real characteristic roots for the actual positive physical
tree generator. Spectrum and positivity are derived from the constructed energy
form and the library spectral theorem, not assumed as a stability hypothesis. -/
open Matrix Polynomial Unitary
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma charpoly_neg_posDef {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (B : Matrix I I ℝ) (hB : B.PosDef) :
    (-B).charpoly = ∏ i : I, (X + C (hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues i)) := by
  have hn : -B = conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ hB.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
      (-Matrix.diagonal (RCLike.ofReal ∘ hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues)) := by
    rw [map_neg, ← hB.isHermitian.spectral_theorem]
  rw [hn, conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.charpoly_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  simp [Matrix.diagonal_neg, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal, Function.comp_def]

/-- Complete factorization into strictly negative real modes, with algebraic
multiplicity retained. No simplicity or absence of cancellations is claimed. -/
theorem physical_characteristic_negative_real_factorization {n : ℕ}
    (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ)
    (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    ∃ r : Fin (n+1) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < r i) ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = ∏ i : Fin (n+1), (X + C (r i)) := by
  have hB := symmetricNegativeGenerator_posDef t x hell ha hf
  refine ⟨hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues, fun i => hB.eigenvalues_pos i, ?_⟩
  rw [physical_charpoly_symmetric t x ha hf]
  exact charpoly_neg_posDef _ hB

/-- In particular the actual resolvent has no nonnegative real poles. -/
theorem physical_characteristic_pos_on_nonnegative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ)
    (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    0 < (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s := by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hP⟩ := physical_characteristic_negative_real_factorization t x hell ha hf
  rw [hP, Polynomial.eval_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro i _
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C]
  exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos hs (hr i)

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PositiveSpectrum

/-! Exact nonpole resolvent expansion of a positive definite real symmetric
matrix, with nonnegative spectral weights summing to one. -/
open Matrix Polynomial Unitary
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

lemma unitary_conjugation_scalar (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup I ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.scalar I s) = Matrix.scalar I s := by
  exact (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U).toAlgEquiv.commutes s

lemma conjugation_diagonal_entry (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup I ℝ) (d : I → ℝ) (o : I) :
    (conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal d)) o o = ∑ i : I, (U o i)^2 * d i := by
  rw [conjStarAlgAut_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.star_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial]
  ring

/-- The normalization of the observable spectral weights follows from unitarity. -/
lemma unitary_row_squares_sum (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup I ℝ) (o : I) :
    (∑ i : I, (U o i)^2) = 1 := by
  have h := conjugation_diagonal_entry U (fun _ => 1) o
  simpa using h.symm

lemma inverse_diagonal_explicit (d : I → ℝ) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.diagonal d * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (d i)⁻¹) = (1 : Matrix I I ℝ) := by
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [hd]
  · simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, h]

/-- True resolvent inverse on the exact nonpole domain. -/
theorem conjugated_diagonal_resolvent (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup I ℝ) (r : I → ℝ)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s + r i ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.scalar I s + conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal r)) *
      conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (s+r i)⁻¹)) = 1 := by
  have he : Matrix.scalar I s + conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal r) =
      conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => s+r i)) := by
    rw [← unitary_conjugation_scalar U s, ← map_add]
    congr 1
    rw [Matrix.scalar_apply, ← Matrix.diagonal_add]
  rw [he, ← map_mul, inverse_diagonal_explicit _ hs, map_one]

/-- Nonnegative unit-mass weights for the actual root inverse of any positive
definite matrix. Coincident eigenvalues and zero observation weights are retained. -/
theorem posDef_resolvent_representation (B : Matrix I I ℝ) (hB : B.PosDef) (o : I) :
    ∃ r w : I → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < r i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) ∧
      (∑ i, w i) = 1 ∧
      (-B).charpoly = ∏ i, (X+C (r i)) ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ i, s + r i ≠ 0) →
        (Matrix.scalar I s + B)⁻¹ o o = ∑ i, w i / (s+r i) := by
  let U := hB.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  let r := hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  refine ⟨r, fun i => (U o i)^2, hB.eigenvalues_pos, fun i => sq_nonneg _,
    unitary_row_squares_sum U o, charpoly_neg_posDef B hB, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  have hspec : B = conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal r) := by
    simpa only [RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, Function.id_comp] using hB.isHermitian.spectral_theorem
  have hi := conjugated_diagonal_resolvent U r s hs
  rw [← hspec] at hi
  rw [Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hi, conjugation_diagonal_entry]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.SpectralResolvent
import HydrologyTree.Resolvent

/-! The actual positive-rate physical tree has a normalized finite Stieltjes
root resolvent. Every weight and spectral mode comes from the proved diagonal
similarity. No observational/spectral representation is supplied as an axiom. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma similarity_inverse {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (D E A : Matrix I I ℝ) (hDE : D*E = 1) (hED : E*D = 1)
    (hA : IsUnit A.det) : (D*A*E)⁻¹ = D*A⁻¹*E := by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
  calc
    (D*A*E)*(D*A⁻¹*E) = D*(A*(E*D)*A⁻¹)*E := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = 1 := by rw [hED, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hA, Matrix.mul_one, hDE]

lemma scalar_matrix_eq_smul_one {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (s : ℝ) :
    Matrix.scalar I s = s • (1 : Matrix I I ℝ) := by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.scalar_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.one_apply, h]

/-- The same fixed diagonal change of variables transports the entire resolvent pencil. -/
theorem physical_scalar_similarity {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) (s : ℝ) :
    sqrtWeightDiagonal t x * (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s + symmetricNegativeGenerator t x) *
        invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x = Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s - compartmentMatrix t x := by
  rw [scalar_matrix_eq_smul_one, physical_negative_similarity t x ha hf]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul]
  have hh : sqrtWeightDiagonal t x *
      (invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x * compartmentMatrix t x * sqrtWeightDiagonal t x) *
        invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x = compartmentMatrix t x := by
    calc
      _ = (sqrtWeightDiagonal t x * invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x) * compartmentMatrix t x *
          (sqrtWeightDiagonal t x * invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf]; simp
  rw [hh, sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf]
  rfl

/-- The root entry is unchanged because the constructed root balance weight is 1. -/
theorem physical_root_resolvent_transport {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s ≠ 0) :
    physicalRootResponse t x s =
      (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s + symmetricNegativeGenerator t x)⁻¹ 0 0 := by
  have hA : IsUnit (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s + symmetricNegativeGenerator t x).det := by
    rw [← sub_neg_eq_add, ← Matrix.eval_charpoly, ← physical_charpoly_symmetric t x ha hf,
      isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    exact hs
  unfold physicalRootResponse
  rw [← physical_scalar_similarity t x ha hf s,
    similarity_inverse _ _ _ (sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf)
      (invSqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_sqrt t x ha hf) hA]
  simp [sqrtWeightDiagonal, invSqrtWeightDiagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal]

/-- Actual physical roots and normalized observation weights. Hidden modes may
have zero weights; repeated characteristic roots are NOT silently ruled out. -/
theorem physical_finite_stieltjes {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ)
    (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    ∃ r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < r i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) ∧
      (∑ i, w i) = 1 ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = ∏ i, (X + C (r i)) ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0) →
        physicalRootResponse t x s = ∑ i, w i / (s+r i) := by
  have hB := symmetricNegativeGenerator_posDef t x hell ha hf
  obtain ⟨r,w,hr,hw,hm,hP,hR⟩ := posDef_resolvent_representation _ hB (0 : Fin (n+1))
  have hphys : physicalCharacteristic t x = ∏ i, (X+C (r i)) :=
    (physical_charpoly_symmetric t x ha hf).trans hP
  refine ⟨r,w,hr,hw,hm,hphys,?_⟩
  intro s hs
  have hne : (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hphys, Polynomial.eval_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro i _
    simpa only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C] using hs i
  rw [physical_root_resolvent_transport t x ha hf s hne]
  exact hR s hs

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PhysicalStieltjes
import HydrologyTree.EdgeCharacteristic

/-! Exact numerator reconstruction and noncancellation criterion for finite
Stieltjes representations. Coincident rates and zero weights are kept until
noncancellation is proved; they are not silently removed by the definitions. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

def stieltjesDenominator (r : I → ℝ) : ℝ[X] := ∏ i : I, (X+C (r i))
def stieltjesNumerator (r w : I → ℝ) : ℝ[X] :=
  ∑ i : I, C (w i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X+C (r j))

lemma stieltjesDenominator_monic (r : I → ℝ) : (stieltjesDenominator r).Monic :=
  Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun i _ => Polynomial.monic_X_add_C (r i))

@[simp] lemma eval_stieltjesDenominator (r : I → ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    (stieltjesDenominator r).eval s = ∏ i : I, (s+r i) := by
  simp [stieltjesDenominator, Polynomial.eval_prod]

@[simp] lemma eval_stieltjesNumerator (r w : I → ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval s =
      ∑ i : I, w i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (s+r j) := by
  simp [stieltjesNumerator, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_prod]

lemma stieltjes_sum_mul_denominator (r w : I → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i : I, w i/(s+r i)) * (stieltjesDenominator r).eval s =
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval s := by
  rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator, eval_stieltjesNumerator, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun j : I => s+r j) (Finset.mem_univ i),
    ← mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hs i)]

/-- Equality of actual rational functions off their poles fixes the complete
unreduced numerator, even when some pole factors later cancel. -/
theorem polynomial_stieltjes_recovery (F : ℝ[X]) (r w : I → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0) →
      F.eval s/(stieltjesDenominator r).eval s = ∑ i : I, w i/(s+r i)) :
    F = stieltjesNumerator r w := by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (infinite_nonroots _ (stieltjesDenominator_monic r).ne_zero).mono
  intro s hs
  have hp : (stieltjesDenominator r).eval s ≠ 0 := hs
  have hi : ∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff] at hp
    exact fun i => hp i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have he := congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z*(stieltjesDenominator r).eval s) (h s hi)
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hp, stieltjes_sum_mul_denominator r w s hi] at he
  exact he

@[simp] lemma stieltjesDenominator_eval_pole (r : I → ℝ) (i : I) :
    (stieltjesDenominator r).eval (-r i) = 0 := by
  rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (by ring)

/-- Exact numerator value at a pole; valid even when other rates coincide. -/
theorem stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole (r w : I → ℝ) (i : I) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-r i) =
      w i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (r j-r i) := by
  rw [eval_stieltjesNumerator, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · congr 1
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  · intro j _ hji
    have hi : i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j := by simp [Ne.symm hji]
    have hz : (∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (-r i+r k)) = 0 :=
      Finset.prod_eq_zero hi (by ring)
    rw [hz, mul_zero]
  · simp

/-- Absence of cancellation forces distinct poles and nonzero observation weights. -/
theorem stieltjes_noncancellation_forces_modes (r w : I → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ z : ℝ, (stieltjesDenominator r).eval z = 0 →
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval z ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective r ∧ ∀ i, w i ≠ 0 := by
  have hm (i : I) : w i * (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (r j-r i)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole] using h (-r i) (stieltjesDenominator_eval_pole r i)
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    by_contra hne
    have hj : j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i := by simp [Ne.symm hne]
    have hz : (∏ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (r k-r i)) = 0 :=
      Finset.prod_eq_zero hj (sub_eq_zero.mpr hij.symm)
    exact hm i (by rw [hz, mul_zero])
  · intro i
    exact left_ne_zero_of_mul (hm i)

/-- Distinct poles with nonzero observation weights also rule out every common
root; with nonnegative weights this is equivalent to every weight being positive. -/
theorem stieltjes_modes_force_noncancellation (r w : I → ℝ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0) :
    ∀ z : ℝ, (stieltjesDenominator r).eval z = 0 →
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval z ≠ 0 := by
  intro z hz
  rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff] at hz
  obtain ⟨i,_,hi⟩ := hz
  have he : z = -r i := by linarith
  rw [he, stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole]
  apply mul_ne_zero (hw i)
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro j hj
  apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
  intro hji
  exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1 (hr hji)

/-- The actual unreduced cofactor has the complete positive-tree spectral
numerator formula, not just a fitted response or selected pole values. -/
theorem physical_stieltjes_polynomials {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    ∃ r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < r i) ∧ (∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) ∧ (∑ i, w i)=1 ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = stieltjesDenominator r ∧
      physicalRootCofactor t x = stieltjesNumerator r w := by
  obtain ⟨r,w,hr,hw,hm,hP,hR⟩ := physical_finite_stieltjes t x hell ha hf
  refine ⟨r,w,hr,hw,hm,hP,?_⟩
  apply polynomial_stieltjes_recovery
  intro s hs
  have h := hR s hs
  rw [physicalRootResponse_eq, hP] at h
  exact h

end HydrologyTree
import HydrologyTree.RootModalData
import HydrologyTree.StieltjesNumerator

/-! Construction of modal coordinates from the ORIGINAL positive physical matrix.
The diagonalization, inverse maps, input vector, root output and both actual
coefficient polynomials are proved. No modal-representation premise remains. -/
open Matrix Polynomial Unitary
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

theorem physical_root_modal_representation {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    ∃ M : RootModalData (compartmentMatrix t x),
      (∀ i, 0 < M.rates i) ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = stieltjesDenominator M.rates ∧
      physicalRootCofactor t x = stieltjesNumerator M.rates (fun i => (M.amplitudes i)^2) := by
  let A := compartmentMatrix t x
  let B := symmetricNegativeGenerator t x
  have hB : B.PosDef := symmetricNegativeGenerator_posDef t x hell ha hf
  let U := hB.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  let r := hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  let D := sqrtWeightDiagonal t x
  let E := invSqrtWeightDiagonal t x
  let S := D*(U : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ)
  let T := star (U : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ)*E
  have hDE : D*E=1 := sqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_inv t x ha hf
  have hED : E*D=1 := invSqrtWeightDiagonal_mul_sqrt t x ha hf
  have hUU : (U : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ)*star (U : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ)=1 := U.property.2
  have hUT : star (U : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ)*(U : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ)=1 := U.property.1
  have hST : S*T=1 := by
    change (D*(U : Matrix _ _ ℝ))*(star (U : Matrix _ _ ℝ)*E)=1
    calc
      _ = D*((U : Matrix _ _ ℝ)*star (U : Matrix _ _ ℝ))*E := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hUU,Matrix.mul_one,hDE]
  have hTS : T*S=1 := by
    change (star (U : Matrix _ _ ℝ)*E)*(D*(U : Matrix _ _ ℝ))=1
    calc
      _ = star (U : Matrix _ _ ℝ)*(E*D)*(U : Matrix _ _ ℝ) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hED,Matrix.mul_one,hUT]
  have hspec : B=(U : Matrix _ _ ℝ)*Matrix.diagonal r*star (U : Matrix _ _ ℝ) := by
    simpa only [conjStarAlgAut_apply,RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id,Function.id_comp] using
      hB.isHermitian.spectral_theorem
  have hEA : E*A*D= -B := by
    exact neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp (physical_negative_similarity t x ha hf).symm
  have hBU : (-B)*(U : Matrix _ _ ℝ)=(U : Matrix _ _ ℝ)*Matrix.diagonal (fun i => -r i) := by
    rw [hspec,Matrix.neg_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc,hUT,Matrix.mul_one]
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  have hAS : A*S=S*Matrix.diagonal (fun i => -r i) := by
    change A*(D*(U : Matrix _ _ ℝ))=(D*(U : Matrix _ _ ℝ))*Matrix.diagonal (fun i => -r i)
    calc
      _ = D*((E*A*D)*(U : Matrix _ _ ℝ)) := by simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc,hDE,Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = D*((-B)*(U : Matrix _ _ ℝ)) := by rw [hEA]
      _ = _ := by rw [hBU,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hEinput : E *ᵥ (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)=Pi.single 0 1 := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i=0
    · subst i
      simp [E,invSqrtWeightDiagonal,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,Matrix.diagonal_apply]
    · simp [E,invSqrtWeightDiagonal,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,Matrix.diagonal_apply,hi]
  have hinput : T *ᵥ (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)=(fun i => U 0 i) := by
    change (star (U : Matrix _ _ ℝ)*E)*ᵥ Pi.single 0 1= _
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,hEinput]
    ext i
    simp [Matrix.mulVec_single_one,Matrix.star_apply,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,star_trivial]
  have hout (y : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : (S*ᵥy) 0=∑ i, U 0 i*y i := by
    simp [S,D,sqrtWeightDiagonal,Matrix.diagonal_mul,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct]
  let M : RootModalData A := ⟨r,(fun i => U 0 i),S,T,hST,hTS,hAS,hinput,hout⟩
  have hP : physicalCharacteristic t x=stieltjesDenominator r :=
    (physical_charpoly_symmetric t x ha hf).trans (charpoly_neg_posDef B hB)
  refine ⟨M,hB.eigenvalues_pos,hP,?_⟩
  change physicalRootCofactor t x=stieltjesNumerator r (fun i => (U 0 i)^2)
  apply polynomial_stieltjes_recovery
  intro s hs
  have hn : (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hP,eval_stieltjesDenominator]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hs i)
  have he : B=conjStarAlgAut ℝ _ U (Matrix.diagonal r) := by
    simpa only [conjStarAlgAut_apply] using hspec
  have hi := conjugated_diagonal_resolvent U r s hs
  rw [← he] at hi
  calc
    _ = physicalRootResponse t x s := by rw [physicalRootResponse_eq,hP]
    _ = (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) s+B)⁻¹ 0 0 := physical_root_resolvent_transport t x ha hf s hn
    _ = ∑ i, (U 0 i)^2 / (s+r i) := by
      rw [Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv hi,conjugation_diagonal_entry]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.LinearForcedODE
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.IntervalIntegral.FundThmCalculus
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.ExpDeriv

/-! Explicit classical scalar solution, using the actual interval integral.
The formula is defined for both time orientations and all real decay rates. -/
open MeasureTheory
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def scalarForcedSolution (r : ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (a y0 s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-r*(s-a)) * (y0 + ∫ v in a..s, Real.exp (r*(v-a))*u v)

@[simp] theorem scalarForcedSolution_initial (r : ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (a y0 : ℝ) :
    scalarForcedSolution r u a y0 a=y0 := by simp [scalarForcedSolution]

lemma scalarIntegratingFactor_cancel (r a s : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-r*(s-a))*Real.exp (r*(s-a))=1 := by
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  convert Real.exp_zero using 1 <;> ring

/-- The derivative is the actual inhomogeneous scalar differential equation. -/
theorem scalarForcedSolution_hasDerivAt (r : ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u)
    (a y0 s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (scalarForcedSolution r u a y0)
      (-r*scalarForcedSolution r u a y0 s + u s) s := by
  have hc : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (r*(v-a))*u v) := by fun_prop
  have hI := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hc.intervalIntegrable a s)
    hc.aestronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter hc.continuousAt
  have he : HasDerivAt (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-r*(v-a)))
      (Real.exp (-r*(s-a))*(-r)) s := by
    convert (((hasDerivAt_id s).sub_const a).const_mul (-r)).exp using 1 <;> simp
  have h := he.mul (hI.const_add y0)
  apply h.congr_deriv
  dsimp only [scalarForcedSolution]
  have hcanc := scalarIntegratingFactor_cancel r a s
  calc
    _ = -r*(Real.exp (-r*(s-a))*(y0+∫ v in a..s, Real.exp (r*(v-a))*u v)) +
        (Real.exp (-r*(s-a))*Real.exp (r*(s-a)))*u s := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hcanc,one_mul]

/-- Scaling the forcing and initial state scales the actual integral solution. -/
theorem scalarForcedSolution_scale (r c : ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (a y0 s : ℝ) :
    scalarForcedSolution r (fun v => c*u v) a (c*y0) s =
      c*scalarForcedSolution r u a y0 s := by
  simp only [scalarForcedSolution]
  have he : (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (r*(v-a))*(c*u v)) =
      (fun v : ℝ => c*(Real.exp (r*(v-a))*u v)) := by funext v; ring
  rw [he,intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  ring

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.RootModalData
import HydrologyTree.ScalarForcedODE

/-! Explicit actual state trajectories from a proved modal coordinate witness.
The forcing is any continuous real function; the initial state is arbitrary. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ}

def modalForcedSolution (M : RootModalData A) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ)
    (z0 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (s : ℝ) : Fin (n+1) → ℝ :=
  M.synthesis *ᵥ (fun i => scalarForcedSolution (M.rates i)
    (fun v => M.amplitudes i*u v) a ((M.analysis*ᵥz0) i) s)

@[simp] theorem modalForcedSolution_initial (M : RootModalData A)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) (z0 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    modalForcedSolution M u a z0 a=z0 := by
  simp only [modalForcedSolution,scalarForcedSolution_initial]
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,M.synth_analysis,Matrix.one_mulVec]

/-- The formula satisfies the ORIGINAL matrix differential equation. -/
theorem modalForcedSolution_ode (M : RootModalData A) (u : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hu : Continuous u) (a : ℝ) (z0 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    IsForcedMatrixSolution A (Pi.single 0 1) u (modalForcedSolution M u a z0) := by
  intro s
  let y : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ := fun v i => scalarForcedSolution (M.rates i)
    (fun q => M.amplitudes i*u q) a ((M.analysis*ᵥz0) i) v
  have hy : HasDerivAt y (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => -M.rates i)*ᵥy s + u s • M.amplitudes) s := by
    apply hasDerivAt_pi.mpr
    intro i
    convert scalarForcedSolution_hasDerivAt (M.rates i) (fun q => M.amplitudes i*u q)
      (continuous_const.mul hu) a ((M.analysis*ᵥz0) i) s using 1 <;>
      simp [y,Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.diagonal_apply,smul_eq_mul,mul_comm]
  have h := (matrixOperator M.synthesis).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hy
  apply h.congr_deriv
  exact rootModal_synthesis_rhs M (y s) (u s)

/-- Global existence and uniqueness for any initial state and continuous input. -/
theorem modalForcedSolution_existsUnique (M : RootModalData A)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (a : ℝ) (z0 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    ∃! z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ, IsForcedMatrixSolution A (Pi.single 0 1) u z ∧ z a=z0 := by
  refine ⟨modalForcedSolution M u a z0,⟨modalForcedSolution_ode M u hu a z0,
    modalForcedSolution_initial M u a z0⟩,?_⟩
  intro z hz
  exact forcedMatrixSolution_unique A (Pi.single 0 1) u z (modalForcedSolution M u a z0) a
    hz.1 (modalForcedSolution_ode M u hu a z0)
    (hz.2.trans (modalForcedSolution_initial M u a z0).symm)

/-- The root trajectory for zero initial storage is determined by the modal
rates and squared amplitudes for EVERY input, not only a finite sample. -/
theorem modalForcedSolution_root_zero (M : RootModalData A)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (a s : ℝ) :
    (modalForcedSolution M u a 0 s) 0 =
      ∑ i, (M.amplitudes i)^2 * scalarForcedSolution (M.rates i) u a 0 s := by
  rw [modalForcedSolution,M.root_output]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_zero,Pi.zero_apply]
  have h := scalarForcedSolution_scale (M.rates i) (M.amplitudes i) u a 0 s
  simp only [mul_zero] at h
  rw [h]
  ring

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.StieltjesNumerator

/-! Degree and leading coefficient of the actual finite Stieltjes numerator.
The normalizing mass constraint is used explicitly; signs and distinctness of
poles are not needed for these algebraic identities. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma stieltjesTerm_monic {n : ℕ} (r : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X+C (r j))).Monic :=
  Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun j _ => Polynomial.monic_X_add_C (r j))

lemma stieltjesTerm_natDegree {n : ℕ} (r : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X+C (r j))).natDegree = n := by
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _ (fun j _ => Polynomial.monic_X_add_C (r j))]
  simp

lemma stieltjesTerm_top_coefficient {n : ℕ} (r : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X+C (r j))).coeff n = 1 := by
  have h : (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X+C (r j))).coeff
      (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (X+C (r j))).natDegree = 1 := by
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_natDegree]
    exact stieltjesTerm_monic r i
  simpa only [stieltjesTerm_natDegree] using h

lemma stieltjesNumerator_natDegree_le {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).natDegree ≤ n := by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
  intro i _
  exact Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans (by
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_C,zero_add,stieltjesTerm_natDegree])

lemma stieltjesNumerator_top_coefficient {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).coeff n = ∑ i, w i := by
  simp [stieltjesNumerator,Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff,Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
    stieltjesTerm_top_coefficient]

/-- Exact monicity at every normalized weight vector, including n=0. -/
theorem normalized_stieltjesNumerator_monic {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hw : (∑ i, w i)=1) : (stieltjesNumerator r w).Monic := by
  apply Polynomial.monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one n (stieltjesNumerator_natDegree_le r w)
  rw [stieltjesNumerator_top_coefficient,hw]

theorem normalized_stieltjesNumerator_degree {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hw : (∑ i, w i)=1) : (stieltjesNumerator r w).natDegree = n := by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero (stieltjesNumerator_natDegree_le r w)
  rw [stieltjesNumerator_top_coefficient,hw]
  exact one_ne_zero

lemma stieltjesDenominator_natDegree {n : ℕ} (r : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    (stieltjesDenominator r).natDegree = n+1 := by
  rw [stieltjesDenominator,Polynomial.natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _
    (fun i _ => Polynomial.monic_X_add_C (r i))]
  simp

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.StieltjesDegree
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.IntermediateValue
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Polynomial

/-! Actual real zeros between every pair of consecutive Stieltjes poles.
Existence follows from a proved polynomial sign calculation and the IVT;
it is not supplied by a spectral oracle or a root-finding computation. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma fin_stieltjes_adjacent_lt {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : i.castSucc < i.succ := by
  change i.val < i.val+1
  omega

lemma fin_stieltjes_outside_adjacent {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) (j : Fin (n+1))
    (hlo : j ≠ i.castSucc) (hhi : j ≠ i.succ) : j < i.castSucc ∨ i.succ < j := by
  have hl : j.val ≠ i.val := fun h => hlo (Fin.ext h)
  have hh : j.val ≠ i.val+1 := fun h => hhi (Fin.ext h)
  change j.val < i.val ∨ i.val+1 < j.val
  omega

lemma adjacentPole_other_product_pos {n : ℕ} (r : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : StrictMono r)
    (i : Fin n) :
    0 < ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i.castSucc).erase i.succ,
      (r j-r i.castSucc)*(r j-r i.succ) := by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro j hj
  have hji : j ≠ i.castSucc := (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).2).1
  have hjs : j ≠ i.succ := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
  rcases fin_stieltjes_outside_adjacent i j hji hjs with hlt | hgt
  · exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr (hr hlt))
      (sub_neg.mpr (hr (lt_trans hlt (fin_stieltjes_adjacent_lt i))))
  · exact mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (hr (lt_trans (fin_stieltjes_adjacent_lt i) hgt)))
      (sub_pos.mpr (hr hgt))

/-- Consecutive pole evaluations of the ACTUAL numerator have opposite signs. -/
theorem stieltjesNumerator_adjacent_poles_opposite {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (i : Fin n) :
    (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-r i.castSucc) *
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-r i.succ) < 0 := by
  have hneq : i.castSucc ≠ i.succ := ne_of_lt (fin_stieltjes_adjacent_lt i)
  have hs : i.succ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n+1))).erase i.castSucc := by simp [Ne.symm hneq]
  have hl : i.castSucc ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n+1))).erase i.succ := by simp [hneq]
  have hgap : 0 < r i.succ-r i.castSucc := sub_pos.mpr (hr (fin_stieltjes_adjacent_lt i))
  have hrest := adjacentPole_other_product_pos r hr i
  have herase : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n+1))).erase i.succ).erase i.castSucc =
      (Finset.univ.erase i.castSucc).erase i.succ := by
    ext j
    simp only [Finset.mem_erase]
    tauto
  have hid : (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-r i.castSucc) *
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-r i.succ) =
      -((w i.castSucc*w i.succ)*(r i.succ-r i.castSucc)^2 *
        ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i.castSucc).erase i.succ,
          (r j-r i.castSucc)*(r j-r i.succ)) := by
    rw [stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole,stieltjesNumerator_eval_pole,
      ← Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ.erase i.castSucc) (fun j => r j-r i.castSucc) hs,
      ← Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ.erase i.succ) (fun j => r j-r i.succ) hl,
      herase,Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    ring
  rw [hid]
  exact neg_lt_zero.mpr (mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos (hw _) (hw _)) (sq_pos_of_pos hgap)) hrest)

lemma polynomial_zero_between_opposite (p : ℝ[X]) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (h : p.eval a*p.eval b < 0) : ∃ z : ℝ, a < z ∧ z < b ∧ p.eval z = 0 := by
  have hu : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.uIcc (p.eval a) (p.eval b) := by
    rw [Set.mem_uIcc]
    rcases mul_neg_iff.mp h with ⟨ha,hb⟩ | ⟨ha,hb⟩
    all_goals first | exact Or.inl ⟨ha.le,hb.le⟩ | exact Or.inr ⟨hb.le,ha.le⟩
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hzero⟩ := intermediate_value_uIcc (p.continuous.continuousOn) hu
  change p.eval z = 0 at hzero
  have hz' : a ≤ z ∧ z ≤ b := by simpa only [Set.uIcc_of_le hab.le,Set.mem_Icc] using hz
  have hza : z ≠ a := by intro he; rw [he] at hzero; rw [hzero,zero_mul] at h; exact (lt_irrefl _ h)
  have hzb : z ≠ b := by intro he; rw [he] at hzero; rw [hzero,mul_zero] at h; exact (lt_irrefl _ h)
  exact ⟨z,lt_of_le_of_ne hz'.1 (Ne.symm hza),lt_of_le_of_ne hz'.2 hzb,hzero⟩

/-- An actual numerator zero strictly between each consecutive pair of poles. -/
theorem stieltjes_interlacing_zero_exists {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃ b : ℝ, r i.castSucc < b ∧ b < r i.succ ∧ (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-b)=0 := by
  have hg : r i.castSucc < r i.succ := hr (fin_stieltjes_adjacent_lt i)
  have hs := stieltjesNumerator_adjacent_poles_opposite r w hr hw i
  rw [mul_comm] at hs
  obtain ⟨z,hz1,hz2,hzero⟩ := polynomial_zero_between_opposite
    (stieltjesNumerator r w) (-r i.succ) (-r i.castSucc) (neg_lt_neg hg) hs
  refine ⟨-z,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith
  · simpa only [neg_neg] using hzero

/-- Choose all zeros together; uniqueness and full factorization are established separately. -/
def stieltjesZeroRates {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) : Fin n → ℝ :=
  fun i => Classical.choose (stieltjes_interlacing_zero_exists r w hr hw i)

lemma stieltjesZeroRates_spec {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (i : Fin n) :
    r i.castSucc < stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i ∧
      stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i < r i.succ ∧
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval (-stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i)=0 :=
  Classical.choose_spec (stieltjes_interlacing_zero_exists r w hr hw i)

theorem stieltjesZeroRates_strictMono {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) : StrictMono (stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw) := by
  intro i j hij
  have h1 := (stieltjesZeroRates_spec r w hr hw i).2.1
  have h2 := (stieltjesZeroRates_spec r w hr hw j).1
  have hmid : r i.succ ≤ r j.castSucc := hr.monotone (by
    change i.val+1 ≤ j.val
    exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (show i.val < j.val from hij))
  exact lt_trans (lt_of_lt_of_le h1 hmid) h2

lemma stieltjesZeroRates_pos {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : StrictMono r) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (hpos : ∀ j, 0 < r j) (i : Fin n) :
    0 < stieltjesZeroRates r w hr hw i :=
  lt_trans (hpos i.castSucc) (stieltjesZeroRates_spec r w hr hw i).1

end HydrologyTree
