/-! Exact coefficient interpretation of the one-child root transformation.
All coefficient permutations, including degree-zero tails, are explicit. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev PathCoefficients (n : ℕ) := Coeff (n+1) × Coeff n
abbrev PathPolyData (n : ℕ) := RootTransitionSpace (Coeff (n+1)) (Coeff n)

lemma cut_cut {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    cut n (cut m p : ℝ[X]) = cut n p := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  change ((cut n (cut m p : ℝ[X]) : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i =
    ((cut n p : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i
  rw [cut_coeff, cut_coeff]
  exact cut_coeff m p ⟨i.val, lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt h⟩

/-- High-first two coefficients and the remaining low coefficients. -/
def topTwoEquiv (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+2) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ((ℝ × ℝ) × Coeff n) :=
  (leadingEquiv (n+1)).symm |>.trans
    ((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ).prodCongr (leadingEquiv n).symm) |>.trans
    (LinearEquiv.prodAssoc ℝ ℝ ℝ (Coeff n)).symm

@[simp] lemma topTwoEquiv_apply (n : ℕ) (p : Coeff (n+2)) :
    topTwoEquiv n p =
      (((p : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1), (p : ℝ[X]).coeff n), cut n (p : ℝ[X])) := by
  change (((p : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1), ((cut (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) : ℝ[X])).coeff n),
      cut n (cut (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) : ℝ[X])) = _
  rw [cut_coeff (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩, cut_cut (Nat.le_succ n)]

/-- A rate-independent permutation of the actual parent polynomial coefficients. -/
def parentCoefficientEquiv (n : ℕ) : PathCoefficients (n+1) ≃ₗ[ℝ] PathPolyData n :=
  (LinearEquiv.prodComm ℝ (Coeff (n+2)) (Coeff (n+1))).trans
    ((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (Coeff (n+1))).prodCongr (topTwoEquiv n))

def pathTop (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap ((Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

def pathNext (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (((Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ n).comp
    (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ (X : ℝ[X]))).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

def pathLow (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap ((cut n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

def pathShift (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (((cut n).comp (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ (X : ℝ[X]))).comp
    (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

/-- The actual characteristic polynomial when one child is attached at the root. -/
def pathStepPolynomial {n : ℕ} (z : PathPolyData n) : ℝ[X] :=
  (X + C z.2.1.1) * (monicPoly z.1 : ℝ[X]) - C z.2.1.2 * (monicPoly z.2.2 : ℝ[X])

def pathStepCoefficients {n : ℕ} (z : PathPolyData n) : PathCoefficients (n+1) :=
  (cut (n+2) (pathStepPolynomial z), z.1)

  simp only [pathStepPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add,
    Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^(n+1) = X^(n+2) by exact (pow_succ' (X : ℝ[X]) (n+1)).symm]
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_X_mul]
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound z.1 le_rfl,
    coeff_eq_zero_of_bound z.2.2 (Nat.le_succ n),
    if_neg (show n+1 ≠ n+2 from by omega), if_neg (show n+1 ≠ n from by omega),
    if_pos rfl, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero, sub_zero]
  simp only [ite_true, mul_one]
  rfl

lemma pathStepPolynomial_next {n : ℕ} (z : PathPolyData n) :
    (pathStepPolynomial z).coeff n = pathNext n z.1 + z.2.1.1 * pathTop n z.1 - z.2.1.2 := by
  simp only [pathStepPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add,
    Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^(n+1) = X^(n+2) by exact (pow_succ' (X : ℝ[X]) (n+1)).symm]
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound z.2.2 le_rfl,
    if_neg (show n ≠ n+2 from by omega), if_neg (show n ≠ n+1 from by omega),
    if_pos rfl, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add, add_zero, ite_true]
  rfl

lemma pathStepPolynomial_low {n : ℕ} (z : PathPolyData n) :
    cut n (pathStepPolynomial z) =
      pathShift n z.1 + z.2.1.1 • pathLow n z.1 - z.2.1.2 • z.2.2 := by
  simp only [pathStepPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add, map_sub, map_add]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^(n+1) = X^(n+2) by exact (pow_succ' (X : ℝ[X]) (n+1)).symm]
  simp only [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul, cut_X_pow_of_le n (n+2) (by omega),
    cut_X_pow_of_le n (n+1) (by omega), cut_X_pow_of_le n n le_rfl,
    smul_zero, cut_coe, zero_add, add_zero]
  rfl

/-- The explicit triangular endomorphism is exactly the actual coefficient

theorem parentCoefficient_step_eq {n : ℕ} (z : PathPolyData n) :
    parentCoefficientEquiv n (pathStepCoefficients z) =
      rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n) z := by
  change (z.1, topTwoEquiv n (cut (n+2) (pathStepPolynomial z))) = _

  rw [cut_coeff (n+2) (pathStepPolynomial z) ⟨n+1, by omega⟩,
    cut_coeff (n+2) (pathStepPolynomial z) ⟨n, by omega⟩, cut_cut (show n ≤ n+2 by omega)]

  simpa using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)

  have he : (fun w => parentCoefficientEquiv n (pathStepCoefficients w)) =
      rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n) := by
    funext w; exact parentCoefficient_step_eq w
  rw [he, endJacobian_rootTransition, finrank_coeff]

end HydrologyTree

  have hp := congrArg (fun u : RootTransitionSpace P E => u.1) h
  change z.1 = w.1 at hp
  have hd0 := congrArg (fun u : RootTransitionSpace P E => u.2.1.1) h

  rw [hp] at hd0

        Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨j, by simp [hjc], hj⟩
      rw [he, mul_zero]

/-! Common roots over any field extension of the reals of the actual characteristic polynomial and actual
root cofactor: exact local cancellation classification from physical rates. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Only internal directed rates must be nonzero; the original root leak is unrestricted. -/
def NonzeroTreeEdges {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  (∀ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ e : Fin n, x.2 e ≠ 0)

lemma inward_nonroot_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) : x.1 v ≠ 0 := by
  rw [← Fin.succ_pred v hv]
  exact hx.1 _

lemma outward_nonroot_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) : outwardByVertex x.2 v ≠ 0 := by
  rw [← Fin.succ_pred v hv, outwardByVertex_succ]
  exact hx.2 _

/-- Nonzero physical edge rates pass to every genuinely extracted child model. -/
theorem nonzero_child_edges {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (c : RootChild t)
    (x : TreeRates n) (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) : NonzeroTreeEdges (childRates t c x) := by
  constructor
  · intro e
    exact inward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx _ (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c e.succ))
  · intro e
    exact outward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx _ (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c e.succ))

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℝ K]

/-- An actual common zero, with no cancellation of the stored polynomials. -/
def PhysicalCommonRoot {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (z : K) : Prop :=
  aeval z (physicalRootCofactor t x) = 0 ∧ aeval z (physicalCharacteristic t x) = 0

def SiblingCollisionAtRoot {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (z : K) : Prop :=
  ∃ c d : RootChild t, c ≠ d ∧
    aeval z (childCharacteristic t x c) = 0 ∧ aeval z (childCharacteristic t x d) = 0

/-- Exact common-root recursion, including simultaneous cancellations in several children. -/
theorem physicalCommonRoot_local_iff {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (z : K) :
    PhysicalCommonRoot t x z ↔ SiblingCollisionAtRoot t x z ∨
      ∃ c : RootChild t, PhysicalCommonRoot (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) z := by
  classical
  let p : RootChild t → K := fun c => aeval z (childCharacteristic t x c)
  let f : RootChild t → K := fun c => aeval z (childCofactor t x c)
  let a : RootChild t → K := fun c => algebraMap ℝ K (x.1 c.val * outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)
  have ha : ∀ c, a c ≠ 0 := by
    intro c
    exact (map_ne_zero (algebraMap ℝ K)).mpr (mul_ne_zero (inward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx _ c.property.1)
      (outward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx _ c.property.1))
  have h := finite_branch_cancellation_iff (z + algebraMap ℝ K ((rateChart t x).1 0)) p f a ha
  have he : PhysicalCommonRoot t x z ↔
      ∃ c, p c = 0 ∧ (f c = 0 ∨ ∃ j, j ≠ c ∧ p j = 0) := by
    rw [PhysicalCommonRoot, physicalRootCofactor_child_product,
      physicalCharacteristic_child_recursion]
    simpa only [map_prod, map_sub, map_mul, map_sum, map_add, aeval_X, aeval_C,
      mul_one,
      p, f, a, branchValueNumerator] using h
  rw [he]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c,hp,hc⟩
    rcases hc with hf | ⟨j,hjc,hj⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨c,hf,hp⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨c,j,Ne.symm hjc,hp,hj⟩
  · rintro (⟨c,d,hcd,hc,hd⟩ | ⟨c,hf,hp⟩)
    · exact ⟨c,hc,Or.inr ⟨d,Ne.symm hcd,hd⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨c,hp,Or.inl hf⟩

end HydrologyTree

/-! Actual one-level physical recovery for prescribed labelled child denominator
factors. The reference's internal rates are nonzero; the competing real rate
vector is unrestricted. This is a building block for complete fiber classification. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Actual edge product times the actual child cofactor. -/
def physicalChildNumerator {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) : ℝ[X] :=
  C (x.1 c.val * outwardByVertex x.2 c.val) * childCofactor t x c

lemma physicalChildNumerator_degree {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t) :
    (physicalChildNumerator t x c).degree < (childCharacteristic t x c).degree := by
  have hP : (childCharacteristic t x c).degree = ((childEdgeCount t c+1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    unfold childCharacteristic
    rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree (physicalCharacteristic_monic _ _).ne_zero]
    exact congrArg (fun k : ℕ => (k : WithBot ℕ)) (physicalCharacteristic_natDegree _ _)
  rw [hP]
  by_cases hc : x.1 c.val * outwardByVertex x.2 c.val = 0
  · simp [physicalChildNumerator, hc]
  · rw [physicalChildNumerator, Polynomial.degree_C_mul hc]
    unfold childCofactor
    rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree (physicalRootCofactor_monic _ _).ne_zero,
      physicalRootCofactor_natDegree]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self (childEdgeCount t c)

lemma physical_branch_numerator_sum {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    branchNumeratorSum (childCharacteristic t x) (physicalChildNumerator t x) =
      (X+C ((rateChart t x).1 0)) * (∏ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c) -
        physicalCharacteristic t x := by
  have h := physicalCharacteristic_child_recursion t x
  change physicalCharacteristic t x =
    (X+C ((rateChart t x).1 0)) * (∏ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c) -
      branchNumeratorSum (childCharacteristic t x) (physicalChildNumerator t x) at h
  linear_combination h

/-- The original parent characteristic and a fixed pairwise-coprime child-factor
assignment determine every actual edge-product times child cofactor globally. -/
theorem physical_child_numerators_identified {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (hcop : ∀ c d : RootChild t, c ≠ d →
      IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t x c) (childCharacteristic t x d))
    (hchild : ∀ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c = childCharacteristic t y c)
    (hparent : physicalCharacteristic t x = physicalCharacteristic t y) :
    physicalChildNumerator t x = physicalChildNumerator t y := by
  have hp : childCharacteristic t x = childCharacteristic t y := funext hchild
  apply coprime_branch_numerators_unique_mod_product (childCharacteristic t x)
    (physicalChildNumerator t x) (physicalChildNumerator t y) hcop
    (physicalChildNumerator_degree t x)
  · intro c
    rw [hchild c]
    exact physicalChildNumerator_degree t y c
  · refine ⟨C ((rateChart t x).1 0 - (rateChart t y).1 0), ?_⟩
    rw [physical_branch_numerator_sum, hp, physical_branch_numerator_sum, hparent]
    rw [map_sub]
    ring

/-- After the child denominators have been assigned, both child cofactors and
connector products are uniquely determined. No positivity premise is needed. -/
theorem physical_child_coefficients_identified {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x)
    (hcop : ∀ c d : RootChild t, c ≠ d →
      IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t x c) (childCharacteristic t x d))
    (hchild : ∀ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c = childCharacteristic t y c)
    (hparent : physicalCharacteristic t x = physicalCharacteristic t y) :
    ∀ c : RootChild t,
      childCofactor t x c = childCofactor t y c ∧
      x.1 c.val * outwardByVertex x.2 c.val = y.1 c.val * outwardByVertex y.2 c.val := by
  have h := physical_child_numerators_identified t x y hcop hchild hparent
  intro c
  have he := congrFun h c
  have hn : x.1 c.val * outwardByVertex x.2 c.val ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (inward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx c.val c.property.1)
      (outward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx c.val c.property.1)
  have hm := scalar_monic_polynomial_unique (childCofactor t x c) (childCofactor t y c)
    (physicalRootCofactor_monic _ _) (physicalRootCofactor_monic _ _)
    _ _ hn he
  exact ⟨hm.2,hm.1⟩

/-- A fixed child denominator assignment recovers the complete child coefficient
data and each actual outward connector, even for unrestricted alternative rates. -/
theorem physical_child_data_and_connectors_identified {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x)
    (hcop : ∀ c d : RootChild t, c ≠ d →
      IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t x c) (childCharacteristic t x d))
    (hchild : ∀ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c = childCharacteristic t y c)
    (hparent : physicalCharacteristic t x = physicalCharacteristic t y) :
    ∀ c : RootChild t,
      physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) =
        physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c) (childRates t c y) ∧
      outwardByVertex x.2 c.val = outwardByVertex y.2 c.val := by
  intro c
  have hc := physical_child_coefficients_identified t x y hx hcop hchild hparent c
  have he : physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) =
      physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c) (childRates t c y) :=
    (physicalCoefficientMap_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr ⟨hchild c,hc.1⟩
  have hleak := physical_root_leak_identified (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)
    (childRates t c y) (nonzero_child_edges t c x hx).1 he
  rw [childRates_leak,childRates_leak] at hleak
  refine ⟨he,?_⟩
  rw [← hleak] at hc
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (inward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx c.val c.property.1) hc.2

end HydrologyTree

/-! Global all-size uniqueness for a prescribed recursive assignment of actual
subtree characteristic polynomials. This proves uniqueness per assignment;
existence of all assignments and their total count are separate obligations. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Every local sibling family of the actual recursive principal model is coprime. -/
def CoprimeAtEveryBranch {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  (∀ c d : RootChild t, c ≠ d →
    IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t x c) (childCharacteristic t x d)) ∧
  ∀ c : RootChild t, CoprimeAtEveryBranch (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

/-- Fixed labelled factor assignment at every vertex, using ACTUAL principal
subtree characteristic polynomials. Cofactors and rates are not assumed equal. -/
def SameSubtreeCharacteristics {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  physicalCharacteristic t x = physicalCharacteristic t y ∧
  ∀ c : RootChild t, SameSubtreeCharacteristics (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) (childRates t c y)
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

/-- Every recursive child-denominator assignment has AT MOST one realization
among all real rate vectors when the reference has nonzero internal rates and
coprime siblings. The competitor needs no positivity or regularity hypothesis. -/
theorem physical_subtree_assignment_unique {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (hcop : CoprimeAtEveryBranch t x)
    (hassign : SameSubtreeCharacteristics t x y) : x = y := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [CoprimeAtEveryBranch] at hcop
    rw [SameSubtreeCharacteristics] at hassign
    have hchild : ∀ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c = childCharacteristic t y c := by
      intro c
      have hh := hassign.2 c
      rw [SameSubtreeCharacteristics] at hh
      exact hh.1
    have hcofactor : physicalRootCofactor t x = physicalRootCofactor t y := by
      rw [physicalRootCofactor_child_product, physicalRootCofactor_child_product]
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun c _ => hchild c)
    have hcoeff : physicalCoefficientMap t x = physicalCoefficientMap t y :=
      (physicalCoefficientMap_eq_iff t x y).mpr ⟨hassign.1,hcofactor⟩
    have hleak := physical_root_leak_identified t x y hx.1 hcoeff
    have hconnectors := physical_child_data_and_connectors_identified t x y hx hcop.1 hchild hassign.1
    have hstates (c : RootChild t) : childRates t c x = childRates t c y :=
      ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)
        (childRates t c y) (nonzero_child_edges t c x hx) (hcop.2 c) (hassign.2 c)
    apply (ratePartitionEquiv t).injective
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact hleak
    · funext c
      rw [ratePartition_child,ratePartition_child,hstates c,(hconnectors c).2]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Positive-rate hypotheses and the proved negative-real factorization pass
to every ACTUAL principal child model. No principal spectral input is assumed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma inward_nonroot_pos {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < x.1 v := by
  rw [← Fin.succ_pred v hv]
  exact ha _

lemma outward_nonroot_pos {n : ℕ} (x : TreeRates n) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < outwardByVertex x.2 v := by
  rw [← Fin.succ_pred v hv,outwardByVertex_succ]
  exact hf _

/-- The child's root leak is positive because it is the original exit-to-parent rate. -/
theorem positive_child_rates {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    0 < (childRates t c x).1 0 ∧
      (∀ e : Fin (childEdgeCount t c), 0 < (childRates t c x).1 e.succ) ∧
      (∀ e : Fin (childEdgeCount t c), 0 < (childRates t c x).2 e) := by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [childRates_leak]
    exact inward_nonroot_pos x ha c.val c.property.1
  · intro e
    exact inward_nonroot_pos x ha (childEnumeration t c e.succ).val
      (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c e.succ))
  · intro e
    exact outward_nonroot_pos x hf (childEnumeration t c e.succ).val
      (branchVertex_ne_zero t c (childEnumeration t c e.succ))

lemma coprime_linear_of_ne (a b : ℝ) (h : a ≠ b) : IsCoprime (X+C a) (X+C b) := by
  have hn : a-b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h
  refine ⟨C ((a-b)⁻¹), -C ((a-b)⁻¹), ?_⟩
  calc
    _ = C ((a-b)⁻¹) * C (a-b) := by rw [map_sub]; ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [← map_mul,inv_mul_cancel₀ hn,map_one]

/-- For completely real factorizations, absence of actual common real roots
proves polynomial coprimality; algebraic closure is not silently invoked. -/
theorem linear_factorizations_coprime {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (r : I → ℝ) (q : J → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ z : ℝ, (∏ i : I, (X+C (r i))).eval z = 0 →
      (∏ j : J, (X+C (q j))).eval z ≠ 0) :
    IsCoprime (∏ i : I, (X+C (r i))) (∏ j : J, (X+C (q j))) := by
  classical
  apply IsCoprime.prod_left
  intro i _
  apply IsCoprime.prod_right
  intro j _
  apply coprime_linear_of_ne
  intro hij
  have hp : (∏ k : I, (X+C (r k))).eval (-r i) = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.eval_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simp
  have hq : (∏ k : J, (X+C (q k))).eval (-r i) = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.eval_prod]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j)
    simp [hij]
  exact h (-r i) hp hq

/-- Actual sibling polynomials are coprime whenever their real principal
spectra are disjoint, for positive physical internal rates. -/
theorem positive_child_characteristics_coprime {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (c d : RootChild t)
    (h : ∀ z : ℝ, (childCharacteristic t x c).eval z = 0 →
      (childCharacteristic t x d).eval z ≠ 0) :
    IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t x c) (childCharacteristic t x d) := by
  have hc := positive_child_rates t x c ha hf
  have hd := positive_child_rates t x d ha hf
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hP⟩ := physical_characteristic_negative_real_factorization
    (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hQ⟩ := physical_characteristic_negative_real_factorization
    (childTree t d) (childRates t d x) hd.1 hd.2.1 hd.2.2
  change IsCoprime (physicalCharacteristic _ _) (physicalCharacteristic _ _)
  rw [hP,hQ]
  apply linear_factorizations_coprime
  intro z hp hq
  apply h z
  · change (physicalCharacteristic _ _).eval z = 0
    rwa [hP]
  · change (physicalCharacteristic _ _).eval z = 0
    rwa [hQ]

end HydrologyTree

sibling principal blocks, not arbitrary recursively postulated polynomials. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℝ K]

/-- A spectral collision between two distinct sibling blocks at some vertex.
All descendants are the actual rate-preserving principal child models. -/
def SiblingCollisionSomewhere {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (z : K) : Prop :=
  SiblingCollisionAtRoot t x z ∨
    ∃ c : RootChild t, SiblingCollisionSomewhere (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) z
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

/-- Complete classification of common zeros of the actual root cofactor and
characteristic polynomial, for every finite tree and every field extension.
Internal rates need only be nonzero; positivity and root-leak nonzero are unnecessary. -/
theorem physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (z : K) :
    PhysicalCommonRoot t x z ↔ SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [physicalCommonRoot_local_iff t x hx, SiblingCollisionSomewhere]
    apply or_congr Iff.rfl
    apply exists_congr
    intro c
    exact ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c)
      (childRates t c x) (nonzero_child_edges t c x hx)

/-- Absence of every sibling collision rules out all cancellations at that value. -/
theorem no_common_root_of_no_sibling_collision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (z : K) (hz : ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z) :
    ¬PhysicalCommonRoot t x z := by
  exact mt (physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision t x hx z).mp hz

/-- Every detected sibling collision actually cancels the original root response:
both original, unreduced polynomials vanish. -/
theorem sibling_collision_gives_common_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) (z : K) (hz : SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z) :
    Polynomial.aeval z (physicalRootCofactor t x) = 0 ∧
      Polynomial.aeval z (physicalCharacteristic t x) = 0 := by
  exact (physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision t x hx z).mpr hz

end HydrologyTree

open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- No pole cancellation in the actual unreduced physical polynomials. -/
def NoRealPhysicalCancellation {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  ∀ z : ℝ, (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval z = 0 →
    (physicalRootCofactor t x).eval z ≠ 0

lemma physicalCommonRoot_real {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (z : ℝ) :
    PhysicalCommonRoot t x z ↔
      (physicalRootCofactor t x).eval z = 0 ∧ (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval z = 0 := by
  simp [PhysicalCommonRoot, Polynomial.aeval_def]

/-- The common-root theorem now gives a noncancellation statement on actual
real principal spectra, without any assumed stability or minimality bridge. -/
theorem noCancellation_iff_noSiblingCollision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) :
    NoRealPhysicalCancellation t x ↔ ∀ z : ℝ, ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  constructor
  · intro h z hz
    have hh := (physicalCommonRoot_real t x z).mp
      ((physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision t x hx z).mpr hz)
    exact h z hh.2 hh.1

    apply h z
    apply (physicalCommonRoot_iff_siblingCollision t x hx z).mp
    exact (physicalCommonRoot_real t x z).mpr ⟨hf,hp⟩

/-- The exact full-size Stieltjes class: all n+1 distinct poles have strictly
positive weights; BOTH unreduced polynomials must equal the displayed formulas. -/
def FullPositiveModes {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  ∃ r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < r i) ∧ Function.Injective r ∧
    (∀ i, 0 < w i) ∧ (∑ i, w i)=1 ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = stieltjesDenominator r ∧
      physicalRootCofactor t x = stieltjesNumerator r w

/-- Positive physical parameters plus noncancellation give the full simple
positive-mode class, rather than assuming simple poles or positive residues. -/
theorem fullPositiveModes_of_noncancellation {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (h : NoRealPhysicalCancellation t x) : FullPositiveModes t x := by
  obtain ⟨r,w,hr,hw,hm,hP,hF⟩ := physical_stieltjes_polynomials t x hell ha hf
  have hnc : ∀ z : ℝ, (stieltjesDenominator r).eval z = 0 →
      (stieltjesNumerator r w).eval z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [← hP] at hz
    rw [← hF]
    exact h z hz
  obtain ⟨hinj,hwn⟩ := stieltjes_noncancellation_forces_modes r w hnc
  exact ⟨r,w,hr,hinj,fun i => lt_of_le_of_ne (hw i) (Ne.symm (hwn i)),hm,hP,hF⟩

/-- Full-size positive modes rule out actual common roots, with no regularity
assumption on a coefficient Jacobian. -/
theorem fullPositiveModes_noncancellation {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (h : FullPositiveModes t x) : NoRealPhysicalCancellation t x := by
  obtain ⟨r,w,hr,hinj,hw,hm,hP,hF⟩ := h
  intro z hz
  rw [hP] at hz
  rw [hF]
  exact stieltjes_modes_force_noncancellation r w hinj (fun i => ne_of_gt (hw i)) z hz

/-- Complete all-size positive-mode/collision equivalence for the ACTUAL tree.
Repeated poles or invisible modes occur precisely when a sibling spectral
collision occurs somewhere in the original tree. -/
theorem physical_full_modes_iff_no_sibling_collisions {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    FullPositiveModes t x ↔ ∀ z : ℝ, ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  have hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x := ⟨fun i => ne_of_gt (ha i), fun i => ne_of_gt (hf i)⟩
  rw [← noCancellation_iff_noSiblingCollision t x hx]
  exact ⟨fullPositiveModes_noncancellation t x,
    fullPositiveModes_of_noncancellation t x hell ha hf⟩

end HydrologyTree

/-! Global uniqueness per prescribed subtree-denominator assignment for actual
positive-rate trees without spectral cancellations. Assignment existence and
complete assignment/fiber enumeration are NOT supplied as hypotheses or claimed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Positivity and the actual no-collision criterion prove the recursively
coprime denominators needed by exact constructive branch recovery. -/
theorem coprime_branches_of_no_spectral_collision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (hno : ∀ z : ℝ, ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z) : CoprimeAtEveryBranch t x := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [CoprimeAtEveryBranch]
    constructor
    · intro c d hcd
      apply positive_child_characteristics_coprime t x ha hf c d
      intro z hc hd
      apply hno z
      rw [SiblingCollisionSomewhere]
      left
      refine ⟨c,d,hcd,?_,?_⟩
      · simpa [Polynomial.aeval_def] using hc
      · simpa [Polynomial.aeval_def] using hd
    · intro c
      have hc := positive_child_rates t x c ha hf
      apply ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c)
        (childRates t c x) hc.2.1 hc.2.2
      intro z hz
      apply hno z
      rw [SiblingCollisionSomewhere]
      exact Or.inr ⟨c,hz⟩

/-- At most one real realization corresponds to a prescribed recursive
characteristic-factor assignment of a positive noncancelling reference tree.
All child-rate recoveries and the final original-rate permutation are proved. -/
theorem positive_subtree_assignment_unique {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (hno : ∀ z : ℝ, ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z)
    (hassign : SameSubtreeCharacteristics t x y) : x = y := by
  exact physical_subtree_assignment_unique t x y
    ⟨fun e => ne_of_gt (ha e), fun e => ne_of_gt (hf e)⟩
    (coprime_branches_of_no_spectral_collision t x ha hf hno) hassign

/-- The complete positive-mode hypothesis can be used instead of a no-collision
hypothesis; the actual equivalence was proved from physical energy and spectra. -/
theorem full_modes_subtree_assignment_unique {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (hell : 0 < x.1 0) (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e)
    (hm : FullPositiveModes t x) (hassign : SameSubtreeCharacteristics t x y) : x = y := by
  exact positive_subtree_assignment_unique t x y ha hf
    ((physical_full_modes_iff_no_sibling_collisions t x hell ha hf).mp hm) hassign

end HydrologyTree

/-! Unconditional existence of a strictly positive conservative realization on
EVERY original finite rooted tree for every full positive Stieltjes response.
The recursive construction uses actual child states and actual matrix recursions;
no realization theorem or local-inverse assertion is assumed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Every normalized positive full Stieltjes pair is realized by the ACTUAL
physical matrix on any prescribed rooted tree of the corresponding size. -/
theorem positive_tree_stieltjes_realization_exists {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    ∃ x : TreeRates n, PositiveRateVector x ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = stieltjesDenominator r ∧
      physicalRootCofactor t x = stieltjesNumerator r w := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    obtain ⟨b,g,d,hb,hbpos,hg,hF,hP,hleak⟩ :=
      exists_positive_reciprocal_data_unordered r w hr hpos hw hm
    let e := numberedEdgeEquiv t
    let br (c : RootChild t) (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) := b (e ⟨c,i⟩)
    let mass (c : RootChild t) := ∑ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1), g (e ⟨c,i⟩)
    have hmass (c : RootChild t) : 0 < mass c :=
      Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hg _) Finset.univ_nonempty
    let bw (c : RootChild t) (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) := g (e ⟨c,i⟩)/mass c
    have hc (c : RootChild t) : ∃ y : TreeRates (childEdgeCount t c), PositiveRateVector y ∧
        physicalCharacteristic (childTree t c) y = stieltjesDenominator (br c) ∧
        physicalRootCofactor (childTree t c) y = stieltjesNumerator (br c) (bw c) := by
      have hir : Function.Injective (br c) := by
        intro i j hij
        have hh := e.injective (hb.injective hij)
        exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun v : NumberedChildNodes t => v.2.val) hh)
      have hwr : ∀ i, 0 < bw c i := fun i => div_pos (hg _) (hmass c)
      have hmr : (∑ i, bw c i)=1 := by
        dsimp only [bw]
        rw [← Finset.sum_div]
        exact div_self (ne_of_gt (hmass c))
      exact ih _ (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c) (br c) (bw c) hir
        (fun i => hbpos _) hwr hmr
    choose y hy hPy hFy using hc
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hFx,hPx,_⟩ := assemble_positive_stieltjes_children t e b g d hbpos hg hleak
      y hy hPy hFy
    exact ⟨x,hx,hPx.trans hP.symm,hFx.trans hF.symm⟩

/-- Every such response has an actual strictly positive physical realization
with exactly the requested root-resolvent function off its original poles. -/
theorem positive_tree_response_realization_exists {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    ∃ x : TreeRates n, PositiveRateVector x ∧
      (∀ s : ℝ, (∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0) → physicalRootResponse t x s = ∑ i, w i/(s+r i)) ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = stieltjesDenominator r ∧
      physicalRootCofactor t x = stieltjesNumerator r w := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hP,hF⟩ := positive_tree_stieltjes_realization_exists t r w hr hpos hw hm
  refine ⟨x,hx,?_,hP,hF⟩
  intro s hs
  rw [physicalRootResponse_eq,hP,hF]
  exact stieltjes_quotient_eq_sum r w s hs

/-- Two different prescribed tree topologies of the same size can realize the
same full positive response. This is exact, not a finite sampled comparison. -/
theorem any_two_trees_share_positive_stieltjes_response {n : ℕ} (t u : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    ∃ (x y : TreeRates n), PositiveRateVector x ∧ PositiveRateVector y ∧
      physicalCharacteristic t x = physicalCharacteristic u y ∧
      physicalRootCofactor t x = physicalRootCofactor u y ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, physicalRootResponse t x s = physicalRootResponse u y s := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hPx,hFx⟩ := positive_tree_stieltjes_realization_exists t r w hr hpos hw hm
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hPy,hFy⟩ := positive_tree_stieltjes_realization_exists u r w hr hpos hw hm
  refine ⟨x,y,hx,hy,hPx.trans hPy.symm,hFx.trans hFy.symm,?_⟩
  intro s
  rw [physicalRootResponse_eq,physicalRootResponse_eq,hPx,hPy,hFx,hFy]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Every actual positive model with a prescribed simple root cofactor has a
unique labelled allocation of its reciprocal poles to the actual child blocks.
This is an exhaustive extraction theorem, not just a construction of examples. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev TreePoleAllocation {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :=
  SizedAllocation (fun c : RootChild t => childEdgeCount t c+1) n

/-- All actual positive child blocks inherit strict positivity, including their
root exit-to-parent leak, in the full physical-rate convention. -/
lemma positive_child_vector {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : PositiveRateVector x) (c : RootChild t) : PositiveRateVector (childRates t c x) := by
  have h := positive_child_rates t x c (fun e => hx.1 e.succ) hx.2
  constructor
  · intro v
    refine Fin.cases h.1 (fun e => h.2.1 e) v
  · exact h.2.2

/-- Exhaustive allocation extraction from the actual principal characteristic
polynomials. Only the reference pole list is assumed simple. -/
theorem positive_child_allocation_exists {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : PositiveRateVector x) (b : Fin n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b)
    (hF : physicalRootCofactor t x = stieltjesDenominator b) :
    ∃ a : TreePoleAllocation t, ∀ c,
      childCharacteristic t x c = allocatedDenominator b a c := by
  have hc (c : RootChild t) : ∃ q : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1) → ℝ,
      (∀ i, 0 < q i) ∧ childCharacteristic t x c = stieltjesDenominator q := by
    have h := positive_child_rates t x c (fun e => hx.1 e.succ) hx.2
    exact physical_characteristic_negative_real_factorization (childTree t c)
      (childRates t c x) h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2
  choose q hq hP using hc
  let r : NumberedChildNodes t → ℝ := fun v => q v.1 v.2
  have heq : stieltjesDenominator r = stieltjesDenominator b := by
    rw [stieltjesDenominator_sigma]
    calc
      (∏ c : RootChild t, stieltjesDenominator (q c)) =
          ∏ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c := by
            exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun c _ => (hP c).symm)
      _ = physicalRootCofactor t x := (physicalRootCofactor_child_product t x).symm
      _ = stieltjesDenominator b := hF
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := stieltjes_factor_matching (numberedEdgeEquiv t) r b hb heq
  refine ⟨allocationOfEquiv e,?_⟩
  intro c
  rw [hP c,allocatedDenominator_of_equiv]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact he ⟨c,i⟩

/-- The allocation is genuinely unique for a fixed actual parent model. -/
theorem positive_child_allocation_unique {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (b : Fin n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) (a d : TreePoleAllocation t)
    (ha : ∀ c, childCharacteristic t x c=allocatedDenominator b a c)
    (hd : ∀ c, childCharacteristic t x c=allocatedDenominator b d c) : a=d := by
  apply allocatedDenominators_injective b hb
  funext c
  exact (ha c).symm.trans (hd c)

/-- Distinct root allocations have disjoint actual positive parameter fibers. -/
theorem allocated_child_factors_coprime {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (b : Fin n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) (a : TreePoleAllocation t)
    (c d : RootChild t) (hcd : c ≠ d) :
    IsCoprime (allocatedDenominator b a c) (allocatedDenominator b a d) := by
  change IsCoprime
    (∏ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1), (X+C (allocatedRates b a c i)))
    (∏ j : Fin (childEdgeCount t d+1), (X+C (allocatedRates b a d j)))
  apply IsCoprime.prod_left
  intro i _
  apply IsCoprime.prod_right
  intro j _
  apply coprime_linear_of_ne
  intro hrate
  have he := (allocationEquiv a).injective (hb hrate)
  exact hcd (congrArg Sigma.fst he)

end HydrologyTree

/-! Purely algebraic child-factor extraction for arbitrary REAL rate vectors.
No positivity of the competing model is assumed: its monic child factors divide
the prescribed split simple root cofactor and therefore split over the reals. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma monic_split_fin_factorization {k : ℕ} (p : ℝ[X]) (hm : p.Monic)
    (hs : p.Splits) (hd : p.natDegree=k) :
    ∃ q : Fin k → ℝ, p=stieltjesDenominator q := by
  let l := p.roots.toList
  have hl : l.length=k := (Multiset.length_toList p.roots).trans (hs.natDegree_eq_card_roots.symm.trans hd)
  let e : Fin k ≃ Fin l.length := finCongr hl.symm
  let q : Fin k → ℝ := fun i => -l.get (e i)
  refine ⟨q,?_⟩
  have hprod : (l.map (fun z : ℝ => (X-C z : ℝ[X]))).prod =
      (p.roots.map (fun z : ℝ => (X-C z : ℝ[X]))).prod := by
    change ((p.roots.toList.map (fun z : ℝ => (X-C z : ℝ[X]))) : Multiset ℝ[X]).prod = _
    simp
  calc
    p = (l.map (fun z : ℝ => (X-C z : ℝ[X]))).prod :=
      (hs.eq_prod_roots_of_monic hm).trans hprod.symm
    _ = ∏ i : Fin l.length, (X-C (l.get i) : ℝ[X]) := by
      symm
      exact Fin.prod_univ_fun_getElem l (fun z : ℝ => (X-C z : ℝ[X]))
    _ = ∏ i : Fin k, (X-C (l.get (e i)) : ℝ[X]) :=
      (e.prod_comp (fun i => (X-C (l.get i) : ℝ[X]))).symm
    _ = stieltjesDenominator q := by
      simp only [stieltjesDenominator,q,map_neg,sub_eq_add_neg]

/-- Every real-rate model with the specified full simple root cofactor has a
unique actual child-pole allocation. Positivity is deliberately NOT a premise. -/
theorem real_child_allocation_exists {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (b : Fin n → ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b)
    (hF : physicalRootCofactor t x=stieltjesDenominator b) :
    ∃ a : TreePoleAllocation t, ∀ c,
      childCharacteristic t x c=allocatedDenominator b a c := by
  have hsplit : (stieltjesDenominator b).Splits :=
    Polynomial.Splits.prod (fun i _ => Polynomial.Splits.X_add_C (b i))
  have hc (c : RootChild t) : ∃ q : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1) → ℝ,
      childCharacteristic t x c=stieltjesDenominator q := by
    have hdvd : childCharacteristic t x c ∣ stieltjesDenominator b := by
      rw [← hF,physicalRootCofactor_child_product]
      exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ c)
    exact monic_split_fin_factorization (childCharacteristic t x c)
      (physicalCharacteristic_monic _ _) (hsplit.of_dvd (stieltjesDenominator_monic b).ne_zero hdvd)
      (physicalCharacteristic_natDegree _ _)
  choose q hq using hc
  let r : NumberedChildNodes t → ℝ := fun z => q z.1 z.2
  have heq : stieltjesDenominator r=stieltjesDenominator b := by
    rw [stieltjesDenominator_sigma]
    calc
      (∏ c : RootChild t, stieltjesDenominator (q c)) =
          ∏ c : RootChild t, childCharacteristic t x c :=
        Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun c _ => (hq c).symm)
      _ = physicalRootCofactor t x := (physicalRootCofactor_child_product t x).symm
      _ = stieltjesDenominator b := hF
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := stieltjes_factor_matching (numberedEdgeEquiv t) r b hb heq
  refine ⟨allocationOfEquiv e,?_⟩
  intro c
  rw [hq c,allocatedDenominator_of_equiv]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact he ⟨c,i⟩

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PositiveFiberAllocation

/-! Actual positive parameter fibers and canonical normalized child data.
Positivity concerns every original directed rate and the actual root leak. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev PositivePolynomialFiber {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (P F : ℝ[X]) :=
  {x : TreeRates n // PositiveRateVector x ∧ physicalCharacteristic t x=P ∧ physicalRootCofactor t x=F}

abbrev PositiveStieltjesFiber {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :=
  PositivePolynomialFiber t (stieltjesDenominator r) (stieltjesNumerator r w)

abbrev PositiveReciprocalFiber {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ) :=
  PositivePolynomialFiber t ((X+C d)*stieltjesDenominator b-stieltjesNumerator b g)
    (stieltjesDenominator b)

def allocatedResidueMass {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (g : Fin n → ℝ)
    (a : TreePoleAllocation t) (c : RootChild t) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1), g (allocationEquiv a ⟨c,i⟩)

def allocatedWeights {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (g : Fin n → ℝ)
    (a : TreePoleAllocation t) (c : RootChild t) : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1) → ℝ :=
  fun i => g (allocationEquiv a ⟨c,i⟩)/allocatedResidueMass t g a c

abbrev AllocatedChildFibers {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ)
    (a : TreePoleAllocation t) :=
  (c : RootChild t) → PositiveStieltjesFiber (childTree t c)
    (allocatedRates b a c) (allocatedWeights t g a c)

lemma allocatedRates_injective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (a : TreePoleAllocation t) (c : RootChild t) :
    Function.Injective (allocatedRates b a c) := by
  intro i j hij
  have h := (allocationEquiv a).injective (hb hij)
  exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun z : NumberedChildNodes t => z.2.val) h)

lemma allocatedResidueMass_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (g : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i) (a : TreePoleAllocation t) (c : RootChild t) :
    0 < allocatedResidueMass t g a c :=
  Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hg _) Finset.univ_nonempty

lemma allocatedWeights_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (g : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i) (a : TreePoleAllocation t) (c : RootChild t) :
    ∀ i, 0 < allocatedWeights t g a c i :=
  fun i => div_pos (hg _) (allocatedResidueMass_pos t g hg a c)

lemma allocatedWeights_sum {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (g : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i) (a : TreePoleAllocation t) (c : RootChild t) :
    (∑ i, allocatedWeights t g a c i)=1 := by
  simp only [allocatedWeights]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self (ne_of_gt (allocatedResidueMass_pos t g hg a c))

/-- Every prescribed labelled allocation has genuine positive child models;
this uses the already proved all-tree existence theorem without a new hypothesis. -/
theorem allocatedChildFibers_nonempty {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i)
    (a : TreePoleAllocation t) : Nonempty (AllocatedChildFibers t b g a) := by
  have hc (c : RootChild t) : Nonempty (PositiveStieltjesFiber (childTree t c)
      (allocatedRates b a c) (allocatedWeights t g a c)) := by
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hP,hF⟩ := positive_tree_stieltjes_realization_exists (childTree t c)
      (allocatedRates b a c) (allocatedWeights t g a c)
      (allocatedRates_injective t b hb a c) (fun i => hpos _)
      (allocatedWeights_pos t g hg a c) (allocatedWeights_sum t g hg a c)
    exact ⟨⟨y,hy,hP,hF⟩⟩
  exact ⟨fun c => Classical.choice (hc c)⟩

/-- Each admissible allocation and each tuple of actual positive child models
assemble to a genuine positive parent model with exact prescribed polynomials. -/
theorem allocatedChildren_assemble {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i) (hl : 0 < d-∑ i, g i/b i)
    (a : TreePoleAllocation t) (y : AllocatedChildFibers t b g a) :
    ∃ x : PositiveReciprocalFiber t b g d, ∀ c, childRates t c x.val=(y c).val := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hF,hP,hchild⟩ := assemble_positive_stieltjes_children t (allocationEquiv a)
    b g d hpos hg hl (fun c => (y c).val) (fun c => (y c).property.1)
    (fun c => (y c).property.2.1) (fun c => (y c).property.2.2)
  exact ⟨⟨x,hx,hP,hF⟩,hchild⟩

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PositiveFiberTypes

/-! Reverse reconstruction of every positive fiber point. A constructed
reference is used only with the proved exact branch-recovery theorem; no
existence or inverse premise is left in the final statement. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- For an actual parent with known child factor assignment, its true child
cofactors must be the normalized residue polynomials for that assignment. -/
theorem positiveFiber_children_membership {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ)
    (d : ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i)
    (hl : 0 < d-∑ i, g i/b i) (x : PositiveReciprocalFiber t b g d)
    (a : TreePoleAllocation t)
    (ha : ∀ c, childCharacteristic t x.val c = allocatedDenominator b a c) :
    ∀ c, physicalRootCofactor (childTree t c) (childRates t c x.val) =
      stieltjesNumerator (allocatedRates b a c) (allocatedWeights t g a c) := by
  let y := Classical.choice (allocatedChildFibers_nonempty t b g hb hpos hg a)
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := allocatedChildren_assemble t b g d hpos hg hl a y
  have hzc (c : RootChild t) : childCharacteristic t z.val c = allocatedDenominator b a c := by
    change physicalCharacteristic (childTree t c) (childRates t c z.val) = _
    rw [hz]
    exact (y c).property.2.1
  have hcop : ∀ c k : RootChild t, c ≠ k →
      IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t x.val c) (childCharacteristic t x.val k) := by
    intro c k hck
    rw [ha c,ha k]
    exact allocated_child_factors_coprime t b hb a c k hck
  have hcoef := physical_child_coefficients_identified t x.val z.val
    ⟨fun e => ne_of_gt (x.property.1.1 e.succ),fun e => ne_of_gt (x.property.1.2 e)⟩
    hcop (fun c => (ha c).trans (hzc c).symm) (x.property.2.1.trans z.property.2.1.symm)
  intro c
  change childCofactor t x.val c = _
  rw [(hcoef c).1]
  change physicalRootCofactor (childTree t c) (childRates t c z.val) = _
  rw [hz]
  exact (y c).property.2.2

/-- Equal actual child rate vectors and full parent coefficient data determine
the complete parent rate vector, including all original outward connectors. -/
theorem positive_parent_unique_from_children {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (hx : PositiveRateVector x)
    (hcop : ∀ c k : RootChild t, c ≠ k →
      IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t x c) (childCharacteristic t x k))
    (hP : physicalCharacteristic t x=physicalCharacteristic t y)
    (hF : physicalRootCofactor t x=physicalRootCofactor t y)
    (hchild : ∀ c, childRates t c x=childRates t c y) : x=y := by
  have hn : NonzeroTreeEdges x :=
    ⟨fun e => ne_of_gt (hx.1 e.succ),fun e => ne_of_gt (hx.2 e)⟩
  have hpc : ∀ c, childCharacteristic t x c=childCharacteristic t y c := by
    intro c
    change physicalCharacteristic _ (childRates t c x) = physicalCharacteristic _ (childRates t c y)
    rw [hchild]
  have hconn := physical_child_data_and_connectors_identified t x y hn hcop hpc hP
  have hroot := physical_root_leak_identified t x y hn.1
    ((physicalCoefficientMap_eq_iff t x y).mpr ⟨hP,hF⟩)
  apply (ratePartitionEquiv t).injective
  apply Prod.ext hroot
  funext c
  rw [ratePartition_child,ratePartition_child]
  exact Prod.ext (hconn c).2 (hchild c)

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PositiveFiberRecovery

/-! The exhaustive one-level bijection between ACTUAL positive parameter fibers
and labelled pole allocations with actual positive child-fiber points. It is
proved both injective and surjective; no allocation-completeness premise remains. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev AllocatedFiberData {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ) :=
  Σ a : TreePoleAllocation t, AllocatedChildFibers t b g a

def allocatedParent {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i) (hl : 0 < d-∑ i, g i/b i)
    (z : AllocatedFiberData t b g) : PositiveReciprocalFiber t b g d :=
  Classical.choose (allocatedChildren_assemble t b g d hpos hg hl z.1 z.2)

lemma allocatedParent_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i) (hl : 0 < d-∑ i, g i/b i)
    (z : AllocatedFiberData t b g) (c : RootChild t) :
    childRates t c (allocatedParent t b g d hpos hg hl z).val = (z.2 c).val :=
  Classical.choose_spec (allocatedChildren_assemble t b g d hpos hg hl z.1 z.2) c

lemma allocatedParent_child_characteristic {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i) (hl : 0 < d-∑ i, g i/b i)
    (z : AllocatedFiberData t b g) (c : RootChild t) :
    childCharacteristic t (allocatedParent t b g d hpos hg hl z).val c =
      allocatedDenominator b z.1 c := by
  change physicalCharacteristic (childTree t c)
    (childRates t c (allocatedParent t b g d hpos hg hl z).val) = _
  rw [allocatedParent_child]
  exact (z.2 c).property.2.1

/-- No two distinct labelled allocations or child-fiber tuples produce the
same original physical parent rate vector. -/
theorem allocatedParent_injective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i)
    (hl : 0 < d-∑ i, g i/b i) : Function.Injective (allocatedParent t b g d hpos hg hl) := by
  rintro ⟨a,u⟩ ⟨k,v⟩ h
  have hak : a=k := by
    apply allocatedDenominators_injective b hb
    funext c
    have he := congrArg (fun z : PositiveReciprocalFiber t b g d => childCharacteristic t z.val c) h
    simpa only [allocatedParent_child_characteristic] using he
  subst k
  have huv : u=v := by
    funext c
    apply Subtype.ext
    have he := congrArg (fun z : PositiveReciprocalFiber t b g d => childRates t c z.val) h
    simpa only [allocatedParent_child] using he
  subst v
  rfl

/-- EVERY original positive parent rate vector is obtained. The proof extracts
its unique root allocation and proves that its true child rates have the required
normalized reciprocal data before reconstructing the parent. -/
theorem allocatedParent_surjective {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i)
    (hl : 0 < d-∑ i, g i/b i) : Function.Surjective (allocatedParent t b g d hpos hg hl) := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := positive_child_allocation_exists t x.val x.property.1 b hb x.property.2.2
  have hF := positiveFiber_children_membership t b g d hb hpos hg hl x a ha
  let y : AllocatedChildFibers t b g a := fun c =>
    ⟨childRates t c x.val,positive_child_vector t x.val x.property.1 c,ha c,hF c⟩
  let z := allocatedParent t b g d hpos hg hl ⟨a,y⟩
  refine ⟨⟨a,y⟩,?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change z.val=x.val
  symm
  apply positive_parent_unique_from_children t x.val z.val x.property.1
  · intro c k hck
    rw [ha c,ha k]
    exact allocated_child_factors_coprime t b hb a c k hck
  · exact x.property.2.1.trans z.property.2.1.symm
  · exact x.property.2.2.trans z.property.2.2.symm
  · intro c
    exact (allocatedParent_child t b g d hpos hg hl ⟨a,y⟩ c).symm

/-- Exhaustive actual-fiber classification at one root. Applying it recursively
is a genuine classification of all positive rates, not a count of candidate
factorizations or an unproved identification between those two sets. -/
def positiveReciprocalFiberEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (b g : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ)
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i)
    (hl : 0 < d-∑ i, g i/b i) :
    PositiveReciprocalFiber t b g d ≃ AllocatedFiberData t b g :=
  (Equiv.ofBijective (allocatedParent t b g d hpos hg hl)
    ⟨allocatedParent_injective t b g d hb hpos hg hl,
      allocatedParent_surjective t b g d hb hpos hg hl⟩).symm

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.RealFactorAllocation
import HydrologyTree.PositiveFiberEquivalence

/-! Automatic strict positivity of every REAL realization of a full positive
Stieltjes response on a fixed labelled tree. Physical admissibility is derived
from the response, not imposed on competing parameters. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Arbitrary real child rates inherit the exact normalized Stieltjes cofactors
once their actual characteristic-factor allocation has been identified. -/
theorem realFiber_child_cofactors {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (b g : Fin n → ℝ) (d : ℝ) (hb : Function.Injective b)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (hg : ∀ i, 0 < g i) (hl : 0 < d-∑ i, g i/b i)
    (hP : physicalCharacteristic t x=(X+C d)*stieltjesDenominator b-stieltjesNumerator b g)
    (a : TreePoleAllocation t)
    (ha : ∀ c, childCharacteristic t x c=allocatedDenominator b a c) :
    ∀ c, childCofactor t x c=stieltjesNumerator (allocatedRates b a c) (allocatedWeights t g a c) := by
  let y := Classical.choice (allocatedChildFibers_nonempty t b g hb hpos hg a)
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := allocatedChildren_assemble t b g d hpos hg hl a y
  have hzc (c : RootChild t) : childCharacteristic t z.val c=allocatedDenominator b a c := by
    change physicalCharacteristic (childTree t c) (childRates t c z.val) = _
    rw [hz]
    exact (y c).property.2.1
  have hcop : ∀ c k : RootChild t, c ≠ k →
      IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t z.val c) (childCharacteristic t z.val k) := by
    intro c k hck
    rw [hzc c,hzc k]
    exact allocated_child_factors_coprime t b hb a c k hck
  have hh := physical_child_coefficients_identified t z.val x
    ⟨fun e => ne_of_gt (z.property.1.1 e.succ),fun e => ne_of_gt (z.property.1.2 e)⟩
    hcop (fun c => (hzc c).trans (ha c).symm) (z.property.2.1.trans hP.symm)
  intro c
  rw [← (hh c).1]
  change physicalRootCofactor (childTree t c) (childRates t c z.val) = _
  rw [hz]
  exact (y c).property.2.2

/-- Every real parameter vector realizing the full positive Stieltjes pair is
strictly positive, including its root leak and every directed edge rate. No
positivity, nonzero-edge or Jacobian-regularity premise is placed on x. -/
theorem real_stieltjes_realization_is_positive {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1)
    (hP : physicalCharacteristic t x=stieltjesDenominator r)
    (hF : physicalRootCofactor t x=stieltjesNumerator r w) : PositiveRateVector x := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    obtain ⟨b,g,d,hb,hbpos,hg,hFb,hPb,hl⟩ :=
      exists_positive_reciprocal_data_unordered r w hr hpos hw hm
    have hFx := hF.trans hFb
    have hPx := hP.trans hPb
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := real_child_allocation_exists t x b hb.injective hFx
    have hFc := realFiber_child_cofactors t x b g d hb.injective hbpos hg hl hPx a ha
    have hchild (c : RootChild t) : PositiveRateVector (childRates t c x) :=
      ih _ (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)
        (allocatedRates b a c) (allocatedWeights t g a c)
        (allocatedRates_injective t b hb.injective a c) (fun i => hbpos _)
        (allocatedWeights_pos t g hg a c) (allocatedWeights_sum t g hg a c)
        (ha c) (hFc c)
    let y : AllocatedChildFibers t b g a := fun c => ⟨childRates t c x,hchild c,ha c,hFc c⟩
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := allocatedChildren_assemble t b g d hbpos hg hl a y
    have hzc (c : RootChild t) : childCharacteristic t z.val c=allocatedDenominator b a c := by
      change physicalCharacteristic (childTree t c) (childRates t c z.val) = _
      rw [hz]
      exact ha c
    have hzx : z.val=x := by
      apply positive_parent_unique_from_children t z.val x z.property.1
      · intro c k hck
        rw [hzc c,hzc k]
        exact allocated_child_factors_coprime t b hb.injective a c k hck
      · exact z.property.2.1.trans hPx.symm
      · exact z.property.2.2.trans hFx.symm
      · exact hz
    exact hzx ▸ z.property.1

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian

/-! Actual polynomial coefficient gluing and its actual Frechet derivative. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev PolyPair (m n : ℕ) := Coeff m × Coeff n
abbrev GlueInput (m n : ℕ) := PolyPair m n × PolyPair m n

def pairBasis (m n : ℕ) : Module.Basis (Fin (m+n)) ℝ (PolyPair m n) :=
  ((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)).reindex finSumFinEquiv

lemma coeff_natDegree_le {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : (p : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ n := by
  simpa using bounded_natDegree (liftCLM n p)

def sylvCLM {m n : ℕ} (f g : ℝ[X]) (hf : f.natDegree ≤ m) (hg : g.natDegree ≤ n) :
    PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] Coeff (m+n) :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (sylvesterMap f g hf hg)

@[simp] theorem sylvCLM_cut {m n : ℕ} (f g : ℝ[X])
    (hf : f.natDegree ≤ m) (hg : g.natDegree ≤ n) (x : PolyPair m n) :
    sylvCLM f g hf hg x = cut (m+n) (f * (x.2 : ℝ[X]) + g * (x.1 : ℝ[X])) := by
  exact (cut_coe (sylvesterMap f g hf hg x)).symm

def monoSylv {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] Coeff (m+n) :=
  sylvCLM (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2)
    (bounded_natDegree _) (bounded_natDegree _)

def lowSylv {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] Coeff (m+n) :=
  sylvCLM x.1 x.2 (coeff_natDegree_le _) (coeff_natDegree_le _)

/-- The non-leading coefficients of `U*V`, and all coefficients of `R*V+U*S`.
Here U and V are actual monic polynomials with the supplied low coefficients;
R and S have arbitrary coefficients of degrees below m and n. -/
def glue {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) : Coeff (m+n) × Coeff (m+n) :=
  (mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n) (monicPoly x.1.1) (monicPoly x.1.2),
   mulCLM m (n+1) (m+n) x.2.1 (monicPoly x.1.2) +
     mulCLM (m+1) n (m+n) (monicPoly x.1.1) x.2.2)

/-- The complete derivative, including the off-diagonal numerator terms. -/
def glueDerivative {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) :
    GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] (Coeff (m+n) × Coeff (m+n)) :=
  repeatedBlock (monoSylv x.1) (lowSylv x.2)

set_option maxHeartbeats 600000 in
theorem hasFDerivAt_glue {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) :
    HasFDerivAt glue (glueDerivative x) x := by
  let A : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff m :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  let B : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  let R : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff m :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  let S : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  have ha := (hasFDerivAt_monicPoly (A x)).comp x A.hasFDerivAt
  have hb := (hasFDerivAt_monicPoly (B x)).comp x B.hasFDerivAt
  have hp := ((mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n)).hasFDerivAt.comp x ha).clm_apply hb
  have hr := ((mulCLM m (n+1) (m+n)).hasFDerivAt.comp x R.hasFDerivAt).clm_apply hb
  have hs := ((mulCLM (m+1) n (m+n)).hasFDerivAt.comp x ha).clm_apply S.hasFDerivAt
  apply (hp.prodMk (hr.add hs)).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  all_goals
    simp only [glueDerivative, repeatedBlock_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply,
      Function.comp_apply, A, B, R, S,
      monoSylv, lowSylv, sylvCLM_cut,
      mulCLM_apply, coe_lift]
  · change cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X])) +
        cut (m+n) ((h.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X])) =
      cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X]) +
        (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.1 : ℝ[X]))
    rw [map_add, mul_comm (h.1.1 : ℝ[X])]
  · change (cut (m+n) ((x.2.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X])) +
        cut (m+n) ((h.2.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X]))) +
      (cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.2.2 : ℝ[X])) +
        cut (m+n) ((h.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (x.2.2 : ℝ[X]))) =
      cut (m+n) ((x.2.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X]) +
        (x.2.2 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.1 : ℝ[X])) +
      cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.2.2 : ℝ[X]) +
        (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X]) * (h.2.1 : ℝ[X]))
    simp only [map_add]
    rw [mul_comm (h.2.1 : ℝ[X]), mul_comm (h.1.1 : ℝ[X])]
    abel

/-- The Jacobian of the actual real coefficient map, in specified coefficient bases. -/
def gluingJacobian {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((pairBasis m n).prod (pairBasis m n))
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n)).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n)))
    (fderiv ℝ glue x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The two-polynomial gluing formula for every degree, every numerator and
all coefficients. Common roots and zero resultant are included. -/
theorem gluingJacobian_eq_resultant_sq {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) :
    gluingJacobian x =
      Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1.1) (monicPoly x.1.2) m n ^ 2 := by
  rw [gluingJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_glue x).fderiv]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _ (repeatedBlock _ _).toLinearMap).det = _
  rw [det_repeatedBlock]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
    (sylvesterMap (monicPoly x.1.1) (monicPoly x.1.2)
      (bounded_natDegree _) (bounded_natDegree _))).det ^ 2 = _
  rw [pairBasis, Polynomial.toMatrix_sylvesterMap']
  rfl

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.Gluing
import HydrologyTree.LeadingCoefficients

/-! Multiplication of actual monic coefficient vectors. This supplies the
one-copy Sylvester derivative needed in the arbitrary-child induction. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def monicMultiply {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : Coeff (m+n) :=
  mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n) (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2)

lemma monicMultiply_eq_cut {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    monicMultiply x = cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.2 : ℝ[X])) := rfl

theorem hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    HasFDerivAt monicMultiply (monoSylv x) x := by
  let ins : PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] GlueInput m n :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (PolyPair m n)).prod 0
  have h := ((hasFDerivAt_glue (ins x)).comp x ins.hasFDerivAt).fst
  apply h.congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro z
  rfl

def monicMultiplyJacobian {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
    (fderiv ℝ monicMultiply x).toLinearMap).det

theorem monicMultiplyJacobian_eq {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    monicMultiplyJacobian x =
      Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2) m n := by
  rw [monicMultiplyJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply x).fderiv]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
    (sylvesterMap (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2)
      (bounded_natDegree _) (bounded_natDegree _))).det = _
  rw [pairBasis, Polynomial.toMatrix_sylvesterMap']
  rfl

theorem monicMultiply_reconstruct {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    (monicPoly (monicMultiply x) : ℝ[X]) =
      (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.2 : ℝ[X]) := by
  rw [monicMultiply_eq_cut]
  apply monic_reconstruct
  · exact (monic_monicPoly x.1).mul (monic_monicPoly x.2)
  · rw [Polynomial.natDegree_mul (monic_monicPoly x.1).ne_zero (monic_monicPoly x.2).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicPoly, natDegree_monicPoly]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.ProductDerivative

/-! Basis-aware determinant composition for growing coefficient families. -/
open Matrix Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Linear
variable {E₀ E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E₀] [NormedSpace ℝ E₀]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def keepLeft (L : E →L[ℝ] F) : (E₀ × E) →L[ℝ] (E₀ × F) :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E₀ E).prod (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E₀ E))

@[simp] lemma keepLeft_apply (L : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E₀ × E) :
    keepLeft L x = (x.1, L x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_keepLeft {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (b₀ : Basis ι ℝ E₀) (bE : Basis κ ℝ E)
    (bF : Basis κ ℝ F) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (b₀.prod bE) (b₀.prod bF) (keepLeft L).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) 0 0 (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, keepLeft, Matrix.one_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

lemma det_keepLeft {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (b₀ : Basis ι ℝ E₀) (bE : Basis κ ℝ E)
    (bF : Basis κ ℝ F) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (b₀.prod bE) (b₀.prod bF) (keepLeft L).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap).det := by
  rw [toMatrix_keepLeft, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]
  simp

lemma toMatrix_both_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F)
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.reindex e) (bF.reindex e) L =
      Matrix.reindex e e (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L) := by
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Matrix.reindex_apply]

lemma det_both_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F)
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.reindex e) (bF.reindex e) L).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L).det := by
  rw [toMatrix_both_reindex, Matrix.det_reindex_self]

end Linear
end HydrologyTree
