import HydrologyTree.JacobianComposition

/-! Actual multiplication of arbitrarily many monic factors and its full
Fréchet Jacobian, with every degree and coefficient value allowed. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

@[reducible] def ProductInput : List ℕ → Type
  | [] => Coeff 0
  | m :: ms => Coeff m × ProductInput ms

instance productInputNormed : (ms : List ℕ) → NormedAddCommGroup (ProductInput ms)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff 0))
  | m :: ms => by
    letI := productInputNormed ms
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff m × ProductInput ms))

instance productInputNormedSpace : (ms : List ℕ) → NormedSpace ℝ (ProductInput ms)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff 0))
  | m :: ms => by
    letI := productInputNormedSpace ms
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff m × ProductInput ms))

def familyBasis : (ms : List ℕ) → Basis (Fin ms.sum) ℝ (ProductInput ms)
  | [] => degreeLT.basis ℝ 0
  | m :: ms => ((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex finSumFinEquiv

/-- Low coefficients of the true product of all monic input polynomials. -/
def familyProduct : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → Coeff ms.sum
  | [], _ => 0
  | m :: ms, x => monicMultiply (x.1, familyProduct ms x.2)

def familyProductDerivative : (ms : List ℕ) → (x : ProductInput ms) →
    ProductInput ms →L[ℝ] Coeff ms.sum
  | [], _ => 0
  | m :: ms, x =>
    (monoSylv (x.1, familyProduct ms x.2)).comp
      (keepLeft (E₀ := Coeff m) (familyProductDerivative ms x.2))

theorem hasFDerivAt_familyProduct (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    HasFDerivAt (familyProduct ms) (familyProductDerivative ms x) x := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => exact hasFDerivAt_const (0 : Coeff 0) x
  | cons m ms ih =>
    have hfst := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).hasFDerivAt (x := x)
    have hsnd := (ih x.2).comp x
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).hasFDerivAt
    exact (hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply (x.1,familyProduct ms x.2)).comp x (hfst.prodMk hsnd)

/-- All individual factors as actual polynomials, retaining possible repetitions. -/
def familyPolynomials : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → List ℝ[X]
  | [], _ => []
  | _ :: ms, x => (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) :: familyPolynomials ms x.2

theorem familyProduct_reconstruct (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    (monicPoly (familyProduct ms x) : ℝ[X]) = (familyPolynomials ms x).prod := by
  induction ms with
  | nil =>
    change (monicPoly (0 : Coeff 0) : ℝ[X]) = 1
    simp [coe_monicPoly]
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change (monicPoly (monicMultiply (x.1,familyProduct ms x.2)) : ℝ[X]) = _
    rw [monicMultiply_reconstruct, ih]
    rfl

/-- Resultant product in recursive factor-versus-remaining-product form. -/
def familyResultant : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → ℝ
  | [], _ => 1
  | m :: ms, x =>
    Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly (familyProduct ms x.2)) m ms.sum *
      familyResultant ms x.2

lemma det_monoSylv {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
      (monoSylv x).toLinearMap).det =
        Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2) m n := by
  simpa only [monicMultiplyJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply x).fderiv] using
    monicMultiplyJacobian_eq x

theorem det_familyProductDerivative (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (familyBasis ms) (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum)
      (familyProductDerivative ms x).toLinearMap).det = familyResultant ms x := by
  induction ms with
  | nil =>
    change (LinearMap.toMatrix (degreeLT.basis ℝ 0) (degreeLT.basis ℝ 0)
      (0 : Coeff 0 →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff 0)).det = 1
    simp
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change (LinearMap.toMatrix (((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex finSumFinEquiv)
      (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+ms.sum))
      ((monoSylv (x.1,familyProduct ms x.2)).toLinearMap.comp
        (keepLeft (E₀ := Coeff m) (familyProductDerivative ms x.2)).toLinearMap)).det =
      _ * familyResultant ms x.2
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp
      (((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex finSumFinEquiv) (pairBasis m ms.sum)
      (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+ms.sum)), Matrix.det_mul, det_monoSylv]
    congr 1
    rw [pairBasis, det_both_reindex, det_keepLeft, ih]

/-- The determinant is taken from fderiv of the actual coefficient map. -/
def familyProductJacobian (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (familyBasis ms) (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum)
    (fderiv ℝ (familyProduct ms) x).toLinearMap).det

theorem familyProductJacobian_eq (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    familyProductJacobian ms x = familyResultant ms x := by
  rw [familyProductJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x).fderiv,
    det_familyProductDerivative]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/FamilyScaling.lean:
import HydrologyTree.EndJacobian
import HydrologyTree.Scaling
import HydrologyTree.FamilyProduct

/-! Actual simultaneous scaling of every child numerator, including all zero
scales. This is one component of the full branching-tree Jacobian chain. -/
open Module Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

instance productInputFiniteDimensional (ms : List ℕ) : FiniteDimensional ℝ (ProductInput ms) :=
  Module.Finite.of_basis (familyBasis ms)

section Products
variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def productEndMap (f : E → E) (g : F → F) (z : E × F) : E × F := (f z.1,g z.2)

lemma hasFDerivAt_productEndMap (f : E → E) (g : F → F) (z : E × F)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z.1) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g z.2) :
    HasFDerivAt (productEndMap f g)
      ((fderiv ℝ f z.1).prodMap (fderiv ℝ g z.2)) z := by
  exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp z (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F).hasFDerivAt).prodMk
    (hg.hasFDerivAt.comp z (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E F).hasFDerivAt)

lemma endJacobian_productEndMap [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (f : E → E) (g : F → F) (z : E × F)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z.1) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g z.2) :
    endJacobian (productEndMap f g) z = endJacobian f z.1 * endJacobian g z.2 := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_productEndMap f g z hf hg)]
  exact LinearMap.det_prodMap _ _

end Products

/-- Interpret the leading coefficient as an independent scale, and lower
coefficients as those of a monic polynomial, then carry out actual multiplication. -/
def scaleLeading (n : ℕ) (q : Coeff (n+1)) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  leadingEquiv n (scaleChart ((leadingEquiv n).symm q))

lemma scaleLeading_actual (n : ℕ) (q : Coeff (n+1)) :
    scaleLeading n q = (q : ℝ[X]).coeff n • monicPoly (cut n (q : ℝ[X])) := by
  have h := congrFun (scaleMonic_eq_comp (n := n)) ((leadingEquiv n).symm q)
  exact h.symm

lemma differentiable_scaleLeading (n : ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (scaleLeading n) := by
  intro q
  exact (leadingEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp q
    ((hasFDerivAt_scaleChart ((leadingEquiv n).symm q)).differentiableAt.comp q
      (leadingEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt)

lemma endJacobian_scaleChart (n : ℕ) (q : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    endJacobian scaleChart q = q.1 ^ n := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_scaleChart q),
    ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)),
    det_scaleChartDerivative]
  simp

/-- The actual scaling determinant is proved with no division by the scale. -/
theorem endJacobian_scaleLeading (n : ℕ) (q : Coeff (n+1)) :
    endJacobian (scaleLeading n) q = (q : ℝ[X]).coeff n ^ n := by
  have h := endJacobian_conjugate (leadingEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv
    scaleChart q (hasFDerivAt_scaleChart _).differentiableAt
  rw [endJacobian_scaleChart] at h
  exact h

/-- A child with n internal edges has a cofactor of degree n and denominator
of degree n+1. This list transformation reflects those actual dimensions. -/
abbrev ChildFactorDegrees (ms : List ℕ) := ms.map (fun n => n+1)
abbrev ScaledFamilyInput (ms : List ℕ) := ProductInput (ChildFactorDegrees ms)

def scaleFamily : (ms : List ℕ) → ScaledFamilyInput ms → ScaledFamilyInput ms
  | [], q => q
  | m :: ms, q => (scaleLeading m q.1, scaleFamily ms q.2)

def scaleFamilyWeight : (ms : List ℕ) → ScaledFamilyInput ms → ℝ
  | [], _ => 1
  | m :: ms, q => (q.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff m ^ m * scaleFamilyWeight ms q.2

lemma differentiable_scaleFamily (ms : List ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (scaleFamily ms) := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => exact differentiable_id
  | cons m ms ih =>
    intro q
    exact (hasFDerivAt_productEndMap (scaleLeading m) (scaleFamily ms) q
      (differentiable_scaleLeading m q.1) (ih q.2)).differentiableAt

/-- Exact product of all monic numerator-scaling factors at an arbitrary root. -/
theorem endJacobian_scaleFamily (ms : List ℕ) (q : ScaledFamilyInput ms) :
    endJacobian (scaleFamily ms) q = scaleFamilyWeight ms q := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => change endJacobian id q = 1; simp [endJacobian]
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change endJacobian (productEndMap (scaleLeading m) (scaleFamily ms)) q = _
    rw [endJacobian_productEndMap _ _ _ (differentiable_scaleLeading m q.1)
      (differentiable_scaleFamily ms q.2), endJacobian_scaleLeading, ih]
    rfl

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/FamilyResultants.lean:
import HydrologyTree.FamilyProduct

/-! Exact pairwise resultant expansion of the arbitrary-family product Jacobian. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- One factor for every ordered-by-position pair i<j, repetitions allowed. -/
def pairwiseResultants : List ℝ[X] → ℝ
  | [] => 1
  | p :: ps => (ps.map fun q => p.resultant q).prod * pairwiseResultants ps

lemma familyPolynomials_degree_sum (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    ((familyPolynomials ms x).map Polynomial.natDegree).sum = ms.sum := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m ms ih => simp only [familyPolynomials, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, natDegree_monicPoly, ih]

lemma familyPolynomials_monic (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    ∀ p ∈ familyPolynomials ms x, p.Monic := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => simp [familyPolynomials]
  | cons m ms ih =>
    intro p hp
    simp only [familyPolynomials, List.mem_cons] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | hp
    · exact monic_monicPoly _
    · exact ih _ p hp

lemma monic_list_prod (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hs : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Monic) : ps.prod.Monic := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => exact Polynomial.monic_one
  | cons p ps ih =>
    exact (hs p (by simp)).mul (ih (fun q hq => hs q (by simp [hq])))

lemma natDegree_monic_list_prod (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hs : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Monic) :
    ps.prod.natDegree = (ps.map Polynomial.natDegree).sum := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hp := hs p (by simp)
    have ht : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.Monic := fun q hq => hs q (by simp [hq])
    rw [List.prod_cons, Polynomial.natDegree_mul hp.ne_zero (monic_list_prod ps ht).ne_zero,
      ih ht]
    rfl

lemma resultant_list_prod (p : ℝ[X]) (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hs : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.Monic) :
    p.resultant ps.prod = (ps.map fun q => p.resultant q).prod := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp
  | cons q qs ih =>
    have hq := hs q (by simp)
    have ht : ∀ r ∈ qs, r.Monic := fun r hr => hs r (by simp [hr])
    rw [List.prod_cons,
      Polynomial.natDegree_mul hq.ne_zero (monic_list_prod qs ht).ne_zero,
      Polynomial.resultant_mul_right _ _ _ _ le_rfl, ih ht]
    rfl

/-- The recursive derivative determinant is exactly the product over all pairs. -/
theorem familyResultant_eq_pairwise (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    familyResultant ms x = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x) := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly (familyProduct ms x.2)) m ms.sum *
        familyResultant ms x.2 = _
    rw [ih]
    change _ = ((familyPolynomials ms x.2).map fun q =>
      (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]).resultant q).prod * pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x.2)
    congr 1
    have h := resultant_list_prod (monicPoly x.1) (familyPolynomials ms x.2)
      (familyPolynomials_monic ms x.2)
    rw [← familyProduct_reconstruct] at h
    simpa only [natDegree_monicPoly] using h

/-- Full all-degree, all-coefficient product-Jacobian formula in pairwise form. -/
theorem familyProductJacobian_eq_pairwise (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    familyProductJacobian ms x = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x) := by
  rw [familyProductJacobian_eq, familyResultant_eq_pairwise]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/FamilySmoothness.lean:
import HydrologyTree.FamilyProduct
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Comp
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Operations

/-! Smoothness of the actual monic factor product; differentiating its derivative
is justified rather than assumed as a hidden Hessian input. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma contDiff_monicPoly (n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (monicPoly (n := n)) :=
  contDiff_const.add (liftCLM n).contDiff

lemma contDiff_monicMultiply (m n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (monicMultiply (m := m) (n := n)) := by
  have ha := (contDiff_monicPoly m).comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).contDiff
  have hb := (contDiff_monicPoly n).comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).contDiff
  exact ((mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n)).contDiff.comp ha).clm_apply hb

/-- Every finite factor product has the differentiability needed by the tangent lift. -/
theorem contDiff_familyProduct (ms : List ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (familyProduct ms) := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => exact contDiff_const
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x : Coeff m × ProductInput ms =>
      monicMultiply (x.1, familyProduct ms x.2))
    have ha : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x : Coeff m × ProductInput ms => x.1) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).contDiff
    have hb : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x : Coeff m × ProductInput ms => familyProduct ms x.2) :=
      ih.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).contDiff
    exact (contDiff_monicMultiply m ms.sum).comp (ha.prodMk hb)

lemma familyProductDerivative_eq_fderiv (ms : List ℕ) :
    familyProductDerivative ms = fderiv ℝ (familyProduct ms) := by
  funext x
  exact (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x).fderiv.symm

/-- The derivative-valued map is itself differentiable everywhere. -/
theorem differentiable_familyProductDerivative (ms : List ℕ) :
    Differentiable ℝ (familyProductDerivative ms) := by
  rw [familyProductDerivative_eq_fderiv]
  exact ((contDiff_familyProduct ms).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable_one

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/TangentJacobian.lean:
import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Comp

/-! The Jacobian of a differentiable tangent lift has two copies of the
original Jacobian. Derivative-valued regularity is an explicit proved input
at each later application, not an unproved family Hessian assertion. -/
open Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def tangentLift (f : E → F) (L : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E) : F × F :=
  (f x.1, L x.1 x.2)

def tangentDerivative (L : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E) :
    (E × E) →L[ℝ] (F × F) :=
  repeatedBlock (L x.1) ((fderiv ℝ L x.1).flip x.2)

/-- Full tangent-lift derivative, including the second-order off-diagonal block. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_tangentLift (f : E → F) (L : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f (L x.1) x.1) (hL : DifferentiableAt ℝ L x.1) :
    HasFDerivAt (tangentLift f L) (tangentDerivative L x) x := by
  let P : (E × E) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E
  let Q : (E × E) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E E
  have h1 := hf.comp x P.hasFDerivAt
  have h2 := (hL.hasFDerivAt.comp x P.hasFDerivAt).clm_apply Q.hasFDerivAt
  apply (h1.prodMk h2).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · change L x.1 z.2 + (fderiv ℝ L x.1 z.1) x.2 =
      (fderiv ℝ L x.1 z.1) x.2 + L x.1 z.2
    exact add_comm _ _

/-- The determinant is the square without any invertibility assumption. -/
theorem tangentLift_jacobian {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F)
    (f : E → F) (L : E → E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f (L x.1) x.1) (hL : DifferentiableAt ℝ L x.1) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF)
      (fderiv ℝ (tangentLift f L) x).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF (L x.1).toLinearMap).det ^ 2 := by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_tangentLift f L x hf hL).fderiv, tangentDerivative,
    det_repeatedBlock]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/FamilyGluing.lean:
import HydrologyTree.FamilyResultants
import HydrologyTree.FamilySmoothness
import HydrologyTree.TangentJacobian

/-! The all-arity polynomial gluing theorem in actual coefficient spaces.
All derivatives, smoothness and polynomial identities are proved; there is no
coprimality, positivity or nonsingularity hypothesis. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Actual numerator sum, one numerator in place of each corresponding factor. -/
def familyNumerator : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → ProductInput ms → ℝ[X]
  | [], _, _ => 0
  | _ :: ms, p, r =>
      (r.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly (familyProduct ms p.2) : ℝ[X]) +
      (monicPoly p.1 : ℝ[X]) * familyNumerator ms p.2 r.2

lemma monoSylv_polynomial {m n : ℕ} (p r : PolyPair m n) :
    (monoSylv p r : ℝ[X]) =
      (monicPoly p.1 : ℝ[X]) * (r.2 : ℝ[X]) +
      (monicPoly p.2 : ℝ[X]) * (r.1 : ℝ[X]) := rfl

/-- The derivative applied to the numerator data is exactly the full numerator
polynomial, not merely a sampled evaluation or a truncated approximation. -/
theorem familyProductDerivative_polynomial (ms : List ℕ)
    (p r : ProductInput ms) :
    (familyProductDerivative ms p r : ℝ[X]) = familyNumerator ms p r := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change (monoSylv (p.1,familyProduct ms p.2)
      (r.1,familyProductDerivative ms p.2 r.2) : ℝ[X]) = _
    rw [monoSylv_polynomial, ih]
    dsimp only [familyNumerator]
    ring

/-- Arbitrarily many monic factors with their arbitrary strict-degree numerators. -/
def familyGlue (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) :
    Coeff ms.sum × Coeff ms.sum :=
  (familyProduct ms x.1, cut ms.sum (familyNumerator ms x.1 x.2))

lemma familyGlue_eq_tangentLift (ms : List ℕ) :
    familyGlue ms = tangentLift (familyProduct ms) (familyProductDerivative ms) := by
  funext x
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · change cut ms.sum (familyNumerator ms x.1 x.2) = familyProductDerivative ms x.1 x.2
    rw [← familyProductDerivative_polynomial, cut_coe]

/-- The full second output encodes the true numerator polynomial. -/
theorem familyGlue_numerator_exact (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) :
    ((familyGlue ms x).2 : ℝ[X]) = familyNumerator ms x.1 x.2 := by
  rw [familyGlue_eq_tangentLift]
  exact familyProductDerivative_polynomial ms x.1 x.2

theorem hasFDerivAt_familyGlue (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) :
    HasFDerivAt (familyGlue ms) (tangentDerivative (familyProductDerivative ms) x) x := by
  rw [familyGlue_eq_tangentLift]
  exact hasFDerivAt_tangentLift _ _ _ (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x.1)
    (differentiable_familyProductDerivative ms x.1)

def familyGlueJacobian (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((familyBasis ms).prod (familyBasis ms))
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum))
    (fderiv ℝ (familyGlue ms) x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The full gluing Jacobian, for every finite factor family and all coefficients,
is the square of the pairwise resultant product, including every singular case. -/
theorem familyGlueJacobian_eq_pairwise (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms × ProductInput ms) :
    familyGlueJacobian ms x = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x.1)^2 := by
  rw [familyGlueJacobian, familyGlue_eq_tangentLift,
    tangentLift_jacobian _ _ _ _ _ (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x.1)
      (differentiable_familyProductDerivative ms x.1),
    det_familyProductDerivative, familyResultant_eq_pairwise]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.FamilyScaling
import HydrologyTree.FamilyGluing
import HydrologyTree.PathPolynomial

/-! Exact common-coordinate normalization for the actual all-child gluing and
root coefficient update. Every normalization is a specified linear equivalence. -/
open Module Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Coordinates
variable {E F I : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]

lemma basis_normalized_jacobian (bE : Basis I ℝ E) (bF : Basis I ℝ F)
    (f : E → F) (x : E) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) :
    endJacobian (fun z => (bE.equiv bF (Equiv.refl I)).symm (f z)) x =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap).det := by
  let e := bE.equiv bF (Equiv.refl I)
  have h := e.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp x hf.hasFDerivAt
  calc
    _ = LinearMap.det (e.symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        (fderiv ℝ f x)).toLinearMap := endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt h
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix bE]
      congr 1
      ext i j
      simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, e, Basis.equiv]

end Coordinates

abbrev FamilyPairs (ns : List ℕ) := ProductInput ns × ProductInput ns

def familyPairEquiv (ns : List ℕ) : FamilyPairs ns ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff ns.sum × Coeff ns.sum) :=
  ((familyBasis ns).prod (familyBasis ns)).equiv
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ ns.sum).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ ns.sum)) (Equiv.refl _)

def normalizedFamilyGlue (ns : List ℕ) (z : FamilyPairs ns) : FamilyPairs ns :=
  (familyPairEquiv ns).symm (familyGlue ns z)

lemma differentiable_normalizedFamilyGlue (ns : List ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedFamilyGlue ns) := by
  intro z
  exact (familyPairEquiv ns).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp z
    (hasFDerivAt_familyGlue ns z).differentiableAt

theorem normalizedFamilyGlue_jacobian (ns : List ℕ) (z : FamilyPairs ns) :
    endJacobian (normalizedFamilyGlue ns) z = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ns z.1)^2 := by
  unfold normalizedFamilyGlue familyPairEquiv
  rw [basis_normalized_jacobian _ _ _ _
    (hasFDerivAt_familyGlue ns z).differentiableAt]
  exact familyGlueJacobian_eq_pairwise ns z

abbrev FamilyRootInputs (ns : List ℕ) := FamilyPairs ns × ℝ

def rootRegroupEquiv (N : ℕ) : ((Coeff N × Coeff N) × ℝ) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff N × (ℝ × Coeff N)) where
  toFun z := (z.1.1,(z.2,z.1.2))
  invFun z := ((z.1,z.2.2),z.2.1)
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

def familyRootEquiv (ns : List ℕ) : FamilyRootInputs ns ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff ns.sum × (ℝ × Coeff ns.sum)) :=
  ((familyPairEquiv ns).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ)).trans (rootRegroupEquiv ns.sum)

/-- Parent coefficients, reordered without changing or scaling any scalar. -/
def rootOutputEquiv (N : ℕ) : (Coeff (N+1) × Coeff N) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff N × (ℝ × Coeff N)) :=
  (LinearEquiv.prodComm ℝ (Coeff (N+1)) (Coeff N)).trans
    ((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (Coeff N)).prodCongr (leadingEquiv N).symm)

lemma rootOutputEquiv_actual (N : ℕ) (z : Coeff N × (ℝ × Coeff N)) :
    rootOutputEquiv N (cut (N+1) (rootPolynomial z),z.1) = rootCoefficientMap z := by
  change (z.1, (((cut (N+1) (rootPolynomial z) : Coeff (N+1)) : ℝ[X]).coeff N,
    cut N (cut (N+1) (rootPolynomial z) : ℝ[X]))) = _
  rw [cut_coeff (N+1) _ ⟨N,Nat.lt_succ_self N⟩, cut_cut (Nat.le_succ N)]
  rfl

def normalizedFamilyRoot (ns : List ℕ) (z : FamilyRootInputs ns) : FamilyRootInputs ns :=
  (familyRootEquiv ns).symm (rootCoefficientMap (familyRootEquiv ns z))

lemma differentiable_normalizedFamilyRoot (ns : List ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedFamilyRoot ns) := by
  intro z
  exact (familyRootEquiv ns).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp z
    ((hasFDerivAt_rootCoefficientMap (familyRootEquiv ns z)).differentiableAt.comp z
      (familyRootEquiv ns).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt)

/-- Exact root-update determinant after transport into the common family coordinates. -/
theorem normalizedFamilyRoot_jacobian (ns : List ℕ) (z : FamilyRootInputs ns) :
    endJacobian (normalizedFamilyRoot ns) z = (-1 : ℝ)^ns.sum := by
  have h := endJacobian_conjugate
    (familyRootEquiv ns).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv rootCoefficientMap z
      (hasFDerivAt_rootCoefficientMap _).differentiableAt
  have hlocal : endJacobian rootCoefficientMap (familyRootEquiv ns z) = (-1 : ℝ)^ns.sum := by
    rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_rootCoefficientMap _),
      ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix ((degreeLT.basis ℝ ns.sum).prod
        ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ ns.sum))), det_rootChartDerivative]
    simp
  exact h.trans hlocal

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/BranchStep.lean:
import HydrologyTree.FamilyNormalization

/-! Complete all-child local coefficient-Jacobian assembly: actual monic
numerator scaling, actual gluing and actual root polynomial update are composed
with their Frechet derivatives. The global physical-tree induction is separate. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev BranchStepInputs (ms : List ℕ) := FamilyRootInputs (ChildFactorDegrees ms)

def branchScaleStep (ms : List ℕ) : BranchStepInputs ms → BranchStepInputs ms :=
  keepFunction (F := ℝ) (productEndMap id (scaleFamily ms))

def branchGlueStep (ms : List ℕ) : BranchStepInputs ms → BranchStepInputs ms :=
  keepFunction (F := ℝ) (normalizedFamilyGlue (ChildFactorDegrees ms))

def normalizedBranchStep (ms : List ℕ) : BranchStepInputs ms → BranchStepInputs ms :=
  normalizedFamilyRoot (ChildFactorDegrees ms) ∘ (branchGlueStep ms ∘ branchScaleStep ms)

lemma differentiable_branchScaleStep (ms : List ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (branchScaleStep ms) := by
  intro z
  exact (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction z
    (hasFDerivAt_productEndMap id (scaleFamily ms) z.1 differentiableAt_id
      (differentiable_scaleFamily ms z.1.2)).differentiableAt).differentiableAt

lemma differentiable_branchGlueStep (ms : List ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (branchGlueStep ms) := by
  intro z
  exact (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction z (differentiable_normalizedFamilyGlue _ z.1)).differentiableAt

lemma differentiable_normalizedBranchStep (ms : List ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedBranchStep ms) :=
  (differentiable_normalizedFamilyRoot _).comp
    ((differentiable_branchGlueStep ms).comp (differentiable_branchScaleStep ms))

lemma branchScaleStep_jacobian (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) :
    endJacobian (branchScaleStep ms) z = scaleFamilyWeight ms z.1.2 := by
  rw [branchScaleStep, endJacobian_keepFunction _ _
    (hasFDerivAt_productEndMap id (scaleFamily ms) z.1 differentiableAt_id
      (differentiable_scaleFamily ms z.1.2)).differentiableAt,
    endJacobian_productEndMap _ _ _ differentiableAt_id
      (differentiable_scaleFamily ms z.1.2), endJacobian_scaleFamily]
  simp [endJacobian]

lemma branchGlueStep_jacobian (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) :
    endJacobian (branchGlueStep ms) z =
      pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1)^2 := by
  rw [branchGlueStep, endJacobian_keepFunction _ _
    (differentiable_normalizedFamilyGlue _ z.1), normalizedFamilyGlue_jacobian]

/-- All local Jacobian factors are composed, rather than merely proved in isolation.
No nonzero scale, simple root, positive rate, or nonempty-child assumption. -/
theorem normalizedBranchStep_jacobian (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) :
    endJacobian (normalizedBranchStep ms) z =
      (-1 : ℝ)^(ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum *
        pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1)^2 *
          scaleFamilyWeight ms z.1.2 := by
  rw [normalizedBranchStep,
    endJacobian_comp (differentiable_normalizedFamilyRoot _ _)
      ((differentiable_branchGlueStep ms _).comp z (differentiable_branchScaleStep ms z)),
    endJacobian_comp (differentiable_branchGlueStep ms _) (differentiable_branchScaleStep ms z),
    normalizedFamilyRoot_jacobian, branchGlueStep_jacobian, branchScaleStep_jacobian]
  change (-1 : ℝ)^(ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum *
    (pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1)^2 *
      scaleFamilyWeight ms z.1.2) = _
  ring

def branchStepPolynomial (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) : ℝ[X] :=
  (X+C z.2) * (monicPoly (familyProduct (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1) : ℝ[X]) -
    familyNumerator (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1 (scaleFamily ms z.1.2)

/-- Actual parent characteristic/cofactor coefficient output at a root. -/
def branchStepCoefficients (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) :
    Coeff ((ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum+1) × Coeff (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum :=
  (cut ((ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum+1) (branchStepPolynomial ms z),
    familyProduct (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1)

def branchCoefficientEquiv (ms : List ℕ) :
    (Coeff ((ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum+1) × Coeff (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum) ≃ₗ[ℝ]
      BranchStepInputs ms :=
  (rootOutputEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum).trans (familyRootEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)).symm

lemma familyRootEquiv_glued (ns : List ℕ) (x : FamilyPairs ns) (d : ℝ) :
    familyRootEquiv ns (normalizedFamilyGlue ns x,d) =
      ((familyGlue ns x).1,(d,(familyGlue ns x).2)) := by
  change rootRegroupEquiv ns.sum
    (familyPairEquiv ns ((familyPairEquiv ns).symm (familyGlue ns x)),d) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

lemma branchStepPolynomial_root (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) :
    branchStepPolynomial ms z =
      rootPolynomial ((familyGlue (ChildFactorDegrees ms) (z.1.1,scaleFamily ms z.1.2)).1,
        (z.2,(familyGlue (ChildFactorDegrees ms) (z.1.1,scaleFamily ms z.1.2)).2)) := by
  unfold branchStepPolynomial rootPolynomial
  rw [familyGlue_numerator_exact]
  rfl

/-- The composed normal-form transformation is exactly the actual coefficient map,
followed by the specified unscaled coefficient permutation. -/
theorem normalizedBranchStep_actual (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) :
    normalizedBranchStep ms z = branchCoefficientEquiv ms (branchStepCoefficients ms z) := by
  change (familyRootEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)).symm
    (rootCoefficientMap (familyRootEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)
      (normalizedFamilyGlue (ChildFactorDegrees ms) (z.1.1,scaleFamily ms z.1.2),z.2))) = _
  rw [familyRootEquiv_glued]
  apply (familyRootEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  simp only [branchCoefficientEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change rootCoefficientMap _ = rootOutputEquiv _ (branchStepCoefficients ms z)
  rw [branchStepCoefficients, branchStepPolynomial_root]
  exact (rootOutputEquiv_actual _ _).symm

/-- End-to-end all-arity local coefficient Jacobian with its actual objects. -/
theorem branchStep_actual_jacobian (ms : List ℕ) (z : BranchStepInputs ms) :
    endJacobian (fun w => branchCoefficientEquiv ms (branchStepCoefficients ms w)) z =
      (-1 : ℝ)^(ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum *
        pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees ms) z.1.1)^2 *
          scaleFamilyWeight ms z.1.2 := by
  have he : (fun w => branchCoefficientEquiv ms (branchStepCoefficients ms w)) = normalizedBranchStep ms := by
    funext w
    exact (normalizedBranchStep_actual ms w).symm
  rw [he, normalizedBranchStep_jacobian]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.BranchStep
import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Pi

/-! Exact serialization of independently indexed child coefficient spaces into
the all-arity gluing coordinates. No dimension matching is assumed. -/
open Module Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def finPiHeadTail {k : ℕ} (E : Fin (k+1) → Type*)
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, Module ℝ (E i)] :
    ((i : Fin (k+1)) → E i) ≃ₗ[ℝ] E 0 × ((i : Fin k) → E i.succ) where
  toFun f := (f 0, fun i => f i.succ)
  invFun z := Fin.cases z.1 z.2
  left_inv f := by funext i; exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
  right_inv z := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

/-- Degree list with definitional head/tail reduction. -/
@[reducible] def finDegreeList : {k : ℕ} → (Fin k → ℕ) → List ℕ
  | 0, _ => []
  | k+1, m => m 0 :: finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)

lemma finDegreeList_eq_ofFn {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ) : finDegreeList m = List.ofFn m := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => rw [finDegreeList, List.ofFn_succ, ih]

/-- Serialize actual bounded polynomials without changing coefficient values. -/
def piCoefficientsFinEquiv : {k : ℕ} → (m : Fin k → ℕ) →
    ((i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ProductInput (finDegreeList m)
  | 0, m => by
    have : Subsingleton (Coeff 0) := (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 0).injective.subsingleton
    exact LinearEquiv.ofSubsingleton _ _
  | k+1, m =>
    (finPiHeadTail (fun i => Coeff (m i))).trans
      ((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (Coeff (m 0))).prodCongr
        (piCoefficientsFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)))

lemma piCoefficientsFinEquiv_polynomials {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ)
    (p : (i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i)) :
    familyPolynomials (finDegreeList m) (piCoefficientsFinEquiv m p) =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin k => (monicPoly (p i) : ℝ[X])) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [List.ofFn_succ]
    change (monicPoly (p 0) : ℝ[X]) ::
      familyPolynomials (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ))
        (piCoefficientsFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => p i.succ)) = _
    rw [ih]

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I]

@[reducible] def degreeSequence (m : I → ℕ) : List ℕ :=
  finDegreeList (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))

/-- The enumeration depends only on the finite index type, never on rates. -/
def piCoefficientsEquiv (m : I → ℕ) :
    ((i : I) → Coeff (m i)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ProductInput (degreeSequence m) :=
  (LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft' ℝ (fun i : I => Coeff (m i)) (Fintype.equivFin I)).trans
    (piCoefficientsFinEquiv (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i)))

lemma degreeSequence_sum (m : I → ℕ) : (degreeSequence m).sum = ∑ i : I, m i := by
  rw [degreeSequence, finDegreeList_eq_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn]
  exact (Fintype.equivFin I).symm.sum_comp m

lemma degreeSequence_addOne (m : I → ℕ) :
    degreeSequence (fun i => m i+1) = ChildFactorDegrees (degreeSequence m) := by
  simp only [degreeSequence, finDegreeList_eq_ofFn, ChildFactorDegrees, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def]

def productInputCast {ms ns : List ℕ} (h : ms = ns) : ProductInput ms ≃ₗ[ℝ] ProductInput ns := by
  subst ns
  exact LinearEquiv.refl ℝ _

def piScaleSlotsEquiv (m : I → ℕ) :
    ((i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ScaledFamilyInput (degreeSequence m) :=
  (piCoefficientsEquiv (fun i => m i+1)).trans (productInputCast (degreeSequence_addOne m))

lemma piCoefficientsEquiv_polynomials (m : I → ℕ) (p : (i : I) → Coeff (m i)) :
    familyPolynomials (degreeSequence m) (piCoefficientsEquiv m p) =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) =>
        (monicPoly (p ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i)) : ℝ[X])) := by
  apply piCoefficientsFinEquiv_polynomials

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PathPolynomial
import HydrologyTree.RateChart

/-! Nested endpoint-path rate coordinates and their explicit permutation to
all physical inward, outward and leak coordinates. No parameter is discarded. -/
open Module Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

@[reducible] def PathRates : ℕ → Type
  | 0 => ℝ
  | n+1 => PathRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)

instance pathRatesNormed : (n : ℕ) → NormedAddCommGroup (PathRates n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup ℝ)
  | n+1 => by
    letI := pathRatesNormed n
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup (PathRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)))

instance pathRatesSpace : (n : ℕ) → NormedSpace ℝ (PathRates n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ ℝ)
  | n+1 => by
    letI := pathRatesSpace n
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ (PathRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)))

instance pathRatesFinite : (n : ℕ) → FiniteDimensional ℝ (PathRates n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (FiniteDimensional ℝ ℝ)
  | n+1 => by
    letI := pathRatesFinite n
    exact inferInstanceAs (FiniteDimensional ℝ (PathRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)))

/-- Add one new root with leak ell and outgoing rate f to the previous child rates. -/
def prependRateEquiv (n : ℕ) : (TreeRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates (n+1) where
  toFun z := (Fin.cons z.2.1 z.1.1, Fin.cons z.2.2 z.1.2)
  invFun x := ((Fin.tail x.1, Fin.tail x.2),(x.1 0,x.2 0))
  left_inv z := rfl
  right_inv x := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
  map_add' z w := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
  map_smul' a z := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl

@[simp] lemma prependRateEquiv_apply (n : ℕ) (z : TreeRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    prependRateEquiv n z = (Fin.cons z.2.1 z.1.1, Fin.cons z.2.2 z.1.2) := rfl

def singletonRateEquiv : ℝ ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates 0 where
  toFun a := (fun _ => a, Fin.elim0)
  invFun x := x.1 0
  left_inv a := rfl
  right_inv x := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i; have hi : i = 0 := Fin.ext (by omega); subst i; rfl
    · funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  map_add' a b := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  map_smul' a b := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i

/-- Explicit linear permutation from the nested rate order to original arrays. -/
def pathRateEquiv : (n : ℕ) → PathRates n ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates n
  | 0 => singletonRateEquiv
  | n+1 => ((pathRateEquiv n).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))).trans (prependRateEquiv n)

@[simp] lemma pathRateEquiv_succ (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    pathRateEquiv (n+1) z = prependRateEquiv n (pathRateEquiv n z.1,z.2) := rfl

/-- The actual root leak as a continuous linear function of all path rates. -/
def pathLeak (n : ℕ) : PathRates n →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (((LinearMap.proj 0).comp
    (LinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).comp (pathRateEquiv n).toLinearMap)

@[simp] lemma pathLeak_apply (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates n) :
    pathLeak n z = (pathRateEquiv n z).1 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma pathLeak_succ (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) : pathLeak (n+1) z = z.2.1 := rfl

/-- The exact monomial, including all zero-rate boundaries. -/
def pathWeight : (n : ℕ) → PathRates n → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n+1, z => (pathLeak n z.1)^(n+1) * z.2.2^n * pathWeight n z.1

def pathRateMonomial (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1)

lemma pathRateMonomial_prepend (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) :
    pathRateMonomial (n+1) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) =
      y.1 0^(n+1) * f^n * pathRateMonomial n y := by
  rw [pathRateMonomial, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  simp only [prependRateEquiv, LinearEquiv.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
    Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.add_sub_add_right,
    Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rfl

theorem pathWeight_eq_rate_monomial (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates n) :
    pathWeight n z = pathRateMonomial n (pathRateEquiv n z) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [pathWeight, pathRateMonomial]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pathWeight, pathRateEquiv_succ, pathRateMonomial_prepend, ih, pathLeak_apply]

/-- The sign depends only on size and the explicit coefficient ordering. -/
def pathOrientation : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | n+1 => (-1 : ℝ)^(n+1) * pathOrientation n

lemma pathOrientation_sq (n : ℕ) : pathOrientation n ^ 2 = 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [pathOrientation]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pathOrientation, mul_pow, ih, mul_one, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm (n+1) 2, pow_mul]
    norm_num

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PathRates

/-! Explicit coordinate permutations for the endpoint-path coefficient map.
The normalization reads existing coefficients; it does not divide, rescale,
fit, or impose the desired Jacobian as an assumption. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Rearrange p,(d,c),q into (p,q),(d,c). -/
def pathShuffle (n : ℕ) : PathPolyData n ≃ₗ[ℝ] (PathCoefficients n × (ℝ × ℝ)) where
  toFun z := ((z.1,z.2.2),z.2.1)
  invFun z := (z.1.1,(z.2,z.1.2))
  left_inv z := rfl
  right_inv z := rfl
  map_add' z w := rfl
  map_smul' a z := rfl

/-- A degree-one monic polynomial has just one non-leading coefficient. -/
def baseCoefficientEquiv : PathCoefficients 0 ≃ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun z := (z.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0
  invFun a := (cut 1 (C a),0)
  left_inv z := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 1).injective
      funext i
      have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i
      change ((cut 1 (C ((z.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0)) : Coeff 1) : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = _
      rw [cut_coeff 1 _ (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 1)]
      simp
    · apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 0).injective
      funext i
      exact Fin.elim0 i
  right_inv a := by
    change ((cut 1 (C a) : Coeff 1) : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = a
    rw [cut_coeff 1 (C a) (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 1)]
    simp
  map_add' z w := by simp
  map_smul' a z := by simp

/-- The order of all original coefficient coordinates, recursively permuted. -/
def pathCoefficientEquiv : (n : ℕ) → PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] PathRates n
  | 0 => baseCoefficientEquiv
  | n+1 => (parentCoefficientEquiv n).trans (pathShuffle n) |>.trans
      ((pathCoefficientEquiv n).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))

/-- From normalized child coefficients and (d,c) to the local polynomial data. -/
def pathTransitionEquiv (n : ℕ) : PathRates (n+1) ≃ₗ[ℝ] PathPolyData n :=
  (((pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm.prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))).trans
    (pathShuffle n).symm

lemma pathCoefficientEquiv_succ (n : ℕ) (p : PathCoefficients (n+1)) :
    pathCoefficientEquiv (n+1) p = (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm (parentCoefficientEquiv n p) := rfl

/-- The actual one-child coefficient operation in the explicit common order. -/
def normalizedPathStep (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) : PathRates (n+1) :=
  pathCoefficientEquiv (n+1) (pathStepCoefficients (pathTransitionEquiv n z))

lemma normalizedPathStep_conjugate (n : ℕ) : normalizedPathStep n =
    fun z => (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm
      (rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n) (pathTransitionEquiv n z)) := by
  funext z
  rw [normalizedPathStep, pathCoefficientEquiv_succ, parentCoefficient_step_eq]

/-- Smoothness follows from the actual polynomial root operation. -/
theorem differentiable_normalizedPathStep (n : ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedPathStep n) := by
  rw [normalizedPathStep_conjugate]
  intro z
  exact (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp z
    ((hasFDerivAt_rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n)
      (pathTransitionEquiv n z)).differentiableAt.comp z
        (pathTransitionEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt)

theorem normalizedPathStep_jacobian (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    endJacobian (normalizedPathStep n) z = (-1 : ℝ)^(n+1) * z.2.2^n := by
  rw [normalizedPathStep_conjugate]
  have h := endJacobian_conjugate (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv
    (rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n)) z
    (hasFDerivAt_rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n)
      (pathTransitionEquiv n z)).differentiableAt
  change endJacobian (fun z => (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm
      (rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n) (pathTransitionEquiv n z))) z = _ at h
  rw [h, endJacobian_rootTransition, finrank_coeff]
  rfl

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PathNormalization

/-! Unscaled coordinate transport: a direct finite bilinear-form proof that
all path coefficient and physical-array reorderings preserve coefficient dot
products. This closes the possible hidden size-dependent scaling of Jacobians. -/
open Polynomial Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def coefficientDot (n : ℕ) (p q : Coeff n) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, (p : ℝ[X]).coeff i * (q : ℝ[X]).coeff i

def pathCoefficientDot (n : ℕ) (p q : PathCoefficients n) : ℝ :=
  coefficientDot (n+1) p.1 q.1 + coefficientDot n p.2 q.2

def physicalRateDot (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i : Fin (n+1), x.1 i * y.1 i) + ∑ i : Fin n, x.2 i * y.2 i

@[reducible] def nestedPathDot : (n : ℕ) → PathRates n → PathRates n → ℝ
  | 0, x, y => x*y
  | n+1, x, y => nestedPathDot n x.1 y.1 + x.2.1*y.2.1 + x.2.2*y.2.2

lemma coefficientDot_succ (n : ℕ) (p q : Coeff (n+1)) :
    coefficientDot (n+1) p q = (p : ℝ[X]).coeff n * (q : ℝ[X]).coeff n +
      coefficientDot n (cut n (p : ℝ[X])) (cut n (q : ℝ[X])) := by
  simp only [coefficientDot, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.val_castSucc,
    Fin.val_last, cut_coeff]
  exact add_comm _ _

lemma coefficientDot_two (n : ℕ) (p q : Coeff (n+2)) :
    coefficientDot (n+2) p q =
      (p : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1) * (q : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1) +
      (p : ℝ[X]).coeff n * (q : ℝ[X]).coeff n +
      coefficientDot n (cut n (p : ℝ[X])) (cut n (q : ℝ[X])) := by
  rw [coefficientDot_succ (n+1), coefficientDot_succ n,
    cut_coeff (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩,
    cut_coeff (n+1) (q : ℝ[X]) ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩,
    cut_cut (Nat.le_succ n), cut_cut (Nat.le_succ n)]
  ring

lemma prependRateEquiv_dot (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n) (a b c d : ℝ) :
    physicalRateDot (n+1) (prependRateEquiv n (x,(a,b)))
      (prependRateEquiv n (y,(c,d))) = physicalRateDot n x y + a*c + b*d := by
  simp only [physicalRateDot, prependRateEquiv_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ]
  ring

/-- The recursive rate equivalence is unscaled in the original physical arrays. -/
theorem pathRateEquiv_dot (n : ℕ) (x y : PathRates n) :
    physicalRateDot n (pathRateEquiv n x) (pathRateEquiv n y) = nestedPathDot n x y := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [pathRateEquiv, singletonRateEquiv, physicalRateDot, nestedPathDot]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pathRateEquiv_succ, pathRateEquiv_succ, prependRateEquiv_dot, ih]

lemma pathCoefficientEquiv_explicit_succ (n : ℕ) (p : PathCoefficients (n+1)) :
    pathCoefficientEquiv (n+1) p =
      (pathCoefficientEquiv n (p.2,cut n (p.1 : ℝ[X])),
        ((p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1),(p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff n)) := by
  change (pathCoefficientEquiv n (p.2, (topTwoEquiv n p.1).2),
    (topTwoEquiv n p.1).1) = _
  rw [topTwoEquiv_apply]

/-- The output-coordinate equivalence only reorders existing coefficients. -/
theorem pathCoefficientEquiv_dot (n : ℕ) (p q : PathCoefficients n) :
    nestedPathDot n (pathCoefficientEquiv n p) (pathCoefficientEquiv n q) =
      pathCoefficientDot n p q := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    change (p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 * (q.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = _
    simp [pathCoefficientDot, coefficientDot, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pathCoefficientEquiv_explicit_succ, pathCoefficientEquiv_explicit_succ]
    change nestedPathDot n (pathCoefficientEquiv n _) (pathCoefficientEquiv n _) + _ + _ = _
    rw [ih]
    unfold pathCoefficientDot
    rw [coefficientDot_two]
    ring

/-- Dot product in an arbitrary finite basis. -/
def basisDot {E I : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [Fintype I]
    (b : Basis I ℝ E) (x y : E) : ℝ := ∑ i, b.repr x i * b.repr y i

/-- A bilinear-form-preserving coefficient map has determinant square one. -/
theorem det_sq_of_basisDot_preserved {E F I : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F]
    [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (bE : Basis I ℝ E) (bF : Basis I ℝ F)
    (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) (hL : ∀ x y, basisDot bF (L x) (L y) = basisDot bE x y) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L).det ^ 2 = 1 := by
  let M := LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L
  have hM : M.transpose * M = 1 := by
    ext i j
    change (∑ k : I, M k i * M k j) = (1 : Matrix I I ℝ) i j
    simp only [M, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    change basisDot bF (L (bE i)) (L (bE j)) = _
    rw [hL]
    simp [basisDot, Matrix.one_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]
  have hd := congrArg Matrix.det hM
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_one] at hd
  simpa only [pow_two] using hd

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.BranchStep
import HydrologyTree.CoordinateEnergy

/-! Exact coefficient-dot preservation for all family charts. This rules out
unproved, size-dependent scale factors when global Jacobians are transported. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma basisDot_reindex {E I J : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (b : Basis I ℝ E) (e : I ≃ J) (x y : E) :
    basisDot (b.reindex e) x y = basisDot b x y := by
  simp only [basisDot, Basis.repr_reindex_apply]
  exact e.symm.sum_comp (fun i => b.repr x i * b.repr y i)

lemma basisDot_prod {E F I J : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F] [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (b : Basis I ℝ E) (c : Basis J ℝ F) (x y : E × F) :
    basisDot (b.prod c) x y = basisDot b x.1 y.1 + basisDot c x.2 y.2 := by
  simp [basisDot]

lemma basisDot_degreeLT (n : ℕ) (p q : Coeff n) :
    basisDot (degreeLT.basis ℝ n) p q = coefficientDot n p q := by
  simp [basisDot, coefficientDot, Polynomial.degreeLT.basis_repr]

lemma basisDot_equiv {E F I : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F] [Fintype I]
    (b : Basis I ℝ E) (c : Basis I ℝ F) (x y : E) :
    basisDot c (b.equiv c (Equiv.refl I) x) (b.equiv c (Equiv.refl I) y) = basisDot b x y := by
  simp [basisDot, Basis.equiv]

@[reducible] def familyCoordinateDot : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → ProductInput ms → ℝ
  | [], _, _ => 0
  | m :: ms, x, y => coefficientDot m x.1 y.1 + familyCoordinateDot ms x.2 y.2

lemma familyBasis_dot (ms : List ℕ) (x y : ProductInput ms) :
    basisDot (familyBasis ms) x y = familyCoordinateDot ms x y := by
  induction ms with
  | nil =>
    change basisDot (degreeLT.basis ℝ 0) x y = 0
    simp [basisDot]
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change basisDot (((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex
      (finSumFinEquiv : (Fin m ⊕ Fin ms.sum) ≃ Fin (m+ms.sum))) x y =
        coefficientDot m x.1 y.1 + familyCoordinateDot ms x.2 y.2
    rw [basisDot_reindex, basisDot_prod, basisDot_degreeLT, ih]

lemma familyPairEquiv_dot (ms : List ℕ) (x y : FamilyPairs ms) :
    coefficientDot ms.sum (familyPairEquiv ms x).1 (familyPairEquiv ms y).1 +
      coefficientDot ms.sum (familyPairEquiv ms x).2 (familyPairEquiv ms y).2 =
      familyCoordinateDot ms x.1 y.1 + familyCoordinateDot ms x.2 y.2 := by
  have h := basisDot_equiv ((familyBasis ms).prod (familyBasis ms))
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum)) x y
  simpa only [familyPairEquiv, basisDot_prod, basisDot_degreeLT, familyBasis_dot] using h

lemma leadingEquiv_dot (n : ℕ) (x y : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    coefficientDot (n+1) (leadingEquiv n x) (leadingEquiv n y) =
      x.1*y.1 + coefficientDot n x.2 y.2 := by
  rw [coefficientDot_succ]
  have hx := split_joinLeading x
  have hy := split_joinLeading y
  rw [splitLeadingLM_apply] at hx hy
  rw [show ((leadingEquiv n x : Coeff (n+1)) : ℝ[X]).coeff n = x.1 from congrArg Prod.fst hx,
    show ((leadingEquiv n y : Coeff (n+1)) : ℝ[X]).coeff n = y.1 from congrArg Prod.fst hy,
    show cut n (leadingEquiv n x : ℝ[X]) = x.2 from congrArg Prod.snd hx,
    show cut n (leadingEquiv n y : ℝ[X]) = y.2 from congrArg Prod.snd hy]

lemma branchCoefficientEquiv_apply (ms : List ℕ)
    (p : Coeff ((ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum+1) × Coeff (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum) :
    branchCoefficientEquiv ms p =
      ((familyPairEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)).symm
        (p.2, cut (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum (p.1 : ℝ[X])),
          (p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum) := rfl

/-- Both gluing coordinate blocks and the root coordinate are pure coefficient
reorderings; no determinant magnitude is inferred numerically. -/
lemma branchCoefficientEquiv_dot (ms : List ℕ)
    (p q : Coeff ((ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum+1) × Coeff (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum) :
    familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees ms) (branchCoefficientEquiv ms p).1.1
        (branchCoefficientEquiv ms q).1.1 +
      familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees ms) (branchCoefficientEquiv ms p).1.2
        (branchCoefficientEquiv ms q).1.2 +
      (branchCoefficientEquiv ms p).2 * (branchCoefficientEquiv ms q).2 =
      pathCoefficientDot (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum p q := by
  let N := (ChildFactorDegrees ms).sum
  have hp : leadingEquiv N ((p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff N, cut N (p.1 : ℝ[X])) = p.1 := join_splitLeading p.1
  have hq : leadingEquiv N ((q.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff N, cut N (q.1 : ℝ[X])) = q.1 := join_splitLeading q.1
  have h := familyPairEquiv_dot (ChildFactorDegrees ms)
    ((familyPairEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)).symm (p.2,cut N (p.1 : ℝ[X])))
    ((familyPairEquiv (ChildFactorDegrees ms)).symm (q.2,cut N (q.1 : ℝ[X])))
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  rw [branchCoefficientEquiv_apply,branchCoefficientEquiv_apply]
  change _ + (p.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff N * (q.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff N = _
  rw [← h]
  unfold pathCoefficientDot
  rw [coefficientDot_succ N]
  ring

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PiSerialization
import HydrologyTree.FamilyCoordinateEnergy

/-! Actual child numerator slots in finite-list gluing coordinates. The leading
coefficient is its connector scale and the remaining coefficients are a monic
child cofactor. Serialization changes no coefficient value. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def piScaledFinEquiv : {k : ℕ} → (m : Fin k → ℕ) →
    ((i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i+1)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ScaledFamilyInput (finDegreeList m)
  | 0, m => by
    change ((i : Fin 0) → Coeff (m i+1)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] Coeff 0
    have : Subsingleton (Coeff 0) := (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 0).injective.subsingleton
    exact LinearEquiv.ofSubsingleton _ _
  | k+1, m =>
    (finPiHeadTail (fun i => Coeff (m i+1))).trans
      ((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (Coeff (m 0+1))).prodCongr
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)))

lemma piScaledFin_polynomials {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ)
    (p : (i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList m)) (piScaledFinEquiv m p) =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin k => (monicPoly (p i) : ℝ[X])) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [List.ofFn_succ]
    change (monicPoly (p 0) : ℝ[X]) ::
      familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)))
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => p i.succ)) = _
    rw [ih]

lemma piScaledFin_weight {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ)
    (p : (i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    scaleFamilyWeight (finDegreeList m) (piScaledFinEquiv m p) =
      ∏ i : Fin k, (p i : ℝ[X]).coeff (m i) ^ (m i) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [finDegreeList,scaleFamilyWeight]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    change (p 0 : ℝ[X]).coeff (m 0) ^ (m 0) *
      scaleFamilyWeight (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ))
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => p i.succ)) = _
    rw [ih]

lemma piScaledFin_scale {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ)
    (p : (i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    scaleFamily (finDegreeList m) (piScaledFinEquiv m p) =
      piScaledFinEquiv m (fun i => scaleLeading (m i) (p i)) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    change (_ : Coeff 0) = _
    have : Subsingleton (Coeff 0) := (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 0).injective.subsingleton
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | succ k ih =>
    change (scaleLeading (m 0) (p 0),
      scaleFamily (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ))
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => p i.succ))) = _
    rw [ih]
    rfl

lemma piScaledFin_dot {k : ℕ} (m : Fin k → ℕ)
    (p q : (i : Fin k) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList m))
      (piScaledFinEquiv m p) (piScaledFinEquiv m q) =
        ∑ i : Fin k, coefficientDot (m i+1) (p i) (q i) := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    change (0 : ℝ) = ∑ i : Fin 0, coefficientDot (m i+1) (p i) (q i)
    simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    change coefficientDot (m 0+1) (p 0) (q 0) +
      familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)))
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => p i.succ))
        (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => q i.succ)) = _
    rw [ih]

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I]

def piScaledEquiv (m : I → ℕ) :
    ((i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ScaledFamilyInput (degreeSequence m) :=
  (LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft' ℝ (fun i => Coeff (m i+1)) (Fintype.equivFin I)).trans
    (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i)))

lemma piScaled_polynomials (m : I → ℕ) (p : (i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees (degreeSequence m)) (piScaledEquiv m p) =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => (monicPoly (p ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i)) : ℝ[X])) :=
  piScaledFin_polynomials _ _

lemma piScaled_weight (m : I → ℕ) (p : (i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    scaleFamilyWeight (degreeSequence m) (piScaledEquiv m p) =
      ∏ i : I, (p i : ℝ[X]).coeff (m i) ^ (m i) := by
  have h := piScaledFin_weight (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))
    (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => p ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))
  exact h.trans ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm.prod_comp (fun i => (p i : ℝ[X]).coeff (m i)^m i))

lemma piScaled_scale (m : I → ℕ) (p : (i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    scaleFamily (degreeSequence m) (piScaledEquiv m p) =
      piScaledEquiv m (fun i => scaleLeading (m i) (p i)) :=
  piScaledFin_scale _ _

lemma piScaled_dot (m : I → ℕ) (p q : (i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees (degreeSequence m))
      (piScaledEquiv m p) (piScaledEquiv m q) =
        ∑ i : I, coefficientDot (m i+1) (p i) (q i) := by
  have h := piScaledFin_dot (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))
    (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => p ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))

import HydrologyTree.MatrixEntries
import HydrologyTree.PhysicalRecursion
import HydrologyTree.LeafRecursion

/-! The endpoint catenary is the original conservative OrderedTree matrix.
The root-tail recurrence is proved directly from every actual matrix entry. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- The path 0--1--...--n, with leak and observation at vertex 0. -/
def pathTree (n : ℕ) : OrderedTree n where
  parent i := i.castSucc
  parent_le i := le_rfl

@[simp] lemma pathTree_parent (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) : (pathTree n).parent i = i.castSucc := rfl

@[simp] lemma path_zero_ne_succ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : (0 : Fin (n+1)) ≠ i.succ := Ne.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)

@[simp] lemma pathCast_zero (n : ℕ) : (0 : Fin (n+1)).castSucc = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma pathParent_succ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    parentVertex (pathTree n) i.succ = i.castSucc := rfl

lemma pathCast_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n+1)) : i.castSucc = 0 ↔ i = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun j : Fin (n+2) => j.val) h)
  · intro h; subst i; rfl

lemma pathCast_succ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : i.succ.castSucc = i.castSucc.succ := rfl

lemma path_root_exit (n : ℕ) (f : EdgeValues (n+1)) : parentCLM (pathTree (n+1)) f 0 = f 0 := by
  rw [parentCLM_apply]
  simp only [pathTree_parent, pathCast_zero_iff]; simp

lemma path_tail_exit (n : ℕ) (f : EdgeValues n) (g : ℝ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    parentCLM (pathTree (n+1)) (Fin.cons g f) i.succ = parentCLM (pathTree n) f i := by
  rw [parentCLM_apply, parentCLM_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [pathTree_parent, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, pathCast_succ,
    Fin.succ_inj, pathCast_zero, path_zero_ne_succ, ite_false, zero_add]
  rfl

lemma path_tail_offdiag (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (n+1)) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    compartmentMatrix (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) i.succ j.succ =
      compartmentMatrix (pathTree n) y i j := by
  have hs : i.succ ≠ j.succ := fun h => hij (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula _ _ _ _ hs,
    compartment_offdiag_parent_formula _ _ _ _ hij]
  simp only [pathParent_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, ite_false, outwardByVertex_succ,
    prependRateEquiv_apply, Fin.cons_succ]
  revert hij
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun u => ?_) i
  · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun v _ => ?_) j
    · intro h; exact False.elim (h rfl)
    · simp only [pathParent_succ, pathCast_succ, pathCast_zero, outwardByVertex_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, path_zero_ne_succ, ite_false, ite_true, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.succ_inj, zero_add, add_zero, eq_self]
      rfl
  · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun v _ => ?_) j
    · intro h
      simp only [pathParent_succ, pathCast_succ, pathCast_zero, outwardByVertex_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, path_zero_ne_succ, ite_false, ite_true, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.succ_inj, zero_add, add_zero, eq_self]
      rfl
    · simp only [pathParent_succ, pathCast_succ, pathCast_zero, outwardByVertex_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, path_zero_ne_succ, ite_false, ite_true, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.succ_inj, zero_add, add_zero, eq_self]
      rfl

/-- The actual principal tail block is the smaller physical path, with its
exit-to-parent rate as its leak. No diagonal is reset or omitted. -/
theorem path_tail_matrix (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) :
    (compartmentMatrix (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f)))).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =
      compartmentMatrix (pathTree n) y := by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, compartment_diagonal, rateChart,
      Pi.add_apply, prependRateEquiv_apply, Fin.cons_succ]
    rw [path_tail_exit]
  · exact path_tail_offdiag n y ell f i j h

lemma path_root_inward (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    compartmentMatrix (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) 0 i.succ =
      if i = 0 then y.1 0 else 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula _ _ _ _ (path_zero_ne_succ i)]
  simp only [pathParent_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, ite_false, ite_true,
    prependRateEquiv_apply, Fin.cons_succ, pathCast_zero_iff, add_zero, eq_self]
  by_cases h : i = 0 <;> simp [h]

lemma path_root_outward (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    compartmentMatrix (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) i.succ 0 =
      if i = 0 then f else 0 := by
  rw [compartment_offdiag_parent_formula _ _ _ _ (Fin.succ_ne_zero i)]
  simp only [pathParent_succ, Fin.succ_ne_zero, ite_false, ite_true,
    outwardByVertex_succ, prependRateEquiv_apply, pathCast_zero_iff, zero_add, eq_self]
  by_cases h : i = 0 <;> simp [h]

def pathRootTailEquiv (n : ℕ) : Unit ⊕ Fin (n+1) ≃ Fin (n+2) where
  toFun := Sum.elim (fun _ => 0) Fin.succ
  invFun := Fin.cases (.inl ()) Sum.inr
  left_inv z := by rcases z with u | i; cases u <;> rfl; rfl
  right_inv i := by refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl

/-- Exact root-tail edge attachment of the original physical path matrix. -/
theorem path_matrix_attachment (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) :
    (compartmentMatrix (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f)))).submatrix
      (pathRootTailEquiv n) (pathRootTailEquiv n) =
      edgeJoin (singletonMatrix (-(ell+f))) (compartmentMatrix (pathTree n) y) () 0 (y.1 0) f := by
  ext u v
  rcases u with u | i <;> rcases v with v | j
  · cases u; cases v
    change compartmentMatrix _ _ 0 0 = -(ell+f)
    rw [compartment_diagonal]
    change -(ell + parentCLM (pathTree (n+1)) (Fin.cons f y.2) 0) = -(ell+f)
    rw [path_root_exit]
    rfl
  · cases u
    change compartmentMatrix _ _ 0 j.succ = Matrix.single () 0 (y.1 0) () j
    rw [path_root_inward]
    simp [Matrix.single_apply, eq_comm]
  · cases v
    change compartmentMatrix _ _ i.succ 0 = Matrix.single 0 () f i ()
    rw [path_root_outward]
    simp [Matrix.single_apply, eq_comm]
  · exact congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ => A i j)
      (path_tail_matrix n y ell f)

/-- Root cofactor recursion for the actual unreduced path model. -/
theorem path_cofactor_recursion (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) :
    physicalRootCofactor (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) =
      physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) y := by
  rw [physicalRootCofactor, path_tail_matrix]
  rfl

/-- The complete physical characteristic recurrence, valid at every real rate. -/
theorem path_characteristic_recursion (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) :
    physicalCharacteristic (pathTree (n+1)) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) =
      (X+C (ell+f)) * physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) y -
        C (y.1 0*f) * physicalRootCofactor (pathTree n) y := by
  rw [physicalCharacteristic, ← charpoly_submatrix_equiv _ (pathRootTailEquiv n),
    path_matrix_attachment, charpoly_edgeJoin, singletonMatrix_charpoly, singletonMatrix_cofactor,
    diagonalCofactor_zero]
  simp only [map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, mul_one, physicalCharacteristic, physicalRootCofactor]

/-- Actual endpoint-path coefficient map in physical arrays. -/
def pathCoefficientMap (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) : PathCoefficients n :=
  physicalCoefficientMap (pathTree n) x

theorem pathCoefficientMap_recursion (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (ell f : ℝ) :
    pathCoefficientMap (n+1) (prependRateEquiv n (y,(ell,f))) =
      pathStepCoefficients ((pathCoefficientMap n y).1,
        ((ell+f, y.1 0*f), (pathCoefficientMap n y).2)) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · change cut (n+2) (physicalCharacteristic _ _) = _
    rw [path_characteristic_recursion]
    change _ = cut (n+2) ((X+C (ell+f)) * (monicPoly (physicalCoefficientMap (pathTree n) y).1 : ℝ[X]) -
      C (y.1 0*f) * (monicPoly (physicalCoefficientMap (pathTree n) y).2 : ℝ[X]))
    rw [physicalCoefficientMap_first_reconstruct, physicalCoefficientMap_second_reconstruct]
  · change cut (n+1) (physicalRootCofactor _ _) = _
    rw [path_cofactor_recursion]
    rfl

end HydrologyTree

/-! Single-child root coupling, retaining the actual child leak as a linear
function of all child parameters. No leak is assumed constant or nonzero. -/
open Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def scalarCouplingFiber (a : ℝ) : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) + ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod
    (a • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)

lemma det_scalarCouplingFiber (a : ℝ) : LinearMap.det (scalarCouplingFiber a).toLinearMap = a := by
  let b := (Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Basis.singleton Unit ℝ)
  have he : LinearMap.toMatrix b b (scalarCouplingFiber a).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) 1 0 (a • (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ)) := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [b, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, scalarCouplingFiber]
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix b, he, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
  simp

def scalarCoupling (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E × (ℝ × ℝ)) : E × (ℝ × ℝ) :=
  (z.1,(z.2.1+z.2.2,a z.1*z.2.2))

def scalarCouplingDerivative (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E × (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    (E × (ℝ × ℝ)) →L[ℝ] (E × (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
  lowerBlock (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) ((0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod (z.2.2 • a))
    (scalarCouplingFiber (a z.1))

theorem hasFDerivAt_scalarCoupling (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E × (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    HasFDerivAt (scalarCoupling a) (scalarCouplingDerivative a z) z := by
  let P : (E × (ℝ × ℝ)) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E _
  let L := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × ℝ))
  let F := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × ℝ))
  have hl := (L.hasFDerivAt (x := z)).add F.hasFDerivAt
  have hc := (a.hasFDerivAt.comp z P.hasFDerivAt).mul F.hasFDerivAt
  apply (P.hasFDerivAt.prodMk (hl.prodMk hc)).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change h.2.1 + h.2.2 = 0 + (h.2.1+h.2.2)
      simp
    · change a z.1 * h.2.2 + z.2.2 * a h.1 = z.2.2 * a h.1 + a z.1 * h.2.2
      ring

theorem scalarCoupling_jacobian [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (z : E × (ℝ × ℝ)) : endJacobian (scalarCoupling a) z = a z.1 := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_scalarCoupling a z), scalarCouplingDerivative,
    endDet_lowerBlock, det_scalarCouplingFiber]
  simp

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PathNormalization
import HydrologyTree.ScalarCoupling

/-! Complete all-size determinant induction for the actual endpoint-path
characteristic/cofactor coefficient map. Every rate value, including zero,
is allowed; all coordinate changes are explicit linear permutations. -/
open Polynomial Matrix Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- The actual physical coefficient map, merely put in a common coordinate order. -/
def normalizedPhysicalPath (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates n) : PathRates n :=
  pathCoefficientEquiv n (pathCoefficientMap n (pathRateEquiv n z))

lemma normalizedPhysicalPath_zero : normalizedPhysicalPath 0 = id := by
  funext a
  letI : Subsingleton (Fin (0+1)) := inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (Fin 1))
  change ((cut 1 (physicalCharacteristic (pathTree 0) (singletonRateEquiv a)) : Coeff 1) : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = a
  rw [cut_coeff 1 _ (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 1)]
  rw [physicalCharacteristic, Matrix.charpoly,
    Matrix.det_eq_elem_of_subsingleton _ (0 : Fin (0+1))]
  simp [Matrix.charmatrix_apply_eq, compartmentMatrix, singletonRateEquiv]

@[simp] lemma pathTransitionEquiv_apply (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    pathTransitionEquiv n z =
      (((pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm z.1).1, (z.2,((pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm z.1).2)) := rfl

/-- The genuine physical recursion factors through the proved local maps. -/
theorem normalizedPhysicalPath_succ (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    normalizedPhysicalPath (n+1) z = normalizedPathStep n
      (keepFunction (normalizedPhysicalPath n) (scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z)) := by
  unfold normalizedPhysicalPath
  rw [pathRateEquiv_succ, pathCoefficientMap_recursion]
  unfold normalizedPathStep keepFunction scalarCoupling
  rw [pathTransitionEquiv_apply]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, pathLeak_apply]

lemma normalizedPhysicalPath_succ_fun (n : ℕ) :
    normalizedPhysicalPath (n+1) = normalizedPathStep n ∘
      (keepFunction (F := ℝ × ℝ) (normalizedPhysicalPath n) ∘ scalarCoupling (pathLeak n)) := by
  funext z
  exact normalizedPhysicalPath_succ n z

/-- Differentiability of the actual full coefficient map is proved by size induction. -/
theorem differentiable_normalizedPhysicalPath (n : ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedPhysicalPath n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [normalizedPhysicalPath_zero]; exact differentiable_id
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [normalizedPhysicalPath_succ_fun]
    intro z
    have hc := (hasFDerivAt_scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z).differentiableAt
    have hk := (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction (scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z) (ih z.1)).differentiableAt
    exact (differentiable_normalizedPathStep n _).comp z (hk.comp z hc)

/-- Exact one-step Jacobian recurrence, without inversion of any parameter. -/
theorem normalizedPhysicalPath_jacobian_succ (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalPath (n+1)) z =
      (-1 : ℝ)^(n+1) * (pathLeak n z.1)^(n+1) * z.2.2^n *
        endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalPath n) z.1 := by
  have hc := (hasFDerivAt_scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z).differentiableAt
  have hk := (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction (scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z)
    (differentiable_normalizedPhysicalPath n z.1)).differentiableAt
  rw [normalizedPhysicalPath_succ_fun,
    endJacobian_comp (differentiable_normalizedPathStep n _) (hk.comp z hc),
    endJacobian_comp hk hc, normalizedPathStep_jacobian,
    endJacobian_keepFunction (normalizedPhysicalPath n) (scalarCoupling (pathLeak n) z)
      (differentiable_normalizedPhysicalPath n z.1),
    scalarCoupling_jacobian]
  change (-1 : ℝ)^(n+1) * (pathLeak n z.1 * z.2.2)^n *
      (endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalPath n) z.1 * pathLeak n z.1) = _
  rw [mul_pow, pow_succ]
  ring

/-- Complete all-size monomial formula for the actual endpoint catenary.
No assumption of the target determinant or of any intermediate recurrence. -/
theorem normalizedPhysicalPath_jacobian (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates n) :
    endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalPath n) z = pathOrientation n * pathWeight n z := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [normalizedPhysicalPath_zero, endJacobian]
    simp [pathOrientation, pathWeight]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [normalizedPhysicalPath_jacobian_succ, ih, pathOrientation, pathWeight]
    ring

/-- Recover the unnormalized actual coefficient map by inverse permutations. -/
lemma pathCoefficientMap_from_normalized (n : ℕ) : pathCoefficientMap n =
    fun x => (pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm (normalizedPhysicalPath n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm x)) := by
  funext x
  simp [normalizedPhysicalPath]

theorem differentiable_pathCoefficientMap (n : ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) := by
  rw [pathCoefficientMap_from_normalized]
  intro x
  exact (pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp x
    ((differentiable_normalizedPhysicalPath n _).comp x
      (pathRateEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt)

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PathInduction

/-! Endpoint-catenary Jacobian for every finite size, evaluated on the actual
physical characteristic/root-cofactor coefficient map and original rate arrays.
The displayed bases only permute the explicitly defined scalar coordinates. -/
open Module Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

@[reducible] def PathCoordinateIndex : ℕ → Type
  | 0 => Unit
  | n+1 => PathCoordinateIndex n ⊕ (Unit ⊕ Unit)

instance pathCoordinateFintype : (n : ℕ) → Fintype (PathCoordinateIndex n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (Fintype Unit)
  | n+1 => by
    letI := pathCoordinateFintype n
    exact inferInstanceAs (Fintype (PathCoordinateIndex n ⊕ (Unit ⊕ Unit)))

instance pathCoordinateDecidableEq (n : ℕ) : DecidableEq (PathCoordinateIndex n) := Classical.decEq _

/-- Every basis vector is a single unscaled physical rate coordinate. -/
def pathRateBasis : (n : ℕ) → Basis (PathCoordinateIndex n) ℝ (PathRates n)
  | 0 => Basis.singleton Unit ℝ
  | n+1 => (pathRateBasis n).prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Basis.singleton Unit ℝ))

def catenaryInputBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (PathCoordinateIndex n) ℝ (TreeRates n) :=
  (pathRateBasis n).map (pathRateEquiv n)

def catenaryOutputBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (PathCoordinateIndex n) ℝ (PathCoefficients n) :=
  (pathRateBasis n).map (pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm

/-- The determinant of fderiv of the actual original path coefficient map. -/
def catenaryJacobian (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryInputBasis n) (catenaryOutputBasis n)
    (fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) x).toLinearMap).det

lemma toMatrix_coordinate_transport {E X Y I : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℝ X]
    [AddCommGroup Y] [Module ℝ Y] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (b : Basis I ℝ E) (ein : E ≃ₗ[ℝ] X) (eout : Y ≃ₗ[ℝ] E) (L : X →ₗ[ℝ] Y) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (b.map ein) (b.map eout.symm) L =
      LinearMap.toMatrix b b (eout.toLinearMap.comp (L.comp ein.toLinearMap)) := by
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Basis.map_repr]

/-- Exact transport from the common-coordinate induction to the actual derivative. -/
theorem normalizedPathJacobian_eq_catenary (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates n) :
    endJacobian (normalizedPhysicalPath n) z = catenaryJacobian n (pathRateEquiv n z) := by
  have hc := (differentiable_pathCoefficientMap n (pathRateEquiv n z)).hasFDerivAt
  have h := (pathCoefficientEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp z
    (hc.comp z (pathRateEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt)
  have hd : fderiv ℝ (normalizedPhysicalPath n) z =
      (pathCoefficientEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        ((fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) (pathRateEquiv n z)).comp
          (pathRateEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap) := h.fderiv
  rw [endJacobian, hd, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (pathRateBasis n),
    catenaryJacobian, catenaryInputBasis, catenaryOutputBasis, toMatrix_coordinate_transport]
  rfl

/-- Full all-size endpoint-catenary formula, including every zero-rate boundary.
For n edges the inward exponents are n,n-1,...,1 and the outward exponents
are n-1,n-2,...,0. The root leak is unrestricted and contributes no factor. -/
theorem catenaryJacobian_eq (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryJacobian n x = pathOrientation n *
      ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1) := by
  have h := normalizedPhysicalPath_jacobian n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm x)
  rw [normalizedPathJacobian_eq_catenary, pathWeight_eq_rate_monomial] at h
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, pathRateMonomial] using h

/-- Orientation-free form of the same exact identity. -/
theorem catenaryJacobian_sq (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryJacobian n x ^ 2 =
      (∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1)) ^ 2 := by
  rw [catenaryJacobian_eq, mul_pow, pathOrientation_sq, one_mul]

lemma pathOrientation_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : pathOrientation n ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hs := pathOrientation_sq n
  rw [h] at hs
  norm_num at hs

lemma pathRateMonomial_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    pathRateMonomial n x = 0 ↔
      (∃ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ = 0) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n ∧ x.2 i = 0) := by
  rw [pathRateMonomial, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i,_,hi⟩
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hi with ha | hf
    · left
      refine ⟨i,?_⟩
      by_contra h
      exact (pow_ne_zero _ h) ha
    · right
      have hp : 0 < n-i.val-1 := by
        by_contra h
        have he : n-i.val-1 = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h
        rw [he, pow_zero] at hf
        exact one_ne_zero hf

      by_contra h

    rcases h with ⟨i,ha⟩ | ⟨i,hi,hf⟩
    · refine ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ i,?_⟩
      have hp : n-i.val ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt i.isLt)
      simp [ha, hp]
    · refine ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ i,?_⟩
      have hp : n-i.val-1 ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp [hf, hp]

theorem catenaryJacobian_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryJacobian n x = 0 ↔
      (∃ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ = 0) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n ∧ x.2 i = 0) := by

theorem catenaryJacobian_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ≠ 0)

  intro hz
  rcases (catenaryJacobian_zero_iff n x).mp hz with (⟨i,hi⟩ | ⟨i,hi,h0⟩)

  · exact hf i hi h0
