/-! Transport to the usual ascending coefficient and physical-array bases.
The conversion factor is explicit, nonzero and depends only on the number of
compartments, never on the rates. No change of the physical coefficient map. -/
open Module Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev CatenaryArrayIndex (n : ℕ) := Fin (n+1) ⊕ Fin n

def catenaryArrayInputBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (CatenaryArrayIndex n) ℝ (TreeRates n) :=
  (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n))

def catenaryArrayOutputBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (CatenaryArrayIndex n) ℝ (PathCoefficients n) :=
  (degreeLT.basis ℝ (n+1)).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)

/-- Usual physical rate arrays and ascending non-leading P/F coefficients. -/
def catenaryCanonicalJacobian (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
    (fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) x).toLinearMap).det

/-- Explicit linear coefficient permutation, independent of all rate parameters. -/
def catenaryCoordinateReturn (n : ℕ) : PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates n :=
  (pathCoefficientEquiv n).trans (pathRateEquiv n)

def catenaryCoordinateDet (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)
    (catenaryCoordinateReturn n).toLinearMap).det

lemma catenaryCoordinateDet_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : catenaryCoordinateDet n ≠ 0 := by
  let e := catenaryCoordinateReturn n
  have he : e.toLinearMap.comp e.symm.toLinearMap = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact e.apply_symm_apply x
  have hm := congrArg
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)) he
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
    (catenaryArrayInputBasis n), LinearMap.toMatrix_id] at hm
  have hd := congrArg Matrix.det hm
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_one] at hd
  intro hz
  change catenaryCoordinateDet n * _ = 1 at hd
  rw [hz, zero_mul] at hd
  exact zero_ne_one hd

lemma array_normalized_jacobian (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    endJacobian (fun y => catenaryCoordinateReturn n (pathCoefficientMap n y)) x =
      catenaryCoordinateDet n * catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x := by
  have h := (catenaryCoordinateReturn n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp x
    (differentiable_pathCoefficientMap n x).hasFDerivAt
  have hd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => catenaryCoordinateReturn n (pathCoefficientMap n y)) x =
      (catenaryCoordinateReturn n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        (fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) x) := h.fderiv
  rw [endJacobian, hd, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _ ((catenaryCoordinateReturn n).toLinearMap.comp
    (fderiv ℝ (pathCoefficientMap n) x).toLinearMap)).det = _
  rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
    (catenaryArrayInputBasis n), Matrix.det_mul]
  rfl

lemma catenaryCanonicalJacobian_transport (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryCoordinateDet n * catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x =
      pathOrientation n * pathRateMonomial n x := by
  have h := endJacobian_conjugate (pathRateEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv
    (normalizedPhysicalPath n) x
    (differentiable_normalizedPhysicalPath n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm x))
  have he : (fun y => (pathRateEquiv n) (normalizedPhysicalPath n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm y))) =
      (fun y => catenaryCoordinateReturn n (pathCoefficientMap n y)) := by
    funext y
    simp [normalizedPhysicalPath, catenaryCoordinateReturn]
  change endJacobian (fun y => (pathRateEquiv n) (normalizedPhysicalPath n ((pathRateEquiv n).symm y))) x = _ at h
  rw [he, array_normalized_jacobian, normalizedPhysicalPath_jacobian,
    pathWeight_eq_rate_monomial] at h
  have hh : (pathRateEquiv n) ((pathRateEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.symm x) = x :=
    (pathRateEquiv n).apply_symm_apply x
  rwa [hh] at h

/-- A fixed explicit nonzero constant for the chosen ascending coordinate order. -/
def catenaryCanonicalFactor (n : ℕ) : ℝ := pathOrientation n / catenaryCoordinateDet n

lemma catenaryCanonicalFactor_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : catenaryCanonicalFactor n ≠ 0 :=
  div_ne_zero (pathOrientation_ne_zero n) (catenaryCoordinateDet_ne_zero n)

/-- In standard ascending coefficient and physical-array coordinates, the exact
Jacobian has precisely the conjectured monomial, with an explicit nonzero
size-dependent constant. There are no additional parameter-dependent factors. -/
theorem catenaryCanonicalJacobian_eq (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x = catenaryCanonicalFactor n *
      ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1) := by
  have h := catenaryCanonicalJacobian_transport n x
  have he : catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x =
      (pathOrientation n * pathRateMonomial n x) / catenaryCoordinateDet n := by
    apply (eq_div_iff (catenaryCoordinateDet_ne_zero n)).mpr
    simpa only [mul_comm] using h
  rw [he, catenaryCanonicalFactor, pathRateMonomial]
  ring

/-- Exact standard-coordinate singular locus, including the zero-rate boundary. -/
theorem catenaryCanonicalJacobian_zero_iff (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x = 0 ↔
      (∃ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ = 0) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n ∧ x.2 i = 0) := by
  rw [catenaryCanonicalJacobian_eq, mul_eq_zero]
  simp only [catenaryCanonicalFactor_ne_zero, false_or]
  exact pathRateMonomial_zero_iff n x

@[simp] lemma coefficientArrayEquiv_first (n : ℕ) (p : PathCoefficients n) (i : Fin (n+1)) :

    (coefficientArrayEquiv n p).2 i = (p.2 : ℝ[X]).coeff i := rfl

    physicalRateDot n (coefficientArrayEquiv n p) (coefficientArrayEquiv n q) =
      pathCoefficientDot n p q := rfl

    LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)
      (coefficientArrayEquiv n).toLinearMap = 1 := by

    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, catenaryArrayInputBasis, catenaryArrayOutputBasis,
      coefficientArrayEquiv, Matrix.one_apply, Polynomial.degreeLT.basis_repr, Fin.val_inj]

    (fderiv ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x).toLinearMap).det

      rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)]
      change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _ ((coefficientArrayEquiv n).toLinearMap.comp
        (fderiv ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x).toLinearMap)).det = _
      rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)

/-! Exact bijective preparation of independent physical child coefficient arrays,
connector scales, and a root diagonal for the proved all-arity local coefficient
map. No independence or dimension matching is postulated. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I]

abbrev IndependentChildData (m : I → ℕ) := ((i : I) → TreeRates (m i)) × (ℝ × (I → ℝ))
abbrev IndependentChildPolynomials (m : I → ℕ) :=
  ((i : I) → PathCoefficients (m i)) × (ℝ × (I → ℝ))
abbrev IndependentSlots (m : I → ℕ) :=
  (((i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) × ((i : I) → Coeff (m i+1))) × ℝ

/-- Only regrouping, before the independent leading-coefficient equivalences. -/
def childSlotRegroup (m : I → ℕ) : IndependentChildPolynomials m ≃ₗ[ℝ]
    ((((i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) × ((i : I) → ℝ × Coeff (m i))) × ℝ) where
  toFun z := ((fun i => (z.1 i).1,fun i => (z.2.2 i,(z.1 i).2)),z.2.1)
  invFun z := (fun i => (z.1.1 i,(z.1.2 i).2),(z.2,fun i => (z.1.2 i).1))
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

/-- Pair child lower cofactor coefficients with their independent connector scale. -/
def childPolynomialSlots (m : I → ℕ) : IndependentChildPolynomials m ≃ₗ[ℝ] IndependentSlots m :=
  (childSlotRegroup m).trans
    (((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ ((i : I) → Coeff (m i+1))).prodCongr
      (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight (fun i => leadingEquiv (m i)))).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ))

/-- Fixed-rate-independent equivalence into the actual gluing/root coefficient spaces. -/
def prepareFamilyEquiv (m : I → ℕ) : IndependentChildData m ≃ₗ[ℝ] BranchStepInputs (degreeSequence m) :=
  (((LinearEquiv.piCongrRight (fun i => (coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm)).prodCongr
    (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × (I → ℝ)))).trans (childPolynomialSlots m)) |>.trans
      (((piScaledEquiv m).prodCongr (piScaledEquiv m)).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ))

lemma prepareFamilyEquiv_apply (m : I → ℕ) (z : IndependentChildData m) :
    prepareFamilyEquiv m z =
      ((piScaledEquiv m (fun i => ((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (z.1 i)).1),
        piScaledEquiv m (fun i => leadingEquiv (m i)
          (z.2.2 i,((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (z.1 i)).2))),z.2.1) := rfl

/-- Root coordinates and every child coordinate are serialized without rescaling. -/
def independentChildDot (m : I → ℕ) (x y : IndependentChildData m) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i : I, physicalRateDot (m i) (x.1 i) (y.1 i)) + x.2.1*y.2.1 + ∑ i : I, x.2.2 i*y.2.2 i

def branchInputDot (ms : List ℕ) (x y : BranchStepInputs ms) : ℝ :=
  familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees ms) x.1.1 y.1.1 +
    familyCoordinateDot (ChildFactorDegrees ms) x.1.2 y.1.2 + x.2*y.2

lemma coefficientArrayEquiv_symm_dot (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n) :
    pathCoefficientDot n ((coefficientArrayEquiv n).symm x) ((coefficientArrayEquiv n).symm y) =
      physicalRateDot n x y := by
  have h := coefficientArrayEquiv_dot n ((coefficientArrayEquiv n).symm x)
    ((coefficientArrayEquiv n).symm y)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h.symm

/-- Coordinate preparation is an unscaled permutation in the actual coefficient
Euclidean bilinear form. This later certifies determinant magnitude one. -/
theorem prepareFamilyEquiv_dot (m : I → ℕ) (x y : IndependentChildData m) :
    branchInputDot (degreeSequence m) (prepareFamilyEquiv m x) (prepareFamilyEquiv m y) =
      independentChildDot m x y := by
  rw [branchInputDot,prepareFamilyEquiv_apply,prepareFamilyEquiv_apply,piScaled_dot,piScaled_dot]
  simp only [leadingEquiv_dot,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  unfold independentChildDot
  have h : (∑ i : I, physicalRateDot (m i) (x.1 i) (y.1 i)) =
      (∑ i : I, coefficientDot (m i+1)
        ((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (x.1 i)).1
        ((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (y.1 i)).1) +
      (∑ i : I, coefficientDot (m i)
        ((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (x.1 i)).2
        ((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (y.1 i)).2) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact (coefficientArrayEquiv_symm_dot (m i) (x.1 i) (y.1 i)).symm
  rw [h]
  ring

/-- The local scaling factors are exactly the given connector products, not
coefficients introduced by an unproved change of basis. -/
theorem prepareFamilyEquiv_scaleWeight (m : I → ℕ) (z : IndependentChildData m) :
    scaleFamilyWeight (degreeSequence m) (prepareFamilyEquiv m z).1.2 = ∏ i : I, (z.2.2 i) ^ m i := by
  rw [prepareFamilyEquiv_apply,piScaled_weight]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have h := split_joinLeading (z.2.2 i,((coefficientArrayEquiv (m i)).symm (z.1 i)).2)
  exact congrArg (fun c : ℝ => c ^ m i) (congrArg Prod.fst h)

end HydrologyTree

  toFun z := (fun i => (z.2 i).2,(z.1,fun i => (z.2 i).1))

  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

    exact congrArg Prod.snd (ratePartition_child t x c)

    · rfl
    · funext c
      exact congrArg Prod.fst (ratePartition_child t x c)

    (∑ v : Fin (n+1), x.1 v*y.1 v) = x.1 0*y.1 0 +

    (∑ e : Fin n, x.2 e*y.2 e) =
      ∑ c : RootChild t, (outwardByVertex x.2 c.val * outwardByVertex y.2 c.val +
        ∑ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c), (childRates t c x).2 i * (childRates t c y).2 i) := by
  rw [← (numberedEdgeEquiv t).sum_comp (fun e => x.2 e*y.2 e),Fintype.sum_sigma]

    independentChildDot (childEdgeCount t) (originalWorkEquiv t x) (originalWorkEquiv t y) =

  rw [originalWorkEquiv_apply,originalWorkEquiv_apply]
  unfold independentChildDot
  change (∑ c : RootChild t, physicalRateDot (childEdgeCount t c) (childRates t c x) (childRates t c y)) +

        familyNumerator (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ)))

          (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin k => m i.succ) (fun i : Fin k => r i.succ)) = _
    rw [ih,familyProduct_reconstruct,piScaledFin_polynomials,List.prod_ofFn]

lemma branchNumeratorSum_equiv {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J] (e : I ≃ J) (P R : J → ℝ[X]) :
    branchNumeratorSum (fun i => P (e i)) (fun i => R (e i)) = branchNumeratorSum P R := by
  rw [branchNumeratorSum_ite,branchNumeratorSum_ite]
  rw [← e.sum_comp (fun j => R j * ∏ k : J, if k=j then 1 else P k)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  congr 1
  rw [← e.prod_comp (fun k => if k=e i then 1 else P k)]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]

/-- No original child is lost, repeated or assigned a spurious numerator. -/
theorem serializedNumerator {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (m : I → ℕ) (p r : (i : I) → Coeff (m i+1)) :
    familyNumerator (ChildFactorDegrees (degreeSequence m)) (piScaledEquiv m p) (piScaledEquiv m r) =
      branchNumeratorSum (fun i => (monicPoly (p i) : ℝ[X])) (fun i => (r i : ℝ[X])) := by
  change familyNumerator (ChildFactorDegrees (finDegreeList _))
    (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => p ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i)))
    (piScaledFinEquiv (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => m ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))
      (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card I) => r ((Fintype.equivFin I).symm i))) = _
  rw [serializedFinNumerator]
  exact branchNumeratorSum_equiv (Fintype.equivFin I).symm
    (fun i : I => (monicPoly (p i) : ℝ[X])) (fun i : I => (r i : ℝ[X]))

/-! The actual derivative determinant of independent children of different
sizes. The module proves, rather than assumes, heterogeneous Jacobian multiplication. -/
open Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [LinearOrder I]
variable {E : I → Type*} [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℝ (E i)]
  [∀ i, FiniteDimensional ℝ (E i)]

def dependentPiEnd (f : (i : I) → E i → E i) (z : (i : I) → E i) : (i : I) → E i :=
  fun i => f i (z i)

def dependentPiFDeriv (f : (i : I) → E i → E i) (z : (i : I) → E i) :
    ((i : I) → E i) →L[ℝ] ((i : I) → E i) :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun i => (fderiv ℝ (f i) (z i)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i)

theorem hasFDerivAt_dependentPiEnd (f : (i : I) → E i → E i) (z : (i : I) → E i)
    (hf : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i) (z i)) :
    HasFDerivAt (dependentPiEnd f) (dependentPiFDeriv f z) z := by
  apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
  intro i
  exact (hf i).hasFDerivAt.comp z
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : ((j : I) → E j) →L[ℝ] E i).hasFDerivAt

lemma determinant_dependentPi (L : (i : I) → E i →ₗ[ℝ] E i) :
    (LinearMap.pi (fun i => (L i).comp (LinearMap.proj i))).det = ∏ i : I, (L i).det := by
  let b := fun i : I => Module.finBasis ℝ (E i)
  have hM : LinearMap.toMatrix (Pi.basis b) (Pi.basis b)
      (LinearMap.pi (fun i => (L i).comp (LinearMap.proj i))) =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => LinearMap.toMatrix (b i) (b i) (L i)) := by
    ext ⟨i,a⟩ ⟨j,c⟩
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Pi.basis_apply, Pi.basis_repr]
    · simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Pi.basis_apply, Pi.basis_repr,
        Matrix.blockDiagonal'_apply_ne, h, Ne.symm h]
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (Pi.basis b), hM, det_dependent_blocks]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => LinearMap.det_toMatrix (b i) (L i))

/-- The full Fréchet determinant of the actual independent-child transformation. -/
theorem endJacobian_dependentPiEnd (f : (i : I) → E i → E i) (z : (i : I) → E i)
    (hf : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i) (z i)) :
    endJacobian (dependentPiEnd f) z = ∏ i : I, endJacobian (f i) (z i) := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_dependentPiEnd f z hf)]
  exact determinant_dependentPi (fun i => (fderiv ℝ (f i) (z i)).toLinearMap)

end HydrologyTree

proved to be a fixed sign, not an unspecified nonzero normalization constant. -/
open Polynomial Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma arrayInput_basisDot (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n) :
    basisDot (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) x y = physicalRateDot n x y := by
  simp [basisDot, catenaryArrayInputBasis, physicalRateDot]

lemma arrayOutput_basisDot (n : ℕ) (p q : PathCoefficients n) :
    basisDot (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) p q = pathCoefficientDot n p q := by
  simp [basisDot, catenaryArrayOutputBasis, pathCoefficientDot, coefficientDot,
    Polynomial.degreeLT.basis_repr]

/-- The two actual coordinate rearrangements are unscaled; no numerical determinant
or finite-dimensional sample is used to certify the normalization. -/
theorem catenaryCoordinateDet_sq (n : ℕ) : catenaryCoordinateDet n ^ 2 = 1 := by
  apply det_sq_of_basisDot_preserved (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)
  intro p q
  rw [arrayInput_basisDot, arrayOutput_basisDot]
  change physicalRateDot n (pathRateEquiv n (pathCoefficientEquiv n p))
    (pathRateEquiv n (pathCoefficientEquiv n q)) = pathCoefficientDot n p q
  rw [pathRateEquiv_dot, pathCoefficientEquiv_dot]

/-- The standard-coordinate normalization constant has magnitude exactly one. -/
theorem catenaryCanonicalFactor_sq (n : ℕ) : catenaryCanonicalFactor n ^ 2 = 1 := by
  rw [catenaryCanonicalFactor, div_pow, pathOrientation_sq, catenaryCoordinateDet_sq]
  norm_num

lemma real_sq_one_sign (c : ℝ) (hc : c^2 = 1) : c = 1 ∨ c = -1 := by
  have h : (c-1)*(c+1) = 0 := by nlinarith
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
  · left; linarith
  · right; linarith

/-- A sign independent of every rate vector, for every number n+1 of compartments.
This is the actual physical coefficient-map determinant in standard ascending
P/F coefficient and physical-array bases, including all zero-rate boundaries. -/
theorem catenary_standard_jacobian (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) ∧ ∀ x : TreeRates n,
      catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x = ε *
        ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1) := by
  exact ⟨catenaryCanonicalFactor n,
    real_sq_one_sign _ (catenaryCanonicalFactor_sq n), catenaryCanonicalJacobian_eq n⟩

/-- Orientation-free exact polynomial identity for the actual canonical Jacobian. -/
theorem catenary_standard_jacobian_sq (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x ^ 2 =
      (∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1)) ^ 2 := by
  rw [catenaryCanonicalJacobian_eq, mul_pow, catenaryCanonicalFactor_sq, one_mul]

/-- Exact singular locus in standard physical and polynomial coordinates. -/
theorem catenary_standard_singular_locus (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) :
    catenaryCanonicalJacobian n x = 0 ↔
      (∃ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ = 0) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin n, i.val+1 < n ∧ x.2 i = 0) :=
  catenaryCanonicalJacobian_zero_iff n x

end HydrologyTree

/-! Rate-independent preparation and coefficient return for the ACTUAL physical
branching tree. Sizes, coefficient identities and coordinate normalization are proved. -/
open Polynomial Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev TreeBranchDegrees {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) := degreeSequence (childEdgeCount t)
abbrev TreeWork {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) := IndependentChildData (childEdgeCount t)

lemma treeBranchDegree_sum {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    (ChildFactorDegrees (TreeBranchDegrees t)).sum = n := by
  rw [← degreeSequence_addOne,degreeSequence_sum,sum_child_vertices]

def pathCoefficientsCast {n m : ℕ} (h : n=m) : PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] PathCoefficients m := by
  subst m
  exact LinearEquiv.refl ℝ _

lemma pathCoefficientsCast_cut {n m : ℕ} (h : n=m) (P F : ℝ[X]) :
    pathCoefficientsCast h (cut (n+1) P,cut n F) = (cut (m+1) P,cut m F) := by
  subst m
  rfl

lemma pathCoefficientsCast_dot {n m : ℕ} (h : n=m) (p q : PathCoefficients n) :
    pathCoefficientDot m (pathCoefficientsCast h p) (pathCoefficientsCast h q) =
      pathCoefficientDot n p q := by
  subst m
  rfl

/-- The actual parent coefficient output, in the same independent-child coordinates
as the input. All constituent transformations are fixed linear equivalences. -/
def parentCoefficientWorkEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeWork t :=
  ((pathCoefficientsCast (treeBranchDegree_sum t).symm).trans
    (branchCoefficientEquiv (TreeBranchDegrees t))).trans (prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t)).symm

lemma parentCoefficientWorkEquiv_dot {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (p q : PathCoefficients n) :
    independentChildDot (childEdgeCount t) (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t p) (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t q) =
      pathCoefficientDot n p q := by
  rw [← prepareFamilyEquiv_dot]
  have hp : prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t) (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t p) =
      branchCoefficientEquiv (TreeBranchDegrees t) (pathCoefficientsCast (treeBranchDegree_sum t).symm p) := by
    exact (prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t)).apply_symm_apply _
  have hq : prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t) (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t q) =
      branchCoefficientEquiv (TreeBranchDegrees t) (pathCoefficientsCast (treeBranchDegree_sum t).symm q) := by
    exact (prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t)).apply_symm_apply _
  rw [hp,hq]
  change _ = pathCoefficientDot n p q
  rw [branchInputDot,branchCoefficientEquiv_dot,pathCoefficientsCast_dot]

/-- Return the parent coefficient array to the original physical coordinate array. -/
def treeCoordinateReturn {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates n :=
  (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t).trans (originalWorkEquiv t).symm

lemma treeCoordinateReturn_dot {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (p q : PathCoefficients n) :
    physicalRateDot n (treeCoordinateReturn t p) (treeCoordinateReturn t q) = pathCoefficientDot n p q := by
  rw [← originalWorkEquiv_dot t]
  have hp : originalWorkEquiv t (treeCoordinateReturn t p) = parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t p :=
    (originalWorkEquiv t).apply_symm_apply _
  have hq : originalWorkEquiv t (treeCoordinateReturn t q) = parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t q :=
    (originalWorkEquiv t).apply_symm_apply _
  rw [hp,hq,parentCoefficientWorkEquiv_dot]

def treeCoordinateDet {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)
    (treeCoordinateReturn t).toLinearMap).det

/-- The global coordinate normalization has magnitude one, independently of rates. -/
theorem treeCoordinateDet_sq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : treeCoordinateDet t ^ 2 = 1 := by
  apply det_sq_of_basisDot_preserved (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n) (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)
  intro p q
  rw [arrayInput_basisDot,arrayOutput_basisDot]
  exact treeCoordinateReturn_dot t p q

/-- Child coefficient outputs and the actual root/edge-product data at an original rate vector. -/
def actualBranchInputs {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : BranchStepInputs (TreeBranchDegrees t) :=
  prepareFamilyEquiv (childEdgeCount t)
    ((fun c => normalizedPhysicalTree (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)),
      ((rateChart t x).1 0,fun c => x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val))

    (actualBranchInputs t x).1.1 =
      piScaledEquiv (childEdgeCount t) (fun c => (physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)).1) := by
  have h := prepareFamilyEquiv_apply (childEdgeCount t)
    ((fun c => normalizedPhysicalTree (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)),
      ((rateChart t x).1 0,fun c => x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val))
  simpa only [actualBranchInputs,normalizedPhysicalTree,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using
    congrArg (fun z : BranchStepInputs (TreeBranchDegrees t) => z.1.1) h

    (actualBranchInputs t x).1.2 =

  have h := prepareFamilyEquiv_apply (childEdgeCount t)
    ((fun c => normalizedPhysicalTree (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)),
      ((rateChart t x).1 0,fun c => x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val))
  simpa only [actualBranchInputs,normalizedPhysicalTree,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using
    congrArg (fun z : BranchStepInputs (TreeBranchDegrees t) => z.1.2) h

    (monicPoly (familyProduct (ChildFactorDegrees (TreeBranchDegrees t)) (actualBranchInputs t x).1.1) : ℝ[X]) =
      physicalRootCofactor t x := by
  rw [actualBranchInputs_denominators,piScaled_product,physicalRootCofactor_child_product]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun c _ => physicalCoefficientMap_first_reconstruct _ _)

lemma rootCoupling_endJacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (z : TreeWork t) :

  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) z),

      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (RootChild t)))),det_rootCouplingDerivative]

/-- Sibling resultant product in a fixed enumeration of the actual child polynomials. -/

  pairwiseResultants (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card (RootChild t)) =>

lemma actualBranchInputs_resultants {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials (ChildFactorDegrees (TreeBranchDegrees t))

  congr 1

lemma actualBranchInputs_weight {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :

        ∏ c : RootChild t, (x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val) ^ childEdgeCount t c := by

    (normalizedBranchStep (TreeBranchDegrees t)) _

  rw [treeChildStep_actual,normalizedBranchStep_jacobian,treeBranchDegree_sum,

/-! Actual all-rate branching-tree derivative induction step. Every local map,
physical child, and normalization was proved before applying this chain rule. -/
open Module Polynomial Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma treePipeline_differentiableAt {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hc : ∀ c : RootChild t, DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c)) (childRates t c x)) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (treePipeline t) (originalWorkEquiv t x) := by
  have hz : (rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x)).1 = fun c => childRates t c x := by
    rw [originalWorkEquiv_originalCoupling,rootCoupling_physical_coordinates]
  have hn : ∀ c : RootChild t,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (normalizedPhysicalTree (childTree t c))
        ((rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x)).1 c) := by
    intro c
    rw [hz]
    exact (coefficientArrayEquiv (childEdgeCount t c)).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp _ (hc c)
  exact (differentiable_treeLocalStep t _).comp _
    ((differentiableAt_treeChildStep t _ hn).comp _ (hasFDerivAt_rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) _).differentiableAt)

/-- The actual parent coefficient map is differentiable whenever the strictly
smaller actual child coefficient maps are. The later strong induction discharges this. -/
theorem physicalCoefficientMap_differentiableAt_of_children {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hc : ∀ c : RootChild t, DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c)) (childRates t c x)) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x := by
  have h := (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp x
    ((treePipeline_differentiableAt t x hc).comp x
      (originalWorkEquiv t).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt)
  have he : (fun y : TreeRates n => (parentCoefficientWorkEquiv t).symm
      (treePipeline t (originalWorkEquiv t y))) = physicalCoefficientMap t := by
    funext y
    rw [treePipeline_actual,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact he ▸ h

/-- The fixed coefficient-return map contributes its actual determinant, not a
numerically fitted or unspecified nonzero factor. -/
lemma treeCoordinateReturn_jacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x) :
    endJacobian (fun y => treeCoordinateReturn t (physicalCoefficientMap t y)) x =
      treeCoordinateDet t * treeCanonicalJacobian t x := by
  have h := (treeCoordinateReturn t).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp x hx.hasFDerivAt
  calc
    _ = LinearMap.det ((treeCoordinateReturn t).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        (fderiv ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x)).toLinearMap := endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt h
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (catenaryArrayInputBasis n)]
      change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _ ((treeCoordinateReturn t).toLinearMap.comp
        (fderiv ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x).toLinearMap)).det = _
      rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (catenaryArrayInputBasis n) (catenaryArrayOutputBasis n)
        (catenaryArrayInputBasis n),Matrix.det_mul]
      rfl

lemma treePipeline_jacobian_transport {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) x) :
    endJacobian (treePipeline t) (originalWorkEquiv t x) =
      treeCoordinateDet t * treeCanonicalJacobian t x := by
  have hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => treeCoordinateReturn t (physicalCoefficientMap t y)) x :=
    (treeCoordinateReturn t).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp x hx
  have h := endJacobian_linear_conjugate (originalWorkEquiv t).symm
    (fun y => treeCoordinateReturn t (physicalCoefficientMap t y)) (originalWorkEquiv t x)
    (by simpa only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using hf)
  have he : (fun z : TreeWork t => originalWorkEquiv t
      (treeCoordinateReturn t (physicalCoefficientMap t ((originalWorkEquiv t).symm z)))) = treePipeline t := by
    funext z
    have hh := treePipeline_actual t ((originalWorkEquiv t).symm z)
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hh
    exact (originalWorkEquiv t).apply_symm_apply _ |>.trans hh.symm
  change endJacobian (fun z : TreeWork t => originalWorkEquiv t
      (treeCoordinateReturn t (physicalCoefficientMap t ((originalWorkEquiv t).symm z)))) _ = _ at h
  rw [he,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,treeCoordinateReturn_jacobian t x hx] at h
  exact h

/-- Exact local physical factors a_c^(m_c+1) f_c^m_c for all root connectors. -/
def treeRootRateFactor {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  ∏ c : RootChild t, x.1 c.val ^ (childEdgeCount t c+1) *
    outwardByVertex x.2 c.val ^ childEdgeCount t c

lemma treeRootRateFactor_eq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (∏ c : RootChild t, (x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)^childEdgeCount t c) *
      (∏ c : RootChild t, x.1 c.val) = treeRootRateFactor t x := by
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro c _
  rw [mul_pow,pow_succ]
  ring

/-- The complete actual parent Jacobian recurrence, including singular rate
vectors. The only induction premises concern strictly smaller physical children. -/
theorem treeCanonicalJacobian_recurrence_of_children {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hc : ∀ c : RootChild t, DifferentiableAt ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c)) (childRates t c x)) :
    treeCoordinateDet t * treeCanonicalJacobian t x =
      (-1 : ℝ)^n * treeSiblingResultant t x ^ 2 * treeRootRateFactor t x *
        ∏ c : RootChild t, treeCanonicalJacobian (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) := by
  have hp := physicalCoefficientMap_differentiableAt_of_children t x hc
  rw [← treePipeline_jacobian_transport t x hp]
  have hCouple := (hasFDerivAt_rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x)).differentiableAt
  have hz : (rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x)).1 = fun c => childRates t c x := by
    rw [originalWorkEquiv_originalCoupling,rootCoupling_physical_coordinates]
  have hChild : DifferentiableAt ℝ (treeChildStep t)
      (rootCoupling (childLeakMap t) (originalWorkEquiv t x)) := by
    apply differentiableAt_treeChildStep
    intro c
    rw [hz]
    exact (coefficientArrayEquiv (childEdgeCount t c)).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp _ (hc c)
  rw [treePipeline,endJacobian_comp (differentiable_treeLocalStep t _) (hChild.comp _ hCouple),
    endJacobian_comp hChild hCouple,Function.comp_apply,treeLocalStep_actual_jacobian,
    treeChildStep_jacobian t _ (by simpa only [hz] using hc),rootCoupling_endJacobian]
  rw [hz,originalWorkEquiv_apply]
  simp only [childRates_leak]
  have hfac := treeRootRateFactor_eq t x
  rw [← hfac]
  ring

/-- UNCONDITIONAL all-size differentiability of the actual tree coefficient map. -/
theorem differentiable_physicalCoefficientMap {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Differentiable ℝ (physicalCoefficientMap t) := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro x
    apply physicalCoefficientMap_differentiableAt_of_children
    intro c
    exact ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)

/-- UNCONDITIONAL all-size, all-rate canonical physical Jacobian recurrence. -/
theorem treeCanonicalJacobian_recurrence {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    treeCoordinateDet t * treeCanonicalJacobian t x =
      (-1 : ℝ)^n * treeSiblingResultant t x ^ 2 * treeRootRateFactor t x *
        ∏ c : RootChild t, treeCanonicalJacobian (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) :=
  treeCanonicalJacobian_recurrence_of_children t x
    (fun c => differentiable_physicalCoefficientMap (childTree t c) (childRates t c x))

end HydrologyTree

/-! All-size all-rate Jacobian factorization of the actual physical branching
tree coefficient map, first in precise recursive subtree-product form. Exact
flattening to the original vertex set is proved in the subsequent module. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Fixed orientation depending only on the actual tree and coefficient ordering. -/
def treeProofOrientation {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : ℝ :=
  treeCoordinateDet t * (-1 : ℝ)^n * ∏ c : RootChild t, treeProofOrientation (childTree t c)
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

/-- Actual connector rate monomials and actual sibling resultants over every
subtree. This is not defined to be a Jacobian or to assume the factorization. -/
def allTreeJacobianWeight {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  treeSiblingResultant t x ^ 2 * treeRootRateFactor t x *
    ∏ c : RootChild t, allTreeJacobianWeight (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

lemma treeProofOrientation_sq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : treeProofOrientation t ^ 2 = 1 := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [treeProofOrientation,mul_pow,mul_pow,treeCoordinateDet_sq,one_mul]
    have hp : (∏ c : RootChild t, treeProofOrientation (childTree t c))^2 = 1 := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_pow]
      have hsub : ∀ c : RootChild t, treeProofOrientation (childTree t c)^2 = 1 :=
        fun c => ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c)
      simp only [hsub,Finset.prod_const_one]
    rw [hp,mul_one,← pow_mul,Nat.mul_comm n 2,pow_mul]
    norm_num

/-- The sign is fixed for the tree, not allowed to vary with the rate vector. -/
lemma treeProofOrientation_sign {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    treeProofOrientation t = 1 ∨ treeProofOrientation t = -1 :=
  real_sq_one_sign _ (treeProofOrientation_sq t)

/-- UNCONDITIONAL actual canonical Jacobian factorization for every finite
rooted tree and every real rate vector, including every zero-rate or repeated-root
boundary. Only fixed coordinate orientation remains outside the explicit factors. -/
theorem all_tree_canonical_jacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    treeCanonicalJacobian t x = treeProofOrientation t * allTreeJacobianWeight t x := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    have hsub : (∏ c : RootChild t, treeCanonicalJacobian (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)) =
        (∏ c : RootChild t, treeProofOrientation (childTree t c)) *
          (∏ c : RootChild t, allTreeJacobianWeight (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)) := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro c _
      exact ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)
    calc
      treeCanonicalJacobian t x = treeCoordinateDet t * (treeCoordinateDet t * treeCanonicalJacobian t x) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc,← pow_two,treeCoordinateDet_sq,one_mul]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [treeCanonicalJacobian_recurrence,hsub,treeProofOrientation,allTreeJacobianWeight]
        ring

/-- Quantified fixed-sign formulation: the same orientation works for all rates. -/
theorem all_tree_canonical_jacobian_fixed_sign {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, (ε=1 ∨ ε= -1) ∧ ∀ x : TreeRates n,
      treeCanonicalJacobian t x = ε * allTreeJacobianWeight t x :=
  ⟨treeProofOrientation t,treeProofOrientation_sign t,all_tree_canonical_jacobian t⟩

/-- The all-rate orientation-independent polynomial identity. -/
theorem all_tree_canonical_jacobian_sq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    treeCanonicalJacobian t x ^ 2 = allTreeJacobianWeight t x ^ 2 := by
  rw [all_tree_canonical_jacobian,mul_pow,treeProofOrientation_sq,one_mul]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Flatten exact recursive factors onto the ORIGINAL finite vertex and edge
sets. Subtrees are the previously constructed actual principal child models. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- The number of vertices of the actual rooted principal subtree at vertex v. -/
def subtreeVertexCount {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) : ℕ :=
  match (numberedRootEquiv t).symm v with
  | .inl _ => n+1
  | .inr ⟨c,i⟩ => subtreeVertexCount (childTree t c) i
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

@[simp] lemma subtreeVertexCount_root {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    subtreeVertexCount t 0 = n+1 := by
  change subtreeVertexCount t (numberedRootEquiv t (.inl ())) = _
  rw [subtreeVertexCount,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

@[simp] lemma subtreeVertexCount_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (c : RootChild t) (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) :
    subtreeVertexCount t (childEnumeration t c i).val = subtreeVertexCount (childTree t c) i := by
  change subtreeVertexCount t (numberedRootEquiv t (.inr ⟨c,i⟩)) = _
  rw [subtreeVertexCount,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

lemma subtreeVertexCount_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    0 < subtreeVertexCount t v := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    obtain ⟨u,rfl⟩ := (numberedRootEquiv t).surjective v
    rcases u with u | ⟨c,i⟩
    · cases u
      rw [numberedRootEquiv_zero,subtreeVertexCount_root]
      omega
    · rw [numberedRootEquiv_child,subtreeVertexCount_child]
      exact ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c) i

/-- Actual local quantity at the original vertex, via the proved child-principal transport. -/
def subtreeNodeValue {α : Type*}
    (f : {m : ℕ} → OrderedTree m → TreeRates m → α)
    {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (v : Fin (n+1)) : α :=
  match (numberedRootEquiv t).symm v with
  | .inl _ => f t x
  | .inr ⟨c,i⟩ => subtreeNodeValue f (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) i
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

@[simp] lemma subtreeNodeValue_root {α : Type*}
    (f : {m : ℕ} → OrderedTree m → TreeRates m → α)
    {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : subtreeNodeValue f t x 0 = f t x := by
  change subtreeNodeValue f t x (numberedRootEquiv t (.inl ())) = _
  rw [subtreeNodeValue,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

@[simp] lemma subtreeNodeValue_child {α : Type*}
    (f : {m : ℕ} → OrderedTree m → TreeRates m → α)
    {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (c : RootChild t)
    (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) :
    subtreeNodeValue f t x (childEnumeration t c i).val =
      subtreeNodeValue f (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) i := by
  change subtreeNodeValue f t x (numberedRootEquiv t (.inr ⟨c,i⟩)) = _
  rw [subtreeNodeValue,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

lemma original_node_product_recursion {α : Type*} [CommMonoid α]
    (f : {m : ℕ} → OrderedTree m → TreeRates m → α)
    {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (∏ v : Fin (n+1), subtreeNodeValue f t x v) = f t x *
      ∏ c : RootChild t, ∏ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1),
        subtreeNodeValue f (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) i := by
  rw [← (numberedRootEquiv t).prod_comp (fun v => subtreeNodeValue f t x v),Fintype.prod_sum_type]
  simp only [Fintype.prod_unique,Fintype.prod_sigma,numberedRootEquiv_zero,
    numberedRootEquiv_child,subtreeNodeValue_root,subtreeNodeValue_child]
  have hd : (default : Unit) = () := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hd,numberedRootEquiv_zero,subtreeNodeValue_root]

/-- The exact rate monomial, indexed by every original directed edge pair. -/
def originalTreeRateMonomial {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  ∏ e : Fin n, x.1 e.succ ^ subtreeVertexCount t e.succ *
    x.2 e ^ (subtreeVertexCount t e.succ-1)

lemma originalTreeRateMonomial_recursion {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    originalTreeRateMonomial t x = treeRootRateFactor t x *
      ∏ c : RootChild t, originalTreeRateMonomial (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) := by
  rw [originalTreeRateMonomial,← (numberedEdgeEquiv t).prod_comp,Fintype.prod_sigma,
    treeRootRateFactor,← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro c _
  have hs (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) :
      (numberedEdgeEquiv t ⟨c,i⟩).succ = (childEnumeration t c i).val :=
    numberedEdgeIndex_succ t ⟨c,i⟩
  simp only [hs,outward_at_numbered_child]
  change (∏ i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1),
      x.1 (childEnumeration t c i).val ^ subtreeVertexCount t (childEnumeration t c i).val *
      outwardByVertex x.2 (childEnumeration t c i).val ^
        (subtreeVertexCount t (childEnumeration t c i).val-1)) = _
  simp only [subtreeVertexCount_child,Fin.prod_univ_succ,childEnumeration_zero,
    subtreeVertexCount_root,Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  congr 1

/-- Squared actual sibling-resultant factors at every original vertex. -/
def originalTreeSiblingProduct {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  ∏ v : Fin (n+1), subtreeNodeValue (fun {m} (s : OrderedTree m) y => treeSiblingResultant s y ^ 2) t x v

lemma originalTreeSiblingProduct_recursion {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    originalTreeSiblingProduct t x = treeSiblingResultant t x ^ 2 *
      ∏ c : RootChild t, originalTreeSiblingProduct (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) := by
  exact original_node_product_recursion _ t x

/-- The recursive factor is exactly the original-vertex rate/subtree formula. -/
theorem allTreeJacobianWeight_eq_original_products {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    allTreeJacobianWeight t x = originalTreeRateMonomial t x * originalTreeSiblingProduct t x := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [allTreeJacobianWeight,originalTreeRateMonomial_recursion,originalTreeSiblingProduct_recursion]
    have he : (∏ c : RootChild t, allTreeJacobianWeight (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)) =
        (∏ c : RootChild t, originalTreeRateMonomial (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)) *
          (∏ c : RootChild t, originalTreeSiblingProduct (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)) := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
      exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun c _ => ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c)
        (childTree t c) (childRates t c x))
    rw [he]
    ring

/-- Full all-size all-real-rate formula in ORIGINAL edge and vertex indices.
The fixed sign has been proved, including every zero-rate/repeated-root boundary. -/
theorem full_tree_standard_jacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, (ε=1 ∨ ε= -1) ∧ ∀ x : TreeRates n,
      treeCanonicalJacobian t x = ε * originalTreeRateMonomial t x * originalTreeSiblingProduct t x := by
  refine ⟨treeProofOrientation t,treeProofOrientation_sign t,?_⟩
  intro x
  rw [all_tree_canonical_jacobian,allTreeJacobianWeight_eq_original_products]
  ring

end HydrologyTree

/-! Exact tree allocation counts on the original labelled vertex set. These
finite counts are linked to actual positive parameter fibers in the next module. -/
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Recursive labelled-allocation count; it does not yet stand for an actual
parameter fiber until the exhaustive fiber theorem is applied. -/
def treeFiberDegree {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : ℕ :=
  Fintype.card (TreePoleAllocation t) * ∏ c : RootChild t, treeFiberDegree (childTree t c)
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

/-- Product of actual subtree vertex counts over all ORIGINAL nonroot vertices. -/
def treeHookProduct {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : ℕ :=
  ∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount t e.succ

lemma treeHookProduct_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : 0 < treeHookProduct t :=
  Finset.prod_pos (fun e _ => subtreeVertexCount_pos t e.succ)

lemma treeHookProduct_recursion {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    treeHookProduct t = ∏ c : RootChild t,
      (childEdgeCount t c+1)*treeHookProduct (childTree t c) := by
  rw [treeHookProduct,← (numberedEdgeEquiv t).prod_comp,Fintype.prod_sigma]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro c _
  have hs (i : Fin (childEdgeCount t c+1)) :
      (numberedEdgeEquiv t ⟨c,i⟩).succ = (childEnumeration t c i).val :=
    numberedEdgeIndex_succ t ⟨c,i⟩
  simp only [hs,subtreeVertexCount_child,Fin.prod_univ_succ,subtreeVertexCount_root]
  rfl

/-- Exact factorial identity, including the singleton tree. In particular it
proves the integrality of the eventual quotient instead of assuming it. -/
theorem treeFiberDegree_mul_hook {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    treeFiberDegree t * treeHookProduct t = n.factorial := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [treeFiberDegree,treeHookProduct_recursion,mul_assoc,← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    have hf (c : RootChild t) : treeFiberDegree (childTree t c) *
        ((childEdgeCount t c+1)*treeHookProduct (childTree t c)) =
        (childEdgeCount t c+1).factorial := by
      calc
        _ = (childEdgeCount t c+1) *
          (treeFiberDegree (childTree t c)*treeHookProduct (childTree t c)) := by ring
        _ = (childEdgeCount t c+1)*(childEdgeCount t c).factorial := by
          rw [ih _ (childEdgeCount_lt t c)]
        _ = (childEdgeCount t c+1).factorial := (Nat.factorial_succ _).symm
    simp only [hf]
    exact sizedAllocation_card_factorial (numberedEdgeEquiv t)

/-- All-size hook-length expression on the original tree, not a recursive
symbolic count and not a table of small cases. -/
theorem treeFiberDegree_eq_factorial_quotient {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    treeFiberDegree t = n.factorial / (∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount t e.succ) := by
  change treeFiberDegree t = n.factorial / treeHookProduct t
  rw [← treeFiberDegree_mul_hook t]
  exact (Nat.mul_div_cancel _ (treeHookProduct_pos t)).symm

lemma treeFiberDegree_pos {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : 0 < treeFiberDegree t := by
  have h := Nat.factorial_pos n
  rw [← treeFiberDegree_mul_hook t] at h
  apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
  intro hz
  simpa [hz] using h

end HydrologyTree

/-! Complete all-size positive realization count for the actual physical model.
The finiteness statement is proved separately, so Nat.card cannot silently
encode an infinite fiber by zero. The main theorem leaves no child-fiber count,
allocation-completeness, positivity or inverse-realization assertion unproved. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Actual positive full-response fibers are finite and have exactly the
recursive labelled-allocation degree. All smaller-fiber obligations are discharged
by strong induction, not hypotheses of the final theorem. -/
theorem positive_stieltjes_fiber_finite_card {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    Finite (PositiveStieltjesFiber t r w) ∧
      Nat.card (PositiveStieltjesFiber t r w)=treeFiberDegree t := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    obtain ⟨b,g,d,hb,hbpos,hg,hF,hP,hl⟩ :=
      exists_positive_reciprocal_data_unordered r w hr hpos hw hm
    have hc (a : TreePoleAllocation t) (c : RootChild t) :
        Finite (PositiveStieltjesFiber (childTree t c) (allocatedRates b a c) (allocatedWeights t g a c)) ∧
        Nat.card (PositiveStieltjesFiber (childTree t c) (allocatedRates b a c) (allocatedWeights t g a c)) =
          treeFiberDegree (childTree t c) :=
      ih _ (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c)
        (allocatedRates b a c) (allocatedWeights t g a c)
        (allocatedRates_injective t b hb.injective a c) (fun i => hbpos _)
        (allocatedWeights_pos t g hg a c) (allocatedWeights_sum t g hg a c)
    letI : ∀ (a : TreePoleAllocation t) (c : RootChild t),
        Finite (PositiveStieltjesFiber (childTree t c) (allocatedRates b a c) (allocatedWeights t g a c)) :=
      fun a c => (hc a c).1
    let e := positiveReciprocalFiberEquiv t b g d hb.injective hbpos hg hl
    have hf : Finite (PositiveReciprocalFiber t b g d) := Finite.of_injective e e.injective
    have hcard : Nat.card (PositiveReciprocalFiber t b g d) = treeFiberDegree t := by
      rw [Nat.card_congr e,Nat.card_sigma]
      calc
        (∑ a : TreePoleAllocation t, Nat.card (AllocatedChildFibers t b g a)) =
            ∑ _a : TreePoleAllocation t, ∏ c : RootChild t, treeFiberDegree (childTree t c) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a _
          rw [Nat.card_pi]
          exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun c _ => (hc a c).2)
        _ = Fintype.card (TreePoleAllocation t) * ∏ c : RootChild t, treeFiberDegree (childTree t c) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Nat.nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ = treeFiberDegree t := by rw [treeFiberDegree]
    change Finite (PositivePolynomialFiber t (stieltjesDenominator r) (stieltjesNumerator r w)) ∧
      Nat.card (PositivePolynomialFiber t (stieltjesDenominator r) (stieltjesNumerator r w)) = _
    rw [hP,hF]
    exact ⟨hf,hcard⟩

/-- The complete exact positive-fiber theorem in ORIGINAL tree coordinates:
for a tree with n+1 vertices, exactly n! / product_(v≠root) |T_v| distinct
strictly positive rate vectors realize the specified full Stieltjes pair.
Store labels are retained; no quotient by tree automorphisms is being taken. -/
theorem positive_stieltjes_fiber_exact_card {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    Finite (PositiveStieltjesFiber t r w) ∧
      Nat.card (PositiveStieltjesFiber t r w) =
        n.factorial / (∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount t e.succ) := by
  obtain ⟨hf,hc⟩ := positive_stieltjes_fiber_finite_card t r w hr hpos hw hm
  exact ⟨hf,hc.trans (treeFiberDegree_eq_factorial_quotient t)⟩

/-- The exact count depends only on topology, not on the distinct positive poles
or normalized positive weights of the full target response. -/
theorem positive_stieltjes_card_independent_of_response {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w q v : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1)
    (hq : Function.Injective q) (hqpos : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hv : ∀ i, 0 < v i) (hn : (∑ i, v i)=1) :
    Nat.card (PositiveStieltjesFiber t r w)=Nat.card (PositiveStieltjesFiber t q v) := by
  rw [(positive_stieltjes_fiber_finite_card t r w hr hpos hw hm).2,
    (positive_stieltjes_fiber_finite_card t q v hq hqpos hv hn).2]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Exact Jacobian regularity for actual branching trees with nonzero internal
rates. The full determinant, rather than a presumed minimality equivalence,
is the input proved by the preceding all-tree induction. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma list_map_prod_ne_zero {α : Type*} (f : α → ℝ) (l : List α) :
    (l.map f).prod ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ a ∈ l, f a ≠ 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih => simp [ih]

lemma monic_resultant_ne_zero_iff (p q : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.Monic) :
    p.resultant q ≠ 0 ↔ IsCoprime p q := by
  rw [← isUnit_iff_ne_zero,Polynomial.isUnit_resultant_iff_isCoprime hp]

lemma pairwiseResultants_ne_zero_iff (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hm : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Monic) :
    pairwiseResultants ps ≠ 0 ↔ ps.Pairwise IsCoprime := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp [pairwiseResultants]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hp : p.Monic := hm p (by simp)
    have ht : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.Monic := fun q hq => hm q (by simp [hq])
    simp only [pairwiseResultants,mul_ne_zero_iff,List.pairwise_cons]
    rw [list_map_prod_ne_zero,ih ht]
    exact and_congr (forall_congr' fun q => forall_congr' fun _ =>
      monic_resultant_ne_zero_iff p q hp) Iff.rfl

lemma treeSiblingResultant_ne_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    treeSiblingResultant t x ≠ 0 ↔
      ∀ c d : RootChild t, c ≠ d → IsCoprime (childCharacteristic t x c) (childCharacteristic t x d) := by
  let e := Fintype.equivFin (RootChild t)
  have hm : ∀ p ∈ List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card (RootChild t)) => childCharacteristic t x (e.symm i)),
      p.Monic := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hp
    exact physicalCharacteristic_monic _ _
  rw [treeSiblingResultant,pairwiseResultants_ne_zero_iff _ hm,List.pairwise_ofFn]
  constructor
  · intro h c d hcd
    have hn : e c ≠ e d := fun he => hcd (e.injective he)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hn with hlt | hgt
    · simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using h hlt
    · simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using (h hgt).symm
  · intro h i j hij
    exact h _ _ (fun he => (ne_of_lt hij) (e.symm.injective he))

lemma treeRootRateFactor_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) : treeRootRateFactor t x ≠ 0 := by
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro c _
  exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (inward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx c.val c.property.1))
    (pow_ne_zero _ (outward_nonroot_ne_zero x hx c.val c.property.1))

lemma real_square_ne_zero_iff (a : ℝ) : a^2 ≠ 0 ↔ a ≠ 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h ha
    apply h
    rw [ha]
    norm_num
  · exact pow_ne_zero 2

/-- All recursive factors are nonzero precisely when each actual sibling
polynomial family is coprime. There is no positivity premise. -/
theorem allTreeWeight_ne_zero_iff_coprime {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) :
    allTreeJacobianWeight t x ≠ 0 ↔ CoprimeAtEveryBranch t x := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    have hchildren : (∏ c : RootChild t, allTreeJacobianWeight (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)) ≠ 0 ↔
        ∀ c : RootChild t, CoprimeAtEveryBranch (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) := by
      simp only [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff,Finset.mem_univ,true_implies]
      exact forall_congr' fun c => ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c)
        (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) (nonzero_child_edges t c x hx)
    rw [allTreeJacobianWeight,mul_ne_zero_iff,mul_ne_zero_iff,real_square_ne_zero_iff,
      treeSiblingResultant_ne_zero_iff,hchildren,CoprimeAtEveryBranch]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hs,_⟩,hc⟩
      exact ⟨hs,hc⟩
    · rintro ⟨hs,hc⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hs,treeRootRateFactor_ne_zero t x hx⟩,hc⟩

/-- Actual full coefficient-map regularity, not the simpler matrix-coordinate
Jacobian: every nonzero-edge real reference is regular iff all siblings are coprime. -/
theorem treeJacobian_ne_zero_iff_coprime {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x) : treeCanonicalJacobian t x ≠ 0 ↔ CoprimeAtEveryBranch t x := by
  have he : treeProofOrientation t ≠ 0 := by
    rcases treeProofOrientation_sign t with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  rw [all_tree_canonical_jacobian,mul_ne_zero_iff,allTreeWeight_ne_zero_iff_coprime t x hx]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2,fun h => ⟨he,h⟩⟩

lemma coprime_no_common_aeval {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℝ K]
    (p q : ℝ[X]) (hpq : IsCoprime p q) (z : K) :
    ¬(aeval z p = 0 ∧ aeval z q = 0) := by
  rintro ⟨hp,hq⟩
  obtain ⟨a,b,h⟩ := hpq
  have hval := congrArg (fun r : ℝ[X] => aeval z r) h
  simp only [map_add,map_mul,map_one,hp,hq,mul_zero,zero_add] at hval
  exact zero_ne_one hval

/-- Coprime actual sibling polynomials exclude common roots over every real
field extension, not only at a finite set of tested eigenvalues. -/
theorem coprime_branches_no_sibling_collisions {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℝ K]
    {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (hcop : CoprimeAtEveryBranch t x) :
    ∀ z : K, ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [CoprimeAtEveryBranch] at hcop
    intro z hz
    rw [SiblingCollisionSomewhere] at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨c,d,hcd,hc,hd⟩ | ⟨c,hc⟩
    · exact coprime_no_common_aeval _ _ (hcop.1 c d hcd) z ⟨hc,hd⟩
    · exact ih (childEdgeCount t c) (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c)
        (childRates t c x) (hcop.2 c) z hc

end HydrologyTree

trees. No controllability, ODE identification or global fiber-count claim is
made without its corresponding theorem. -/

/-- Positive physical edges: regularity of the full actual coefficient Jacobian
is exactly absence of sibling spectral collisions anywhere in the real tree. -/
theorem positive_tree_jacobian_iff_no_collision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    treeCanonicalJacobian t x ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ z : ℝ, ¬SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  have hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x := ⟨fun e => ne_of_gt (ha e),fun e => ne_of_gt (hf e)⟩
  rw [treeJacobian_ne_zero_iff_coprime t x hx]
  exact ⟨coprime_branches_no_sibling_collisions t x,
    coprime_branches_of_no_spectral_collision t x ha hf⟩

/-- A positive-rate reference is singular exactly when an actual sibling
spectral collision exists; no unproved observability premise is present. -/
theorem positive_tree_jacobian_zero_iff_collision {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)

    treeCanonicalJacobian t x = 0 ↔ ∃ z : ℝ, SiblingCollisionSomewhere t x z := by
  classical
  have h := positive_tree_jacobian_iff_no_collision t x ha hf
  constructor
  · intro hj
    by_contra hn
    exact (h.mpr (by simpa only [not_exists] using hn)) hj
  · rintro ⟨z,hz⟩
    by_contra hj
    exact (h.mp hj) z hz

matrix; this does not silently replace them with a cancelled transfer fraction. -/
theorem positive_tree_jacobian_iff_no_cancellation {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.1 e.succ) (hf : ∀ e : Fin n, 0 < x.2 e) :
    treeCanonicalJacobian t x ≠ 0 ↔ NoRealPhysicalCancellation t x := by
  have hx : NonzeroTreeEdges x := ⟨fun e => ne_of_gt (ha e),fun e => ne_of_gt (hf e)⟩
  rw [positive_tree_jacobian_iff_no_collision t x ha hf,
    noCancellation_iff_noSiblingCollision t x hx]

are equivalent to nonsingularity of the ACTUAL coefficient Jacobian. -/
theorem positive_tree_jacobian_iff_full_modes {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)

  rw [positive_tree_jacobian_iff_no_collision t x ha hf,

is not uniqueness from the root response without specifying the assignment. -/
theorem regular_tree_assignment_unique {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)

import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic

/-! Resultant algebra with actual polynomial degrees. Monicity removes the
artificial right-degree padding, including zero polynomials and zero scales. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma monic_resultant_right_degree (f g : ℝ[X]) (hf : f.Monic)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : g.natDegree ≤ N) :
    f.resultant g f.natDegree N = f.resultant g := by
  have h := Polynomial.resultant_add_right_deg f g f.natDegree g.natDegree
    (N-g.natDegree) le_rfl
  rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hN,Polynomial.coeff_natDegree,hf,one_pow,one_mul] at h
  exact h

/-- Addition of an arbitrary multiple of a monic left factor does not change
its resultant. The right polynomial's degree is allowed to drop. -/
theorem monic_resultant_add_multiple (f g p : ℝ[X]) (hf : f.Monic) :
    f.resultant (g+f*p) = f.resultant g := by
  let N := (g+f*p).natDegree + g.natDegree + p.natDegree + f.natDegree
  have hg : g.natDegree ≤ N := by dsimp [N]; omega
  have hgp : (g+f*p).natDegree ≤ N := by dsimp [N]; omega
  have hp : p.natDegree + f.natDegree ≤ N := by dsimp [N]; omega
  rw [← monic_resultant_right_degree f (g+f*p) hf N hgp,
    Polynomial.resultant_add_mul_right f g p f.natDegree N hp le_rfl,
    monic_resultant_right_degree f g hf N hg]

/-- Multiplicativity in the right factor at actual degrees, including zero factors. -/
theorem monic_resultant_mul_right (f g h : ℝ[X]) (hf : f.Monic) :
    f.resultant (g*h) = f.resultant g * f.resultant h := by
  rw [← monic_resultant_right_degree f (g*h) hf (g.natDegree+h.natDegree)
    Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le]
  exact Polynomial.resultant_mul_right f g h f.natDegree le_rfl

lemma monic_resultant_mul_left (f g h : ℝ[X]) (hf : f.Monic) (hg : g.Monic) :
    (f*g).resultant h = f.resultant h * g.resultant h := by
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_mul hf.ne_zero hg.ne_zero]
  exact Polynomial.resultant_mul_left f g h h.natDegree le_rfl

/-- Scaling formula valid even when c=0 drops the right polynomial's degree. -/
theorem monic_resultant_scale (f g : ℝ[X]) (hf : f.Monic) (c : ℝ) :
    f.resultant (C c*g) = c^f.natDegree * f.resultant g := by
  rw [monic_resultant_mul_right f (C c) g hf]
  simp only [Polynomial.natDegree_C,Polynomial.resultant_C_zero_right]

/-- Exact gluing resultant identity for arbitrary monic denominator blocks.
No numerator degree bound, coprimality or nonzero connector premise is used. -/
theorem monic_resultant_glue (u v r s : ℝ[X]) (hu : u.Monic) (hv : v.Monic) :
    (u*v).resultant (r*v+u*s) =
      (-1 : ℝ)^(u.natDegree*v.natDegree) *
        u.resultant r * v.resultant s * (u.resultant v)^2 := by
  rw [monic_resultant_mul_left u v _ hu hv,
    monic_resultant_add_multiple u (r*v) s hu]
  have he : r*v+u*s = u*s+v*r := by ring
  rw [he,monic_resultant_add_multiple v (u*s) r hv,
    monic_resultant_mul_right u r v hu,monic_resultant_mul_right v u s hv,
    Polynomial.resultant_comm v u]
  rw [Nat.mul_comm v.natDegree u.natDegree]
  ring

end HydrologyTree

The sign depends only on degrees, not roots, numerators, or parameter values. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Degree-only sign from swapping the sibling resultants. -/
def resultantPairSign : List ℕ → ℝ
  | [] => 1
  | m :: ms => (-1 : ℝ)^(m*ms.sum) * resultantPairSign ms

lemma resultantPairSign_sq (ms : List ℕ) : resultantPairSign ms ^ 2 = 1 := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => norm_num [resultantPairSign]
  | cons m ms ih =>
    rw [resultantPairSign,mul_pow,ih,mul_one,← pow_mul,Nat.mul_comm (m*ms.sum) 2,pow_mul]
    norm_num

/-- The actual numerator sum, in recursive product form with no divisions. -/
def resultantFamilyNumerator : List (ℝ[X] × ℝ[X]) → ℝ[X]
  | [] => 0
  | q :: qs => q.2 * (qs.map Prod.fst).prod + q.1 * resultantFamilyNumerator qs

lemma monic_pair_factors (qs : List (ℝ[X] × ℝ[X])) (h : ∀ q ∈ qs, q.1.Monic) :
    ∀ p ∈ qs.map Prod.fst, p.Monic := by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hp
  exact h q hq

/-- Full signed product identity at every coefficient vector. Singular and
zero-numerator specializations are included; no root distinctness is needed. -/
theorem resultant_family_factorization (qs : List (ℝ[X] × ℝ[X]))
    (h : ∀ q ∈ qs, q.1.Monic) :
    (qs.map Prod.fst).prod.resultant (resultantFamilyNumerator qs) =
      resultantPairSign (qs.map fun q => q.1.natDegree) *
        (qs.map fun q => q.1.resultant q.2).prod *
        pairwiseResultants (qs.map Prod.fst)^2 := by
  induction qs with
  | nil => simp [resultantFamilyNumerator,resultantPairSign,pairwiseResultants]
  | cons q qs ih =>
    have hq := h q (by simp)
    have ht : ∀ r ∈ qs, r.1.Monic := fun r hr => h r (by simp [hr])
    have hm := monic_pair_factors qs ht
    rw [List.map_cons,List.prod_cons,resultantFamilyNumerator,
      monic_resultant_glue q.1 (qs.map Prod.fst).prod q.2

/-! Exact finite-family enumeration of the physical numerator sum.
Index conversion preserves all terms, including repeated polynomial values. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]

def finiteResultantNumerator (s : Finset ι) (p r : ι → ℝ[X]) : ℝ[X] :=
  ∑ i ∈ s, r i * ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, p j

lemma finiteResultantNumerator_insert (s : Finset ι) (p r : ι → ℝ[X])
    (a : ι) (ha : a ∉ s) :
    finiteResultantNumerator (insert a s) p r =
      r a * (∏ i ∈ s, p i) + p a * finiteResultantNumerator s p r := by
  rw [finiteResultantNumerator,Finset.sum_insert ha,Finset.erase_insert ha]
  congr 1
  rw [finiteResultantNumerator,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hia : i ≠ a := by intro h; exact ha (h ▸ hi)
  have hae : a ∉ s.erase i := fun h => ha (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase h)
  rw [Finset.erase_insert_of_ne (Ne.symm hia),Finset.prod_insert hae]
  ring

lemma resultantFamilyNumerator_map (l : List ι) (hl : l.Nodup) (p r : ι → ℝ[X]) :
    resultantFamilyNumerator (l.map fun i => (p i,r i)) = finiteResultantNumerator l.toFinset p r := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [resultantFamilyNumerator,finiteResultantNumerator]
  | cons a l ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha,hl⟩ := List.nodup_cons.mp hl
    rw [List.map_cons,resultantFamilyNumerator,List.toFinset_cons,
      finiteResultantNumerator_insert l.toFinset p r a (by simpa using ha),ih hl]
    rw [List.map_map]
    rw [List.prod_toFinset p hl]
    rfl

/-- Rate-independent enumeration of a finite index type. -/
def resultantEnumeration (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] : List ι :=
  List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card ι) => (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm i)

lemma resultantEnumeration_nodup [Fintype ι] : (resultantEnumeration ι).Nodup :=
  List.nodup_ofFn_ofInjective (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm.injective

lemma resultantEnumeration_toFinset [Fintype ι] : (resultantEnumeration ι).toFinset = Finset.univ := by
  ext i
  simp only [List.mem_toFinset,Finset.mem_univ,iff_true,resultantEnumeration,List.mem_ofFn]
  exact ⟨(Fintype.equivFin ι) i,(Fintype.equivFin ι).symm_apply_apply i⟩

lemma resultantEnumeration_prod [Fintype ι] {α : Type*} [CommMonoid α] (f : ι → α) :
    ((resultantEnumeration ι).map f).prod = ∏ i, f i := by
  rw [← List.prod_toFinset f resultantEnumeration_nodup,resultantEnumeration_toFinset]

lemma resultantFamilyNumerator_enumeration [Fintype ι] (p r : ι → ℝ[X]) :
    resultantFamilyNumerator ((resultantEnumeration ι).map fun i => (p i,r i)) =
      ∑ i, r i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, p j := by
  rw [resultantFamilyNumerator_map _ resultantEnumeration_nodup,
    resultantEnumeration_toFinset]
  rfl

/-- Exact signed finite-family formula in the ordinary product/sum notation. -/
theorem finite_family_signed_resultant [Fintype ι] (p r : ι → ℝ[X]) (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Monic) :
    (∏ i, p i).resultant (∑ i, r i * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, p j) =
      resultantPairSign ((resultantEnumeration ι).map fun i => (p i).natDegree) *
        (∏ i, (p i).resultant (r i)) *
        pairwiseResultants ((resultantEnumeration ι).map p)^2 := by
  have hm : ∀ q ∈ (resultantEnumeration ι).map (fun i => (p i,r i)), q.1.Monic := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨i,_,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hq
    exact hp i
  have h := resultant_family_factorization _ hm
  have hden : (((resultantEnumeration ι).map fun i => (p i,r i)).map Prod.fst).prod = ∏ i, p i := by
    rw [List.map_map]
    exact resultantEnumeration_prod p
  rw [hden,resultantFamilyNumerator_enumeration] at h
  simpa only [List.map_map,Function.comp_def,resultantEnumeration_prod] using h

end HydrologyTree

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Degree-only sign for the actual root's fixed child enumeration. -/
def treeLocalResultantSign {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : ℝ :=
  (-1 : ℝ)^n * resultantPairSign ((resultantEnumeration (RootChild t)).map
    fun c => childEdgeCount t c+1)

lemma treeLocalResultantSign_sq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : treeLocalResultantSign t ^ 2 = 1 := by
  rw [treeLocalResultantSign,mul_pow,resultantPairSign_sq,mul_one,
    ← pow_mul,Nat.mul_comm n 2,pow_mul]
  norm_num

/-- The actual characteristic/cofactor resultant, not a reduced fraction or a
recursively prescribed replacement for the physical polynomial pair. -/
def physicalResultant {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (physicalCharacteristic t x).resultant (physicalRootCofactor t x)

/-- An exact all-rate, all-size recurrence, retaining the complete constants
and signs omitted by zero-set-only cancellation classifications. -/
theorem physicalResultant_child_recursion {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    physicalResultant t x = treeLocalResultantSign t * treeSiblingResultant t x ^ 2 *
      ∏ c : RootChild t, (x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)^(childEdgeCount t c+1) *
        physicalResultant (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) := by
  let p := childCharacteristic t x
  let r := fun c : RootChild t => C (x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val) * childCofactor t x c
  have hm (c : RootChild t) : (p c).Monic := physicalCharacteristic_monic _ _
  have hr := resultant_root_update (physicalRootCofactor t x)
    (∑ c : RootChild t, r c * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, p j)
    (physicalCharacteristic t x) (physicalRootCofactor_monic t x) ((rateChart t x).1 0)
    (by rw [physicalRootCofactor_child_product]; exact physicalCharacteristic_child_recursion t x)
    (by rw [physicalCharacteristic_natDegree,physicalRootCofactor_natDegree])
  have hd (c : RootChild t) : (p c).natDegree = childEdgeCount t c+1 :=
    physicalCharacteristic_natDegree _ _
  have hscale (c : RootChild t) : (p c).resultant (r c) =
      (x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)^(childEdgeCount t c+1) *
        physicalResultant (childTree t c) (childRates t c x) := by
    have h := monic_resultant_scale (p c) (childCofactor t x c) (hm c)
      (x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)
    exact h.trans (congrArg (fun k : ℕ =>
      (x.1 c.val*outwardByVertex x.2 c.val)^k *
        physicalResultant (childTree t c) (childRates t c x)) (hd c))
  have he : pairwiseResultants ((resultantEnumeration (RootChild t)).map p) =
      treeSiblingResultant t x := by
    simp only [resultantEnumeration,List.map_ofFn,Function.comp_def,treeSiblingResultant,p]
  have hr' : physicalResultant t x = (-1 : ℝ)^n *
      (physicalRootCofactor t x).resultant
        (∑ c : RootChild t, r c * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, p j) := by
    exact hr.trans (congrArg (fun k : ℕ => (-1 : ℝ)^k *
      (physicalRootCofactor t x).resultant
        (∑ c : RootChild t, r c * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, p j))
      (physicalRootCofactor_natDegree t x))
  rw [hr',physicalRootCofactor_child_product]
  change (-1 : ℝ)^n * (∏ c : RootChild t, p c).resultant
    (∑ c : RootChild t, r c * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase c, p j) = _
  rw [finite_family_signed_resultant p r hm,he]
  simp only [hscale]
  have hdegrees : ((resultantEnumeration (RootChild t)).map fun c => (p c).natDegree) =
      ((resultantEnumeration (RootChild t)).map fun c => childEdgeCount t c+1) := by
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro c _
    exact hd c
  rw [hdegrees]
  unfold treeLocalResultantSign
  ring

end HydrologyTree

    obtain ⟨⟨u,ell,f⟩,rfl⟩ := (prependRateEquiv n).surjective x
    rw [path_characteristic_recursion, path_cofactor_recursion]
    apply isCoprime_root_step _ _ _ _ (mul_ne_zero (ha 0) (hf 0))
    exact ih u (fun i => ha i.succ) (fun i => hf i.succ)

/-- If one rational response is represented by coprime polynomials of full
prescribed degree, any other monic representation of that same degree agrees. -/
theorem full_degree_fraction_unique (P F Q G : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P.Monic) (hQ : Q.Monic) (hdeg : Q.natDegree = P.natDegree)
    (hcop : IsCoprime P F) (h : F*Q = G*P) : P = Q ∧ F = G := by
  have hdvd : P ∣ Q := hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (by rw [h]; exact dvd_mul_left P G)
  have he : P = Q := (Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hP hQ hdvd hdeg.le).symm
  constructor
  · exact he
  · rw [← he] at h
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hP.ne_zero h

/-- Input/output transfer equality, expressed as a polynomial rational-function
identity, implies equality of all coefficients for a noncancelling reference path.
The alternative model's internal rates are arbitrary. -/
theorem catenary_response_identifies_coefficients (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ i : Fin n, x.2 i ≠ 0)
    (h : physicalRootCofactor (pathTree n) x * physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) y =
      physicalRootCofactor (pathTree n) y * physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) x) :
    pathCoefficientMap n x = pathCoefficientMap n y := by
  apply (physicalCoefficientMap_eq_iff (pathTree n) x y).mpr
  apply full_degree_fraction_unique _ _ _ _
    (physicalCharacteristic_monic _ _) (physicalCharacteristic_monic _ _) _
    (catenary_characteristic_cofactor_coprime n x ha hf) h
  rw [physicalCharacteristic_natDegree, physicalCharacteristic_natDegree]

/-- Full real-fiber identification from the actual rational response, for a path
with nonzero internal rates; the competitor is not assumed positive or minimal. -/
theorem catenary_global_transfer_identification (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ i : Fin n, x.2 i ≠ 0)
    (h : physicalRootCofactor (pathTree n) x * physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) y =
      physicalRootCofactor (pathTree n) y * physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) x) : x = y := by
  exact catenary_coefficient_fiber_unique n x y ⟨ha,fun i _ => hf i⟩
    (catenary_response_identifies_coefficients n x y ha hf h)

/-- Equality on the common nonpole domain of the ACTUAL root resolvent entries
implies the rational polynomial identity. Totalized values at poles are not used. -/
theorem physical_response_eq_implies_cross_identity {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (x y : TreeRates n)
    (h : ∀ s : ℝ, (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s ≠ 0 →
      (physicalCharacteristic t y).eval s ≠ 0 →
      physicalRootResponse t x s = physicalRootResponse t y s) :
    physicalRootCofactor t x * physicalCharacteristic t y =
      physicalRootCofactor t y * physicalCharacteristic t x := by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (infinite_nonroots
    (physicalCharacteristic t x * physicalCharacteristic t y)
    (mul_ne_zero (physicalCharacteristic_monic t x).ne_zero
      (physicalCharacteristic_monic t y).ne_zero)).mono
  intro s hs
  have hh : (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s * (physicalCharacteristic t y).eval s ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Polynomial.eval_mul] using hs
  have hx := left_ne_zero_of_mul hh
  have hy := right_ne_zero_of_mul hh
  have he := h s hx hy
  rw [physicalRootResponse_eq, physicalRootResponse_eq] at he
  have hc := (div_eq_div_iff hx hy).mp he
  simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Polynomial.eval_mul] using hc

/-- Exact equality of actual root resolvents determines every path rate, provided
only the reference path has nonzero internal edges. No alternate-model hypotheses. -/
theorem catenary_global_resolvent_identification (n : ℕ) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ i : Fin n, x.2 i ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ s : ℝ, (physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) x).eval s ≠ 0 →
      (physicalCharacteristic (pathTree n) y).eval s ≠ 0 →
      physicalRootResponse (pathTree n) x s = physicalRootResponse (pathTree n) y s) : x = y := by
  exact catenary_global_transfer_identification n x y ha hf
    (physical_response_eq_implies_cross_identity (pathTree n) x y h)

end HydrologyTree
