import HydrologyTree.PositiveFiberCount
import HydrologyTree.PositiveJacobian
import HydrologyTree.ResultantBoundary
import HydrologyTree.CatenaryCoprime

/-! The exact positive count applies to the ACTUAL root resolvent, not merely
to independently observed characteristic/cofactor coefficients. Equality is only
required on the common nonpole domain. No totalized value at a pole is interpreted
as a finite physical response, and no ODE solution bridge is assumed here. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Equality to the given Stieltjes response wherever both expressions are
actual nonpole resolvents. Characteristic coefficients are not extra observations. -/
def HasStieltjesRootResponse {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℝ, (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s ≠ 0 → (∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0) →
    physicalRootResponse t x s = ∑ i, w i/(s+r i)

abbrev PositiveResponseFiber {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :=
  {x : TreeRates n // PositiveRateVector x ∧ HasStieltjesRootResponse t x r w}

/-- Every member of a positive full-response coefficient fiber is actually
regular. The nonzero Jacobian is a conclusion, not a restriction on the counted set. -/
theorem positive_stieltjes_fiber_regular {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (x : PositiveStieltjesFiber t r w) :
    treeCanonicalJacobian t x.val ≠ 0 := by
  apply (positive_tree_jacobian_iff_full_modes t x.val (x.property.1.1 0)
    (fun e => x.property.1.1 e.succ) x.property.1.2).mpr
  exact ⟨r,w,hpos,hr,hw,hm,x.property.2.1,x.property.2.2⟩

/-- Full-size noncancelling response equality forces the entire polynomial pair,
even for a competing real rate vector not assumed positive or regular. -/
theorem stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (x : TreeRates n) :
    HasStieltjesRootResponse t x r w ↔
      physicalCharacteristic t x=stieltjesDenominator r ∧
      physicalRootCofactor t x=stieltjesNumerator r w := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hPz,hFz⟩ := positive_tree_stieltjes_realization_exists t r w hr hpos hw hm
    have hJ := positive_stieltjes_fiber_regular t r w hr hpos hw hm ⟨z,hz,hPz,hFz⟩
    have hcop := (physicalPair_coprime_iff_all_rates t z).mpr
      ⟨fun e => ne_of_gt (hz.2 e),hJ⟩
    have hcross := physical_response_eq_implies_cross_identity t z x (by
      intro s hs hx
      have hden : (stieltjesDenominator r).eval s ≠ 0 := by rwa [← hPz]
      have hi : ∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0 := by
        rw [eval_stieltjesDenominator,Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff] at hden
        exact fun i => hden i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      rw [physicalRootResponse_eq,hPz,hFz]
      exact (stieltjes_quotient_eq_sum r w s hi).trans (h s hx hi).symm)
    have hdeg : (physicalCharacteristic t x).natDegree=(physicalCharacteristic t z).natDegree := by
      rw [physicalCharacteristic_natDegree,physicalCharacteristic_natDegree]
    obtain ⟨heP,heF⟩ := full_degree_fraction_unique _ _ _ _
      (physicalCharacteristic_monic t z) (physicalCharacteristic_monic t x) hdeg hcop hcross
    exact ⟨heP.symm.trans hPz,heF.symm.trans hFz⟩
  · rintro ⟨hP,hF⟩ s _ hs
    rw [physicalRootResponse_eq,hP,hF]
    exact stieltjes_quotient_eq_sum r w s hs

def positiveResponseFiberEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    PositiveResponseFiber t r w ≃ PositiveStieltjesFiber t r w where
  toFun x := ⟨x.val,x.property.1,
    (stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x.val).mp x.property.2⟩
  invFun x := ⟨x.val,x.property.1,
    (stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x.val).mpr x.property.2⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- Exact all-size count of actual positive models sharing the prescribed root
resolvent. Finiteness and completeness are both proved, without genericity or
an extra observation of the internal characteristic polynomials. -/
theorem positive_root_response_fiber_exact_card {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    Finite (PositiveResponseFiber t r w) ∧
      Nat.card (PositiveResponseFiber t r w) =
        n.factorial / (∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount t e.succ) := by
  obtain ⟨hf,hcard⟩ := positive_stieltjes_fiber_exact_card t r w hr hpos hw hm
  letI := hf
  let e := positiveResponseFiberEquiv t r w hr hpos hw hm
  exact ⟨Finite.of_injective e e.injective,(Nat.card_congr e).trans hcard⟩

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PositiveFiberEquivalence
import HydrologyTree.TreeFiberCombinatorics
import Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Finite

/-! Complete recursive classification. The target is a finite combinatorial
allocation type depending only on the labelled tree, not on a candidate list
of physical models or on an assumed solution count. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Every level records only its labelled pole allocation; child enumerations
inside a block are canonical and are not counted as different assignments. -/
def RecursivePoleAllocations {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : Type :=
  Σ _a : TreePoleAllocation t, (c : RootChild t) → RecursivePoleAllocations (childTree t c)
termination_by n
decreasing_by exact childEdgeCount_lt t c

lemma recursivePoleAllocations_finite_card {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) :
    Finite (RecursivePoleAllocations t) ∧ Nat.card (RecursivePoleAllocations t)=treeFiberDegree t := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    have hc (c : RootChild t) : Finite (RecursivePoleAllocations (childTree t c)) ∧
        Nat.card (RecursivePoleAllocations (childTree t c))=treeFiberDegree (childTree t c) :=
      ih _ (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c)
    letI : ∀ c : RootChild t, Finite (RecursivePoleAllocations (childTree t c)) := fun c => (hc c).1
    rw [RecursivePoleAllocations]
    refine ⟨inferInstance,?_⟩
    rw [Nat.card_sigma]
    simp only [Nat.card_pi]
    simp only [fun c => (hc c).2]
    rw [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Nat.nsmul_eq_mul,treeFiberDegree]

/-- Changing only equal polynomial descriptions preserves the actual rate vector. -/
def positivePolynomialFiberCongr {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (P F Q G : ℝ[X])
    (hP : P=Q) (hF : F=G) : PositivePolynomialFiber t P F ≃ PositivePolynomialFiber t Q G where
  toFun x := ⟨x.val,x.property.1,x.property.2.1.trans hP,x.property.2.2.trans hF⟩
  invFun x := ⟨x.val,x.property.1,x.property.2.1.trans hP.symm,x.property.2.2.trans hF.symm⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- EVERY actual positive realization is classified by a unique recursive
labelled pole allocation, and EVERY recursive allocation is realized. All child
bijections are constructed by induction, with no classification premise. -/
theorem positive_stieltjes_recursive_equiv_exists {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    Nonempty (PositiveStieltjesFiber t r w ≃ RecursivePoleAllocations t) := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    obtain ⟨b,g,d,hb,hbpos,hg,hF,hP,hl⟩ :=
      exists_positive_reciprocal_data_unordered r w hr hpos hw hm
    have hc (a : TreePoleAllocation t) (c : RootChild t) :
        Nonempty (PositiveStieltjesFiber (childTree t c)
          (allocatedRates b a c) (allocatedWeights t g a c) ≃ RecursivePoleAllocations (childTree t c)) :=
      ih _ (childEdgeCount_lt t c) (childTree t c)
        (allocatedRates b a c) (allocatedWeights t g a c)
        (allocatedRates_injective t b hb.injective a c) (fun i => hbpos _)
        (allocatedWeights_pos t g hg a c) (allocatedWeights_sum t g hg a c)
    let E : AllocatedFiberData t b g ≃ RecursivePoleAllocations t := by
      rw [RecursivePoleAllocations]
      exact Equiv.sigmaCongrRight (fun a => Equiv.piCongrRight (fun c => Classical.choice (hc a c)))
    exact ⟨(positivePolynomialFiberCongr t _ _ _ _ hP hF).trans
      ((positiveReciprocalFiberEquiv t b g d hb.injective hbpos hg hl).trans E)⟩

/-- A proved full bijection, not merely equinumerosity or an upper bound. -/
def positiveStieltjesRecursiveEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    PositiveStieltjesFiber t r w ≃ RecursivePoleAllocations t :=
  Classical.choice (positive_stieltjes_recursive_equiv_exists t r w hr hpos hw hm)

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.RealFiberRigidity
import HydrologyTree.PositiveResponseFiber
import HydrologyTree.RecursiveFiberClassification

/-! Complete classification of UNRESTRICTED REAL realizations. For a full
positive Stieltjes target, the positive physical locus is forced by the data;
there are no additional mixed-sign, zero-rate, or singular real solutions.
The root leak location and original tree encoding are unchanged. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev RealStieltjesFiber {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :=
  {x : TreeRates n // physicalCharacteristic t x=stieltjesDenominator r ∧
    physicalRootCofactor t x=stieltjesNumerator r w}

abbrev RealResponseFiber {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :=
  {x : TreeRates n // HasStieltjesRootResponse t x r w}

/-- The entire real coefficient fiber is the positive fiber, with the SAME
rate vector. No positivity, minimality or regularity hypothesis is discarded. -/
def realStieltjesFiberEquivPositive {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    RealStieltjesFiber t r w ≃ PositiveStieltjesFiber t r w where
  toFun x := ⟨x.val,real_stieltjes_realization_is_positive t x.val r w hr hpos hw hm
    x.property.1 x.property.2,x.property⟩
  invFun x := ⟨x.val,x.property.2⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- Equality of actual root resolvents suffices for the same unrestricted-real
classification. Coefficients are recovered; they are not extra observations. -/
def realResponseFiberEquivCoefficients {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    RealResponseFiber t r w ≃ RealStieltjesFiber t r w where
  toFun x := ⟨x.val,(stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x.val).mp x.property⟩
  invFun x := ⟨x.val,(stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x.val).mpr x.property⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- Full all-real response fiber bijection with the finite recursive labelled
allocation type. This is stronger than enumerating admissible positive models. -/
def realResponseRecursiveEquiv {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    RealResponseFiber t r w ≃ RecursivePoleAllocations t :=
  (realResponseFiberEquivCoefficients t r w hr hpos hw hm).trans
    ((realStieltjesFiberEquivPositive t r w hr hpos hw hm).trans
      (positiveStieltjesRecursiveEquiv t r w hr hpos hw hm))

/-- Exact finite count of ALL REAL coefficient realizations, not only the
positive subset. All real solutions are necessarily strictly positive. -/
theorem real_stieltjes_fiber_exact_card {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    Finite (RealStieltjesFiber t r w) ∧
      Nat.card (RealStieltjesFiber t r w) =
        n.factorial / (∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount t e.succ) := by
  obtain ⟨hf,hc⟩ := positive_stieltjes_fiber_exact_card t r w hr hpos hw hm
  letI := hf
  let E := realStieltjesFiberEquivPositive t r w hr hpos hw hm
  exact ⟨Finite.of_injective E E.injective,(Nat.card_congr E).trans hc⟩

/-- Exact finite count of ALL REAL models sharing the actual full root response.
No physical sign constraints are assumptions on the counted rate vectors. -/
theorem real_root_response_fiber_exact_card {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    Finite (RealResponseFiber t r w) ∧
      Nat.card (RealResponseFiber t r w) =
        n.factorial / (∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount t e.succ) := by
  obtain ⟨hf,hc⟩ := real_stieltjes_fiber_exact_card t r w hr hpos hw hm
  letI := hf
  let E := realResponseFiberEquivCoefficients t r w hr hpos hw hm
  exact ⟨Finite.of_injective E E.injective,(Nat.card_congr E).trans hc⟩

/-- The full target response forces strict positivity and a nonzero ACTUAL
coefficient Jacobian of any competing real vector, even one allowed initially
to have negative rates, vanishing rates or a nonpositive root leak. -/
theorem real_full_response_forces_positive_regular {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (hx : HasStieltjesRootResponse t x r w) :
    PositiveRateVector x ∧ treeCanonicalJacobian t x ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hP,hF⟩ := (stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x).mp hx
  have hp := real_stieltjes_realization_is_positive t x r w hr hpos hw hm hP hF
  exact ⟨hp,positive_stieltjes_fiber_regular t r w hr hpos hw hm ⟨x,hp,hP,hF⟩⟩

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.GraphMatrixTransport
import HydrologyTree.RealFiberClassification

/-! Actual root-response fibers for independently presented finite simple trees.
Both the graph's oriented rates and its matrix inverse entry are independent
definitions. The full bijection is proved through the constructed transport. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]

def HasGraphStieltjesResponse {n : ℕ} (o : V) (y : GraphRates G) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ s : ℝ, (graphCharacteristic o y).eval s ≠ 0 → (∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0) →
    graphRootResponse o y s=∑ i, w i/(s+r i)

abbrev GraphResponseFiber {n : ℕ} (o : V) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :=
  {y : GraphRates G // HasGraphStieltjesResponse o y r w}

theorem graph_response_transport {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (x : TreeRates n) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    HasGraphStieltjesResponse o (graphRateEquiv p x) r w ↔ HasStieltjesRootResponse p.tree x r w := by
  simp only [HasGraphStieltjesResponse,HasStieltjesRootResponse,
    graphCharacteristic_transport,graphRootResponse_transport]

/-- Exact actual-rate bijection, without sign or regularity restrictions on either fiber. -/
def graphResponseFiberEquiv {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : GraphResponseFiber (G := G) o r w ≃ RealResponseFiber p.tree r w where
  toFun y := ⟨(graphRateEquiv p).symm y.val,
    (graph_response_transport p _ r w).mp (by simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using y.property)⟩
  invFun x := ⟨graphRateEquiv p x.val,(graph_response_transport p x.val r w).mpr x.property⟩
  left_inv y := by apply Subtype.ext; exact (graphRateEquiv p).apply_symm_apply y.val
  right_inv x := by apply Subtype.ext; exact (graphRateEquiv p).symm_apply_apply x.val

/-- Every unrestricted real graph realization of a full positive target has
positive rates on ALL actual graph darts, including the root leak. -/
theorem graph_full_response_positive {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (y : GraphResponseFiber (G := G) o r w) :
    PositiveGraphRates y.val := by
  let x := graphResponseFiberEquiv p r w y
  have hp := (real_full_response_forces_positive_regular p.tree x.val r w hr hpos hw hm x.property).1
  have h := (graphRateEquiv_positive_iff p x.val).mpr hp
  change PositiveGraphRates (graphRateEquiv p ((graphRateEquiv p).symm y.val)) at h
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using h

/-- Full recursive allocation classification of the original graph parameter fiber. -/
def graphResponseRecursiveEquiv {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    GraphResponseFiber (G := G) o r w ≃ RecursivePoleAllocations p.tree :=
  (graphResponseFiberEquiv p r w).trans (realResponseRecursiveEquiv p.tree r w hr hpos hw hm)

theorem graph_response_fiber_exact_card {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    Finite (GraphResponseFiber (G := G) o r w) ∧
      Nat.card (GraphResponseFiber (G := G) o r w)=
        n.factorial/(∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount p.tree e.succ) := by
  obtain ⟨hf,hc⟩ := real_root_response_fiber_exact_card p.tree r w hr hpos hw hm
  letI := hf
  let e := graphResponseFiberEquiv p r w
  exact ⟨Finite.of_injective e e.injective,(Nat.card_congr e).trans hc⟩

/-- No presentation is an input premise: it is constructed from the finite
graph's own tree hypothesis, and the exact count is for its actual graph rates. -/
theorem finite_graph_full_response_classification {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hG : G.IsTree) (o : V) (hN : Fintype.card V=n+1)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    ∃ p : RootedTreePresentation n G o,
      Nonempty (GraphResponseFiber (G := G) o r w ≃ RecursivePoleAllocations p.tree) ∧
      Finite (GraphResponseFiber (G := G) o r w) ∧
      Nat.card (GraphResponseFiber (G := G) o r w)=n.factorial/(∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount p.tree e.succ) ∧
      ∀ y : GraphResponseFiber (G := G) o r w, PositiveGraphRates y.val := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := finite_rooted_tree_presentation n G o hG hN
  obtain ⟨hf,hc⟩ := graph_response_fiber_exact_card p r w hr hpos hw hm
  exact ⟨p,⟨graphResponseRecursiveEquiv p r w hr hpos hw hm⟩,hf,hc,
    fun y => graph_full_response_positive p r w hr hpos hw hm y⟩

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.ScalarForcedODE
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde

/-! Independence of distinct real exponentials on EVERY nonempty open interval.
The proof differentiates actual functions and uses the exact Vandermonde matrix. -/
open Matrix Filter
open scoped Topology
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {n : ℕ}

def exponentialMoment (r c : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, c i*(r i)^k*Real.exp (r i*s)

theorem exponentialMoment_derivative (r c : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (exponentialMoment r c k) (exponentialMoment r c (k+1) s) s := by
  have h := HasDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun i _ =>
    (((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul (r i)).exp).const_mul (c i*(r i)^k))
  have hefun : (∑ i : Fin (n+1), fun y : ℝ => c i*(r i)^k*Real.exp (r i*id y)) =
      exponentialMoment r c k := by
    funext y
    simp [exponentialMoment]
  rw [hefun] at h
  apply h.congr_deriv
  simp only [id_eq,mul_one,exponentialMoment]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

/-- Vanishing on an open interval forces every coefficient to be zero. -/
theorem exponential_sum_independent (r c : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hzero : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, exponentialMoment r c 0 s=0) : c=0 := by
  have hall : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, exponentialMoment r c k s=0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact hzero
    | succ k ih =>
      intro s hs
      have he : exponentialMoment r c k =ᶠ[𝓝 s] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
        filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hs] with v hv
        exact ih v hv
      exact (exponentialMoment_derivative r c k s).unique
        ((hasDerivAt_const s (0 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq he)
  let s := (a+b)/2
  have hs : s ∈ Set.Ioo a b := by dsimp [s]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hz : (Matrix.vandermonde r)ᵀ *ᵥ(fun i => c i*Real.exp (r i*s))=0 := by
    ext j
    have h := hall j.val s hs
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,Matrix.transpose_apply,Matrix.vandermonde_apply,
      exponentialMoment,Pi.zero_apply,mul_left_comm,mul_comm,mul_assoc] using h
  have hd : IsUnit (Matrix.vandermonde r)ᵀ.det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_transpose,isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    exact Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff.mpr hr
  have hv := congrArg (fun v => ((Matrix.vandermonde r)ᵀ)⁻¹*ᵥv) hz
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hd,Matrix.one_mulVec,Matrix.mulVec_zero] at hv
  funext i
  have hi := congrFun hv i
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hi).resolve_right (Real.exp_ne_zero _)

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.ExponentialIndependence
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.OpenPos
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef

/-! Strict positivity of the actual finite-horizon exponential Gramian. -/
open Matrix MeasureTheory
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree
variable {n : ℕ}

def exponentialSignal (r c : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, c i*Real.exp (r i*s)

def exponentialGramian (r : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (T : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun i j => ∫ s in 0..T, Real.exp (r i*s)*Real.exp (r j*s)

lemma continuous_exponentialSignal (r c : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : Continuous (exponentialSignal r c) := by
  unfold exponentialSignal
  fun_prop

theorem exponentialGramian_mulVec (r c : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (T : ℝ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    (exponentialGramian r T*ᵥc) i=∫ s in 0..T, Real.exp (r i*s)*exponentialSignal r c s := by
  have hi (j : Fin (n+1)) : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun s : ℝ => (Real.exp (r i*s)*Real.exp (r j*s))*c j) volume 0 T := by
    apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
    fun_prop
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,exponentialGramian,Matrix.of_apply]
  rw [show (∑ j, (∫ s in 0..T, Real.exp (r i*s)*Real.exp (r j*s))*c j) =
      ∑ j, ∫ s in 0..T, (Real.exp (r i*s)*Real.exp (r j*s))*c j by
        simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]]
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun j _ => hi j)]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro s _
  simp only [exponentialSignal,Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)

theorem exponentialGramian_quadratic (r c : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (T : ℝ) :
    c ⬝ᵥ (exponentialGramian r T*ᵥc) = ∫ s in 0..T, (exponentialSignal r c s)^2 := by
  simp only [dotProduct,exponentialGramian_mulVec]
  simp_rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  have hi (i : Fin (n+1)) : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun s : ℝ => c i*(Real.exp (r i*s)*exponentialSignal r c s)) volume 0 T := by
    apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
    exact continuous_const.mul ((Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).mul
      (continuous_exponentialSignal r c))
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun i _ => hi i)]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro s _
  simp only [← mul_assoc]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  change exponentialSignal r c s * exponentialSignal r c s = _
  ring

theorem exponentialGramian_posDef (r : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) : (exponentialGramian r T).PosDef := by
  apply Matrix.posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec.mpr
  constructor
  · ext i j
    simp [exponentialGramian,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,mul_comm]
  · intro c hc
    simp only [star_trivial,exponentialGramian_quadratic]
    have hcont : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (exponentialSignal r c s)^2) :=
      (continuous_exponentialSignal r c).pow 2
    have hnon : 0 ≤ ∫ s in 0..T, (exponentialSignal r c s)^2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall hT.le (fun s => sq_nonneg _)
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne hnon
    intro hz
    have hae : (fun s : ℝ => (exponentialSignal r c s)^2) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Set.Ioc 0 T)] 0 :=
      (intervalIntegral.integral_eq_zero_iff_of_le_of_nonneg_ae hT.le
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => sq_nonneg (exponentialSignal r c s)))
        (hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 T)).mp hz.symm
    have heq := MeasureTheory.Measure.eqOn_Ioc_of_ae_eq (μ := volume) hae
      hcont.continuousOn continuous_const.continuousOn
    apply hc
    apply exponential_sum_independent r c hr 0 T hT
    intro s hs
    have he := heq ⟨hs.1,hs.2.le⟩
    have hz0 : exponentialSignal r c s=0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp he
    simpa [exponentialMoment,exponentialSignal] using hz0

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.ExponentialGramian
import HydrologyTree.ModalForcedODE

/-! Explicit finite-horizon steering by actual continuous controls. Controls
are real-valued, as in linear controllability; nonnegative-only control is NOT
asserted. All initial and terminal physical state vectors are allowed. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ}

lemma scalar_exponentialSignal_terminal (r c : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (k y0 T : ℝ) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    scalarForcedSolution (r i) (fun s => k*exponentialSignal r c s) 0 y0 T =
      Real.exp (-r i*T)*(y0+k*(exponentialGramian r T*ᵥc) i) := by
  simp only [scalarForcedSolution,sub_zero,exponentialGramian_mulVec]
  have he : (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (r i*s)*(k*exponentialSignal r c s)) =
      (fun s : ℝ => k*(Real.exp (r i*s)*exponentialSignal r c s)) := by funext s; ring
  rw [he,intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]

def modalSteeringTarget (M : RootModalData A) (T : ℝ)
    (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : Fin (n+1) → ℝ := fun i =>
  (Real.exp (M.rates i*T)*(M.analysis*ᵥz1) i - (M.analysis*ᵥz0) i)/M.amplitudes i

def modalSteeringCoefficients (M : RootModalData A) (T : ℝ)
    (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : Fin (n+1) → ℝ :=
  (exponentialGramian M.rates T)⁻¹*ᵥmodalSteeringTarget M T z0 z1

def modalSteeringInput (M : RootModalData A) (T : ℝ)
    (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ :=
  exponentialSignal M.rates (modalSteeringCoefficients M T z0 z1)

lemma modalSteering_gramian_equation (M : RootModalData A) (hr : Function.Injective M.rates)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    exponentialGramian M.rates T*ᵥmodalSteeringCoefficients M T z0 z1=modalSteeringTarget M T z0 z1 := by
  rw [modalSteeringCoefficients,Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (exponentialGramian_posDef M.rates hr T hT).det_pos)),
    Matrix.one_mulVec]

/-- The constructed control reaches the exact target at every positive horizon. -/
theorem modalSteering_terminal (M : RootModalData A) (hr : Function.Injective M.rates)
    (hk : ∀ i, M.amplitudes i ≠ 0) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    modalForcedSolution M (modalSteeringInput M T z0 z1) 0 z0 T=z1 := by
  have hG := modalSteering_gramian_equation M hr T hT z0 z1
  have he : (fun i => scalarForcedSolution (M.rates i)
      (fun s => M.amplitudes i*modalSteeringInput M T z0 z1 s) 0 ((M.analysis*ᵥz0) i) T) = M.analysis*ᵥz1 := by
    funext i
    rw [modalSteeringInput,scalar_exponentialSignal_terminal,hG]
    dsimp only [modalSteeringTarget]
    rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (hk i)]
    have hc := scalarIntegratingFactor_cancel (M.rates i) 0 T
    simp only [sub_zero] at hc
    calc
      _ = (Real.exp (-M.rates i*T)*Real.exp (M.rates i*T))*(M.analysis*ᵥz1) i := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hc,one_mul]
  rw [modalForcedSolution,he,Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,M.synth_analysis,Matrix.one_mulVec]

/-- Actual continuous-time controllability, not just a Kalman rank statement.
For every T>0 and every initial/final state, a continuous real input and its
unique global classical trajectory are constructed. -/
theorem modal_finite_horizon_steering (M : RootModalData A) (hr : Function.Injective M.rates)
    (hk : ∀ i, M.amplitudes i ≠ 0) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous u ∧
      ∃! z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ, IsForcedMatrixSolution A (Pi.single 0 1) u z ∧ z 0=z0 ∧ z T=z1 := by
  let u := modalSteeringInput M T z0 z1
  have hu : Continuous u := continuous_exponentialSignal _ _
  refine ⟨u,hu,modalForcedSolution M u 0 z0,?_,?_⟩
  · exact ⟨modalForcedSolution_ode M u hu 0 z0,modalForcedSolution_initial M u 0 z0,
      modalSteering_terminal M hr hk T hT z0 z1⟩
  · intro z hz
    exact forcedMatrixSolution_unique A (Pi.single 0 1) u z (modalForcedSolution M u 0 z0) 0
      hz.1 (modalForcedSolution_ode M u hu 0 z0)
      (hz.2.1.trans (modalForcedSolution_initial M u 0 z0).symm)

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.RootModalData
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde

/-! Actual Kalman matrices, not assumed rank interfaces. Their factorization
is proved from the same physical modal coordinate witness used for the ODE. -/
open Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ}

def rootKrylovMatrix (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun i j => (A^j.val *ᵥ(Pi.single 0 1)) i

def rootObservationMatrix (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ) :
    Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ := Matrix.of fun i j => (A^i.val) 0 j

lemma rootModal_synthesis_row (M : RootModalData A) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    M.synthesis 0 i=M.amplitudes i := by
  simpa [Pi.single_apply] using M.root_output (Pi.single i 1)

/-- Every actual matrix power, with no simple-spectrum hypothesis. -/
theorem rootModal_matrix_power (M : RootModalData A) (k : ℕ) :
    A^k=M.synthesis*Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (-M.rates i)^k)*M.analysis := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using M.synth_analysis.symm
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ',ih]
    calc
      _ = (A*M.synthesis)*Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (-M.rates i)^k)*M.analysis := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = M.synthesis*(Matrix.diagonal (fun i => -M.rates i)*
          Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (-M.rates i)^k))*M.analysis := by
            rw [M.intertwine]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]; simp only [pow_succ']

lemma rootModal_krylov_column (M : RootModalData A) (k : ℕ) :
    A^k *ᵥ(Pi.single 0 1)=M.synthesis*ᵥ(fun i => M.amplitudes i*(-M.rates i)^k) := by
  rw [rootModal_matrix_power M k,← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,M.input_analysis]
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp [Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,Matrix.diagonal_apply,mul_comm]

/-- Actual controllability matrix factorization. -/
theorem rootKrylovMatrix_factorization (M : RootModalData A) :
    rootKrylovMatrix A=M.synthesis*Matrix.diagonal M.amplitudes*
      Matrix.vandermonde (fun i => -M.rates i) := by
  ext i j
  change (A^j.val *ᵥPi.single 0 1) i = _
  rw [rootModal_krylov_column M j.val,Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,Matrix.vandermonde_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  ring

/-- Actual observability matrix factorization, in the original state coordinates. -/
theorem rootObservationMatrix_factorization (M : RootModalData A) :
    rootObservationMatrix A=(Matrix.vandermonde (fun i => -M.rates i))ᵀ*
      Matrix.diagonal M.amplitudes*M.analysis := by
  ext i j
  change (A^i.val) 0 j = _
  rw [rootModal_matrix_power M i.val,Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal,Matrix.transpose_apply,Matrix.vandermonde_apply,rootModal_synthesis_row M]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  ring

/-- The actual Kalman determinants are nonzero when all full modes are present. -/
theorem rootModal_kalman_nonsingular (M : RootModalData A)
    (hr : Function.Injective M.rates) (hk : ∀ i, M.amplitudes i ≠ 0) :
    (rootKrylovMatrix A).det ≠ 0 ∧ (rootObservationMatrix A).det ≠ 0 := by
  have hST := congrArg Matrix.det M.synth_analysis
  rw [Matrix.det_mul,Matrix.det_one] at hST
  have hS : M.synthesis.det ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul (hST ▸ one_ne_zero)
  have hT : M.analysis.det ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul (hST ▸ one_ne_zero)
  have hv : (Matrix.vandermonde (fun i => -M.rates i)).det ≠ 0 :=
    Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff.mpr (neg_injective.comp hr)
  have hkdet : (Matrix.diagonal M.amplitudes).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_diagonal]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => hk i)
  rw [rootKrylovMatrix_factorization M,rootObservationMatrix_factorization M,
    Matrix.det_mul,Matrix.det_mul,Matrix.det_mul,Matrix.det_mul,Matrix.det_transpose]
  exact ⟨mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hS hkdet) hv,mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hv hkdet) hT⟩

end HydrologyTree

/-! Full-mode Kalman controllability/observability in the original physical
coordinates. This alone is not called continuous-time steering; the actual
trajectory observation and reachability statements require their own bridges. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Nonsingularity of BOTH actual root Kalman matrices is a proved consequence
of the prescribed full response, for unrestricted real competing parameters. -/
theorem real_full_response_kalman_nonsingular {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (hx : HasStieltjesRootResponse t x r w) :
    (rootKrylovMatrix (compartmentMatrix t x)).det ≠ 0 ∧
      (rootObservationMatrix (compartmentMatrix t x)).det ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hP,hF⟩ := (stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x).mp hx
  have hp := real_stieltjes_realization_is_positive t x r w hr hpos hw hm hP hF
  obtain ⟨M,_,hMP,hMF⟩ := physical_root_modal_representation t x (hp.1 0) (fun e => hp.1 e.succ) hp.2
  obtain ⟨e,he,hweights⟩ := stieltjes_pair_matching M.rates r (fun i => (M.amplitudes i)^2) w hr
    (hMP.symm.trans hP) (hMF.symm.trans hF)
  apply rootModal_kalman_nonsingular M
  · intro i j hij
    apply e.injective
    apply hr
    rwa [← he i,← he j]
  · intro i hi
    have h := hw (e i)
    rw [← hweights i,hi] at h
    norm_num at h

end HydrologyTree

forward growth bound. No stability, real spectrum or positivity is assumed. -/

open scoped Topology
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

def matrixFlow (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (s : ℝ) : (I → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (I → ℝ) :=
  NormedSpace.exp (s • matrixOperator A)

@[simp] theorem matrixFlow_zero (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (z : I → ℝ) : matrixFlow A 0 z=z := by
  simp [matrixFlow]

theorem matrixFlow_hasDerivAt (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (z : I → ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v => matrixFlow A v z) (A *ᵥ matrixFlow A s z) s := by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const' (𝕂 := ℝ) (matrixOperator A) s).clm_apply
    (hasDerivAt_const s z)
  simpa [matrixFlow,ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply] using h

/-- A global forward bound obtained from the actual ODE by Gronwall. -/
theorem matrixFlow_norm_bound (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (z : I → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    ‖matrixFlow A s z‖ ≤ ‖z‖*Real.exp (‖matrixOperator A‖*s) := by
  have hc : Continuous (fun v => matrixFlow A v z) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun v => (matrixFlow_hasDerivAt A z v).continuousAt)
  have h := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le (a := 0) (b := s)
    (δ := ‖z‖) (K := ‖matrixOperator A‖) (ε := 0) hc.continuousOn
    (fun v _ => (matrixFlow_hasDerivAt A z v).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (by simp) (fun v _ => by simpa using (matrixOperator A).le_opNorm (matrixFlow A v z))
  simpa only [sub_zero,gronwallBound_ε0] using h s ⟨hs,le_rfl⟩

/-- Exponential rescaling kills every homogeneous transient when the probing
exponent exceeds the actual operator norm, even for unstable real matrices. -/
theorem matrixFlow_scaled_tendsto_zero (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (z : I → ℝ) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : ‖matrixOperator A‖ < q) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-q*s) • matrixFlow A s z) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hl : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (‖matrixOperator A‖-q)*s) atTop atBot :=
    (tendsto_const_mul_atBot_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr hq)).mpr tendsto_id
  have he : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ‖z‖*Real.exp ((‖matrixOperator A‖-q)*s)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.mul (Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp hl)
  apply squeeze_zero_norm' ((eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)).mono (fun s hs => ?_)) he
  rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le]
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-q*s)*(‖z‖*Real.exp (‖matrixOperator A‖*s)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (matrixFlow_norm_bound A z s hs) (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = ‖z‖*(Real.exp (-q*s)*Real.exp (‖matrixOperator A‖*s)) := by ring
    _ = ‖z‖*Real.exp ((‖matrixOperator A‖-q)*s) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 2
      ring

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.MatrixFlow
import HydrologyTree.ScalarForcedODE
import HydrologyTree.Resolvent

/-! Exact exponential input probes for arbitrary real matrices. The recovered
quantity is the actual resolvent, with its domain of invertibility checked. -/
open Matrix Filter
open scoped Topology
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]

lemma scalar_mulVec_eq_smul (q : ℝ) (z : I → ℝ) : Matrix.scalar I q *ᵥ z=q • z := by
  ext i
  simp [Matrix.scalar_apply,Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct,Matrix.diagonal_apply]

def resolventVector (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (b : I → ℝ) (q : ℝ) : I → ℝ :=
  (Matrix.scalar I q-A)⁻¹ *ᵥ b

lemma resolventVector_equation (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (b : I → ℝ) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : (Matrix.scalar I q-A).det ≠ 0) :
    q • resolventVector A b q-A*ᵥresolventVector A b q=b := by
  have h : (Matrix.scalar I q-A)*ᵥresolventVector A b q=b := by
    rw [resolventVector,Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hq),Matrix.one_mulVec]
  simpa only [Matrix.sub_mulVec,scalar_mulVec_eq_smul] using h

def exponentialODEProbe (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (b : I → ℝ) (q s : ℝ) : I → ℝ :=
  Real.exp (q*s) • resolventVector A b q - matrixFlow A s (resolventVector A b q)

@[simp] theorem exponentialODEProbe_initial (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (b : I → ℝ) (q : ℝ) :
    exponentialODEProbe A b q 0=0 := by simp [exponentialODEProbe]

/-- A genuine zero-initial solution for the positive smooth input exp(q*s). -/
theorem exponentialODEProbe_ode (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (b : I → ℝ) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : (Matrix.scalar I q-A).det ≠ 0) :
    IsForcedMatrixSolution A b (fun s => Real.exp (q*s)) (exponentialODEProbe A b q) := by
  intro s
  have h := ((((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul q).exp).smul_const (resolventVector A b q)).sub
    (matrixFlow_hasDerivAt A (resolventVector A b q) s)
  apply h.congr_deriv
  simp only [exponentialODEProbe,Matrix.mulVec_sub,Matrix.mulVec_smul,id_eq,mul_one]
  ext i
  have hv := congrFun (resolventVector_equation A b q hq) i
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply,Pi.add_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul] at hv ⊢
  linear_combination Real.exp (q*s)*hv

/-- The scaled actual trajectory tends to the true resolvent vector. -/
theorem exponentialODEProbe_scaled_limit (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (b : I → ℝ) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : ‖matrixOperator A‖ < q) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-q*s) • exponentialODEProbe A b q s)
      atTop (𝓝 (resolventVector A b q)) := by
  have h : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => resolventVector A b q -
      Real.exp (-q*s) • matrixFlow A s (resolventVector A b q)) atTop
      (𝓝 (resolventVector A b q-0)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.sub (matrixFlow_scaled_tendsto_zero A (resolventVector A b q) q hq)
  have he (s : ℝ) : Real.exp (-q*s) • exponentialODEProbe A b q s =
      resolventVector A b q - Real.exp (-q*s) • matrixFlow A s (resolventVector A b q) := by
    rw [exponentialODEProbe,smul_sub,smul_smul]
    have hc : Real.exp (-q*s)*Real.exp (q*s)=1 := by
      simpa using scalarIntegratingFactor_cancel q 0 s
    rw [hc,one_smul]
  simpa only [sub_zero,← he] using h

/-- Every observed coordinate has the corresponding exact asymptotic response. -/
theorem exponentialODEProbe_coordinate_limit (A : Matrix I I ℝ) (b : I → ℝ) (q : ℝ)
    (hq : ‖matrixOperator A‖ < q) (o : I) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-q*s)*exponentialODEProbe A b q s o)
      atTop (𝓝 (resolventVector A b q o)) := by
  exact ((continuous_apply o).tendsto (resolventVector A b q)).comp (exponentialODEProbe_scaled_limit A b q hq)

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.ExponentialODEProbe
import HydrologyTree.PhysicalForcedODE
import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.Infinite

/-! Actual all-continuous-input equality implies a polynomial transfer identity
for arbitrary real matrices. Positive exponential probes are genuine classical
solutions; the universal output predicate cannot be used vacuously. -/
open Matrix Polynomial Filter
open scoped Topology
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def SameContinuousRootOutputs {n : ℕ} (t v : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous u →
    ∀ z q : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ,
      IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u z → IsPhysicalForcedSolution v y u q →
      z 0=0 → q 0=0 → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → z s 0=q s 0

/-- Exponential input probes identify each sufficiently high nonpole resolvent
from actual trajectories, without assuming either matrix is stable. -/
theorem same_continuous_outputs_resolvent {n : ℕ} (t v : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (h : SameContinuousRootOutputs t v x y) (q : ℝ)
    (hqA : ‖matrixOperator (compartmentMatrix t x)‖ < q)
    (hqB : ‖matrixOperator (compartmentMatrix v y)‖ < q)
    (hA : (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval q ≠ 0)
    (hB : (physicalCharacteristic v y).eval q ≠ 0) :
    physicalRootResponse t x q=physicalRootResponse v y q := by
  let A := compartmentMatrix t x
  let B := compartmentMatrix v y
  let b : Fin (n+1) → ℝ := Pi.single 0 1
  have hdA : (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) q-A).det ≠ 0 := by rwa [← Matrix.eval_charpoly]
  have hdB : (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) q-B).det ≠ 0 := by rwa [← Matrix.eval_charpoly]
  have hout := h (fun s => Real.exp (q*s)) (by fun_prop)
    (exponentialODEProbe A b q) (exponentialODEProbe B b q)
    (exponentialODEProbe_ode A b q hdA) (exponentialODEProbe_ode B b q hdB)
    (exponentialODEProbe_initial A b q) (exponentialODEProbe_initial B b q)
  have hlA := exponentialODEProbe_coordinate_limit A b q hqA (0 : Fin (n+1))
  have hlB := exponentialODEProbe_coordinate_limit B b q hqB (0 : Fin (n+1))
  have he : (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-q*s)*exponentialODEProbe A b q s 0) =ᶠ[atTop]
      (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-q*s)*exponentialODEProbe B b q s 0) :=
    (eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)).mono (fun s hs => congrArg (fun z => Real.exp (-q*s)*z) (hout s hs))
  have hh := tendsto_nhds_unique (hlA.congr' he) hlB
  simpa only [resolventVector,b,Matrix.mulVec_single_one,Matrix.col_apply,physicalRootResponse,A,B] using hh

/-- Exact transfer cross identity from actual input/output trajectories.
The proof uses infinitely many high exponential probes, not a finite test set. -/
theorem same_continuous_outputs_cross_identity {n : ℕ} (t v : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (h : SameContinuousRootOutputs t v x y) :
    physicalRootCofactor t x*physicalCharacteristic v y =
      physicalRootCofactor v y*physicalCharacteristic t x := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := Polynomial.exists_max_root (physicalCharacteristic t x) (physicalCharacteristic_monic t x).ne_zero
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := Polynomial.exists_max_root (physicalCharacteristic v y) (physicalCharacteristic_monic v y).ne_zero
  let R := max (max a b) (max ‖matrixOperator (compartmentMatrix t x)‖ ‖matrixOperator (compartmentMatrix v y)‖)
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
  apply (Set.Ioi_infinite R).mono
  intro q hq
  change R < q at hq
  have hqa : a < q := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_left a b) (le_max_left _ _)) hq
  have hqb : b < q := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_right a b) (le_max_left _ _)) hq
  have hnA : (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval q ≠ 0 := fun hz => (not_le_of_gt hqa) (ha q hz)
  have hnB : (physicalCharacteristic v y).eval q ≠ 0 := fun hz => (not_le_of_gt hqb) (hb q hz)
  have hqA : ‖matrixOperator (compartmentMatrix t x)‖ < q :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hq
  have hqB : ‖matrixOperator (compartmentMatrix v y)‖ < q :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hq
  have he := same_continuous_outputs_resolvent t v x y h q hqA hqB hnA hnB
  rw [physicalRootResponse_eq,physicalRootResponse_eq] at he
  have hh := (div_eq_div_iff hnA hnB).mp he
  simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,Polynomial.eval_mul] using hh

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.RealFiberClassification

/-! Actual root-discharge transfer: the observed output is the root leak times
root storage. The leak is recovered from the transfer, not assumed calibrated.
This is a matrix-resolvent theorem; no unproved all-input ODE bridge is claimed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def physicalDischargeResponse {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  x.1 0 * physicalRootResponse t x s

def stieltjesLeak {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : ℝ := (∑ i, w i/r i)⁻¹

lemma stieltjesLeak_pos {n : ℕ} (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) : 0 < stieltjesLeak r w := by
  apply inv_pos.mpr
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => div_pos (hw i) (hr i)) Finset.univ_nonempty

/-- The root leak is fixed by the full target response, not an independently
assumed known parameter. No positivity premise is made on the competing x. -/
theorem full_stieltjes_leak_identified {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1)
    (hP : physicalCharacteristic t x=stieltjesDenominator r)
    (hF : physicalRootCofactor t x=stieltjesNumerator r w) : x.1 0=stieltjesLeak r w := by
  have hx := real_stieltjes_realization_is_positive t x r w hr hpos hw hm hP hF
  rw [physical_root_leak_eq_ratio t x (fun e => ne_of_gt (hx.1 e.succ)),hP,hF,stieltjesLeak]
  have hz := stieltjes_quotient_eq_sum r w 0 (fun i => by simpa using ne_of_gt (hpos i))
  simp only [zero_add] at hz
  rw [← hz]
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm]

/-- Two equal actual discharge transfers have the same leak coefficient,
recovered by the leading coefficients of the full cross-polynomial identity. -/
theorem equal_discharge_recovers_leak {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (h : ∀ s, (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s ≠ 0 → (physicalCharacteristic t y).eval s ≠ 0 →
      physicalDischargeResponse t x s=physicalDischargeResponse t y s) : x.1 0=y.1 0 := by
  have hc : C (x.1 0)*physicalRootCofactor t x*physicalCharacteristic t y =
      C (y.1 0)*physicalRootCofactor t y*physicalCharacteristic t x := by
    apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
    apply (infinite_nonroots (physicalCharacteristic t x*physicalCharacteristic t y)
      (mul_ne_zero (physicalCharacteristic_monic t x).ne_zero
        (physicalCharacteristic_monic t y).ne_zero)).mono
    intro s hs
    have hp : (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s*(physicalCharacteristic t y).eval s ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,Polynomial.eval_mul] using hs
    have hx := left_ne_zero_of_mul hp
    have hy := right_ne_zero_of_mul hp
    have he := h s hx hy
    simp only [physicalDischargeResponse,physicalRootResponse_eq,← mul_div_assoc] at he
    have heq := (div_eq_div_iff hx hy).mp he
    simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,Polynomial.eval_mul,Polynomial.eval_C] using heq
  have hl := congrArg Polynomial.leadingCoeff hc
  simpa only [Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul,Polynomial.leadingCoeff_C,
    (physicalRootCofactor_monic t x).leadingCoeff,(physicalRootCofactor_monic t y).leadingCoeff,
    (physicalCharacteristic_monic t x).leadingCoeff,(physicalCharacteristic_monic t y).leadingCoeff,
    mul_one] using hl

def HasStieltjesDischargeResponse {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ s, (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval s ≠ 0 → (∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0) →
    physicalDischargeResponse t x s = stieltjesLeak r w * ∑ i, w i/(s+r i)

/-- Actual discharge data identify the leak and hence the normalized root
response. The competing real rates have no imposed sign restrictions. -/
theorem stieltjes_discharge_iff_root_response {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    HasStieltjesDischargeResponse t x r w ↔ HasStieltjesRootResponse t x r w := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hPz,hFz⟩ := positive_tree_stieltjes_realization_exists t r w hr hpos hw hm
    have hlz := full_stieltjes_leak_identified t z r w hr hpos hw hm hPz hFz
    have hleak := equal_discharge_recovers_leak t x z (by
      intro s hx hz
      have hi : ∀ i, s+r i ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hPz,eval_stieltjesDenominator,Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff] at hz
        exact fun i => hz i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      rw [h s hx hi,physicalDischargeResponse,hlz,physicalRootResponse_eq,hPz,hFz,
        stieltjes_quotient_eq_sum r w s hi])
    intro s hx hi
    have he := h s hx hi
    rw [physicalDischargeResponse,hleak,hlz] at he
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (stieltjesLeak_pos r w hpos hw)) he
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hP,hF⟩ := (stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x).mp h
    have hl := full_stieltjes_leak_identified t x r w hr hpos hw hm hP hF
    intro s hx hi
    rw [physicalDischargeResponse,hl,h s hx hi]

abbrev RealDischargeFiber {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :=
  {x : TreeRates n // HasStieltjesDischargeResponse t x r w}

def realDischargeFiberEquivRoot {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    RealDischargeFiber t r w ≃ RealResponseFiber t r w where
  toFun x := ⟨x.val,(stieltjes_discharge_iff_root_response t x.val r w hr hpos hw hm).mp x.property⟩
  invFun x := ⟨x.val,(stieltjes_discharge_iff_root_response t x.val r w hr hpos hw hm).mpr x.property⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- Exact finite count for the ACTUAL discharge transfer, with its unknown
root-leak coefficient identified rather than assumed supplied. -/
theorem real_discharge_fiber_exact_card {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    Finite (RealDischargeFiber t r w) ∧
      Nat.card (RealDischargeFiber t r w)=n.factorial / (∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount t e.succ) := by
  obtain ⟨hf,hc⟩ := real_root_response_fiber_exact_card t r w hr hpos hw hm
  letI := hf
  let E := realDischargeFiberEquivRoot t r w hr hpos hw hm
  exact ⟨Finite.of_injective E E.injective,(Nat.card_congr E).trans hc⟩

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PhysicalForcedODE
import HydrologyTree.DischargeFiber

/-! Closed actual-ODE implication of the full real-response classification.
Every real response realization is proved positive before constructing solutions.
All-input equalities below concern arbitrary continuous inputs and actual states. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Every real full-target model has a unique actual zero-initial trajectory
for every continuous input, with the explicitly prescribed time-domain output. -/
theorem real_full_response_forced_ODE {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (hx : HasStieltjesRootResponse t x r w)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (a : ℝ) :
    ∃! z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ,
      IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u z ∧ z a=0 ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, z s 0=∑ i, w i*scalarForcedSolution (r i) u a 0 s := by
  obtain ⟨hP,hF⟩ := (stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x).mp hx
  have hpositive := real_stieltjes_realization_is_positive t x r w hr hpos hw hm hP hF
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hunique⟩ := physical_forced_ODE_existsUnique t x hpositive u hu a 0
  refine ⟨z,⟨hz.1,hz.2,?_⟩,?_⟩
  · exact fun s => physical_forced_root_formula t x hpositive r w hr hP hF u hu a z hz.1 hz.2 s
  · intro y hy
    exact hunique y ⟨hy.1,hy.2.1⟩

/-- Two prescribed topologies with the same full response give identical actual
root state and discharge for EVERY continuous input and every initial time.
No positivity or regularity premise is imposed on the competing rate vectors. -/
theorem same_full_response_all_continuous_inputs {n : ℕ} (t v : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1)
    (hx : HasStieltjesRootResponse t x r w) (hy : HasStieltjesRootResponse v y r w)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (a : ℝ)
    (z q : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hz : IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u z) (hq : IsPhysicalForcedSolution v y u q)
    (hz0 : z a=0) (hq0 : q a=0) :
    ∀ s : ℝ, z s 0=q s 0 ∧ x.1 0*z s 0=y.1 0*q s 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hPx,hFx⟩ := (stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x).mp hx
  obtain ⟨hPy,hFy⟩ := (stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials v r w hr hpos hw hm y).mp hy
  have hposx := real_stieltjes_realization_is_positive t x r w hr hpos hw hm hPx hFx
  have hposy := real_stieltjes_realization_is_positive v y r w hr hpos hw hm hPy hFy
  have hleakx := full_stieltjes_leak_identified t x r w hr hpos hw hm hPx hFx
  have hleaky := full_stieltjes_leak_identified v y r w hr hpos hw hm hPy hFy
  intro s
  have he : z s 0=q s 0 :=
    (physical_forced_root_formula t x hposx r w hr hPx hFx u hu a z hz hz0 s).trans
      (physical_forced_root_formula v y hposy r w hr hPy hFy u hu a q hq hq0 s).symm
  exact ⟨he,by rw [he,hleakx,hleaky]⟩

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.TimeDomainIdentification
import HydrologyTree.FullResponseDynamics

/-! Complete identification and finite-fiber classification from actual
continuous-input ODE outputs. No positivity, stability, or trajectory-existence
assumption on a competing real parameter vector is hidden in the membership. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Actual zero-initial root output for every continuous forcing at all
nonnegative times. It specifies no internal coefficients or states. -/
def HasFullContinuousRootOutput {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous u → ∀ z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ,
    IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u z → z 0=0 → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s →
      z s 0=∑ i, w i*scalarForcedSolution (r i) u 0 0 s

/-- Both directions are proved for unrestricted real competitors. Explicit
exponential probes prevent a vacuous use of the universal trajectory predicate. -/
theorem continuous_root_output_iff_response {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    HasFullContinuousRootOutput t x r w ↔ HasStieltjesRootResponse t x r w := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hPy,hFy⟩ := positive_tree_stieltjes_realization_exists t r w hr hpos hw hm
    have hsame : SameContinuousRootOutputs t t y x := by
      intro u hu z q hz hq hz0 hq0 s hs
      exact (physical_forced_root_formula t y hy r w hr hPy hFy u hu 0 z hz hz0 s).trans
        (h u hu q hq hq0 s hs).symm
    have hcross := same_continuous_outputs_cross_identity t t y x hsame
    have hJ := positive_stieltjes_fiber_regular t r w hr hpos hw hm ⟨y,hy,hPy,hFy⟩
    have hcop := (physicalPair_coprime_iff_all_rates t y).mpr ⟨fun e => ne_of_gt (hy.2 e),hJ⟩
    have hdeg : (physicalCharacteristic t x).natDegree=(physicalCharacteristic t y).natDegree := by
      rw [physicalCharacteristic_natDegree,physicalCharacteristic_natDegree]
    obtain ⟨hP,hF⟩ := full_degree_fraction_unique _ _ _ _
      (physicalCharacteristic_monic t y) (physicalCharacteristic_monic t x) hdeg hcop hcross
    exact (stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x).mpr
      ⟨hP.symm.trans hPy,hF.symm.trans hFy⟩
  · intro h u hu z hz hz0 s _
    obtain ⟨hP,hF⟩ := (stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x).mp h
    have hx := real_stieltjes_realization_is_positive t x r w hr hpos hw hm hP hF
    exact physical_forced_root_formula t x hx r w hr hP hF u hu 0 z hz hz0 s

abbrev RealContinuousOutputFiber {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :=
  {x : TreeRates n // HasFullContinuousRootOutput t x r w}

def continuousOutputFiberEquivResponse {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    RealContinuousOutputFiber t r w ≃ RealResponseFiber t r w where
  toFun x := ⟨x.val,(continuous_root_output_iff_response t x.val r w hr hpos hw hm).mp x.property⟩
  invFun x := ⟨x.val,(continuous_root_output_iff_response t x.val r w hr hpos hw hm).mpr x.property⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- The complete exact real fiber count now applies to genuine continuous-input
ODE behavior, not only formal rational functions or extra coefficient data. -/
theorem real_continuous_output_fiber_exact_card {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    Finite (RealContinuousOutputFiber t r w) ∧
      Nat.card (RealContinuousOutputFiber t r w)=n.factorial / (∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount t e.succ) := by
  obtain ⟨hf,hc⟩ := real_root_response_fiber_exact_card t r w hr hpos hw hm
  letI := hf
  let E := continuousOutputFiberEquivResponse t r w hr hpos hw hm
  exact ⟨Finite.of_injective E E.injective,(Nat.card_congr E).trans hc⟩

/-- The observed ODE behavior forces physical positivity, regularity, and
actual global existence and uniqueness for every continuous input. -/
theorem continuous_output_forces_physical_wellposedness {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (hx : HasFullContinuousRootOutput t x r w) :
    PositiveRateVector x ∧ treeCanonicalJacobian t x ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous u → ∀ (a : ℝ) (z0 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ),
        ∃! z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ, IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u z ∧ z a=z0 := by
  have hR := (continuous_root_output_iff_response t x r w hr hpos hw hm).mp hx
  obtain ⟨hposx,hJ⟩ := real_full_response_forces_positive_regular t x r w hr hpos hw hm hR
  exact ⟨hposx,hJ,fun u hu a z0 => physical_forced_ODE_existsUnique t x hposx u hu a z0⟩

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/TimeDomainDischarge.lean:
import HydrologyTree.ContinuousOutputFiber

/-! Reverse identification from actual discharge histories, including recovery
of an uncalibrated leak. Continuous forcing and actual classical solutions only. -/
open Matrix Polynomial Filter
open scoped Topology
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def SameContinuousDischargeOutputs {n : ℕ} (t v : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n) : Prop :=
  ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous u → ∀ z q : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ,
    IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u z → IsPhysicalForcedSolution v y u q →
    z 0=0 → q 0=0 → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → x.1 0*z s 0=y.1 0*q s 0

lemma same_continuous_discharge_resolvent {n : ℕ} (t v : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (h : SameContinuousDischargeOutputs t v x y) (q : ℝ)
    (hqA : ‖matrixOperator (compartmentMatrix t x)‖ < q)
    (hqB : ‖matrixOperator (compartmentMatrix v y)‖ < q)
    (hA : (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval q ≠ 0)
    (hB : (physicalCharacteristic v y).eval q ≠ 0) :
    physicalDischargeResponse t x q=physicalDischargeResponse v y q := by
  let A := compartmentMatrix t x
  let B := compartmentMatrix v y
  let b : Fin (n+1) → ℝ := Pi.single 0 1
  have hdA : (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) q-A).det ≠ 0 := by rwa [← Matrix.eval_charpoly]
  have hdB : (Matrix.scalar (Fin (n+1)) q-B).det ≠ 0 := by rwa [← Matrix.eval_charpoly]
  have hout := h (fun s => Real.exp (q*s)) (by fun_prop)
    (exponentialODEProbe A b q) (exponentialODEProbe B b q)
    (exponentialODEProbe_ode A b q hdA) (exponentialODEProbe_ode B b q hdB)
    (exponentialODEProbe_initial A b q) (exponentialODEProbe_initial B b q)
  have hlA := (exponentialODEProbe_coordinate_limit A b q hqA (0 : Fin (n+1))).const_mul (x.1 0)
  have hlB := (exponentialODEProbe_coordinate_limit B b q hqB (0 : Fin (n+1))).const_mul (y.1 0)
  have he : (fun s : ℝ => x.1 0*(Real.exp (-q*s)*exponentialODEProbe A b q s 0)) =ᶠ[atTop]
      (fun s : ℝ => y.1 0*(Real.exp (-q*s)*exponentialODEProbe B b q s 0)) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with s hs
    have hh := congrArg (fun z => Real.exp (-q*s)*z) (hout s hs)
    simpa only [mul_left_comm] using hh
  have hh := tendsto_nhds_unique (hlA.congr' he) hlB
  simpa only [resolventVector,b,Matrix.mulVec_single_one,Matrix.col_apply,
    physicalDischargeResponse,physicalRootResponse,A,B] using hh

/-- The unknown actual leak is identified from discharge ODE histories, even
for competing real vectors with no sign or regularity assumptions. -/
theorem same_continuous_discharge_leak {n : ℕ} (t v : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (h : SameContinuousDischargeOutputs t v x y) : x.1 0=y.1 0 := by
  have hcross : C (x.1 0)*physicalRootCofactor t x*physicalCharacteristic v y =
      C (y.1 0)*physicalRootCofactor v y*physicalCharacteristic t x := by
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := Polynomial.exists_max_root (physicalCharacteristic t x) (physicalCharacteristic_monic t x).ne_zero
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := Polynomial.exists_max_root (physicalCharacteristic v y) (physicalCharacteristic_monic v y).ne_zero
    let R := max (max a b) (max ‖matrixOperator (compartmentMatrix t x)‖ ‖matrixOperator (compartmentMatrix v y)‖)
    apply Polynomial.eq_of_infinite_eval_eq
    apply (Set.Ioi_infinite R).mono
    intro q hq
    change R < q at hq
    have hqa : a < q := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_left a b) (le_max_left _ _)) hq
    have hqb : b < q := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_right a b) (le_max_left _ _)) hq
    have hnA : (physicalCharacteristic t x).eval q ≠ 0 := fun hz => (not_le_of_gt hqa) (ha q hz)
    have hnB : (physicalCharacteristic v y).eval q ≠ 0 := fun hz => (not_le_of_gt hqb) (hb q hz)
    have hqA : ‖matrixOperator (compartmentMatrix t x)‖ < q :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hq
    have hqB : ‖matrixOperator (compartmentMatrix v y)‖ < q :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hq
    have he := same_continuous_discharge_resolvent t v x y h q hqA hqB hnA hnB
    simp only [physicalDischargeResponse,physicalRootResponse_eq,← mul_div_assoc] at he
    simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,Polynomial.eval_mul,Polynomial.eval_C] using (div_eq_div_iff hnA hnB).mp he
  have hl := congrArg Polynomial.leadingCoeff hcross
  simpa only [Polynomial.leadingCoeff_mul,Polynomial.leadingCoeff_C,
    (physicalRootCofactor_monic t x).leadingCoeff,(physicalRootCofactor_monic v y).leadingCoeff,
    (physicalCharacteristic_monic t x).leadingCoeff,(physicalCharacteristic_monic v y).leadingCoeff,mul_one] using hl

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.TimeDomainDischarge

/-! Exact all-real classification from actual continuous-input discharge histories.
The root leak is recovered from those histories, not externally prescribed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def HasFullContinuousDischargeOutput {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous u → ∀ z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ,
    IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u z → z 0=0 → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s →
      x.1 0*z s 0=stieltjesLeak r w*(∑ i, w i*scalarForcedSolution (r i) u 0 0 s)

/-- Exact inverse and forward equivalence, for unrestricted real competitors. -/
theorem continuous_discharge_output_iff_response {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    HasFullContinuousDischargeOutput t x r w ↔ HasStieltjesRootResponse t x r w := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hPy,hFy⟩ := positive_tree_stieltjes_realization_exists t r w hr hpos hw hm
    have hly := full_stieltjes_leak_identified t y r w hr hpos hw hm hPy hFy
    have hsame : SameContinuousDischargeOutputs t t x y := by
      intro u hu z q hz hq hz0 hq0 s hs
      rw [h u hu z hz hz0 s hs,hly,
        physical_forced_root_formula t y hy r w hr hPy hFy u hu 0 q hq hq0 s]
    have hlx : x.1 0=stieltjesLeak r w := (same_continuous_discharge_leak t t x y hsame).trans hly
    apply (continuous_root_output_iff_response t x r w hr hpos hw hm).mp
    intro u hu z hz hz0 s hs
    have he := h u hu z hz hz0 s hs
    rw [hlx] at he
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (stieltjesLeak_pos r w hpos hw)) he
  · intro h u hu z hz hz0 s hs
    obtain ⟨hP,hF⟩ := (stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x).mp h
    rw [full_stieltjes_leak_identified t x r w hr hpos hw hm hP hF,
      (continuous_root_output_iff_response t x r w hr hpos hw hm).mpr h u hu z hz hz0 s hs]

abbrev RealContinuousDischargeFiber {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :=
  {x : TreeRates n // HasFullContinuousDischargeOutput t x r w}

def continuousDischargeFiberEquivResponse {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    RealContinuousDischargeFiber t r w ≃ RealResponseFiber t r w where
  toFun x := ⟨x.val,(continuous_discharge_output_iff_response t x.val r w hr hpos hw hm).mp x.property⟩
  invFun x := ⟨x.val,(continuous_discharge_output_iff_response t x.val r w hr hpos hw hm).mpr x.property⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- Actual finite ODE discharge-fiber cardinality, with unknown leak recovered. -/
theorem real_continuous_discharge_fiber_exact_card {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    Finite (RealContinuousDischargeFiber t r w) ∧
      Nat.card (RealContinuousDischargeFiber t r w)=n.factorial / (∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount t e.succ) := by
  obtain ⟨hf,hc⟩ := real_root_response_fiber_exact_card t r w hr hpos hw hm
  letI := hf
  let E := continuousDischargeFiberEquivResponse t r w hr hpos hw hm
  exact ⟨Finite.of_injective E E.injective,(Nat.card_congr E).trans hc⟩

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PhysicalKalman
import HydrologyTree.PhysicalForcedODE

/-! Actual finite-window trajectory observability. The conclusion compares
whole physical state trajectories from a scalar output on any open time interval. -/
open Matrix Filter
open scoped Topology
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma homogeneous_power_output_derivative {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ) (z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hz : IsForcedMatrixSolution A (Pi.single 0 1) 0 z) (k : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v => (A^k*ᵥz v) 0) ((A^(k+1)*ᵥz s) 0) s := by
  have h := (matrixOperator (A^k)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hz s)
  have he := hasDerivAt_pi.mp h (0 : Fin (n+1))
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply,matrixOperator_apply,Pi.zero_apply,zero_smul,add_zero,Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,pow_succ] using he

/-- A zero root signal on an open time interval forces every Kalman output
coordinate to vanish there, using actual derivatives rather than formal jets. -/
theorem homogeneous_zero_output_powers {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ) (z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hz : IsForcedMatrixSolution A (Pi.single 0 1) 0 z) (a b : ℝ)
    (hout : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, z s 0=0) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, (A^k*ᵥz s) 0=0 := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using hout
  | succ k ih =>
    intro s hs
    have he : (fun v : ℝ => (A^k*ᵥz v) 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 s] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hs] with v hv
      exact ih v hv
    have hd0 := (hasDerivAt_const s (0 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq he
    exact (homogeneous_power_output_derivative A z hz k s).unique hd0

/-- Nonzero actual observability determinant identifies any homogeneous state
trajectory from its root coordinate on ANY nonempty open time window. -/
theorem root_observation_detects_trajectory {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ)
    (hO : (rootObservationMatrix A).det ≠ 0) (z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hz : IsForcedMatrixSolution A (Pi.single 0 1) 0 z)
    (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hout : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, z s 0=0) : z=0 := by
  let s := (a+b)/2
  have hs : s ∈ Set.Ioo a b := by dsimp [s]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hzero : rootObservationMatrix A*ᵥz s=0 := by
    ext i
    exact homogeneous_zero_output_powers A z hz a b hout i.val s hs
  have hzs : z s=0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun v => (rootObservationMatrix A)⁻¹*ᵥv) hzero
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hO),
      Matrix.one_mulVec,Matrix.mulVec_zero] using h
  apply forcedMatrixSolution_unique A (Pi.single 0 1) 0 z 0 s hz
  · intro v
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_const v (0 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ))
  · exact hzs

/-- Equal scalar output and a common forcing on any nonempty open interval
identify the entire actual state trajectories, without assuming initial states. -/
theorem actual_trajectory_observability {n : ℕ}
    (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ)
    (hO : (rootObservationMatrix A).det ≠ 0) (u : ℝ → ℝ)
    (z q : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hz : IsForcedMatrixSolution A (Pi.single 0 1) u z)
    (hq : IsForcedMatrixSolution A (Pi.single 0 1) u q)
    (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hout : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, z s 0=q s 0) : z=q := by
  have hd : IsForcedMatrixSolution A (Pi.single 0 1) 0 (z-q) := by
    intro s
    have h := (hz s).sub (hq s)
    apply h.congr_deriv
    simp [Matrix.mulVec_sub]
  have he := root_observation_detects_trajectory A hO (z-q) hd a b hab
    (fun s hs => sub_eq_zero.mpr (hout s hs))
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp he

/-- The complete actual observability conclusion for every real full-response
model. The determinant and positivity prerequisites are proved, not assumed. -/
theorem real_full_response_trajectory_observable {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (hx : HasStieltjesRootResponse t x r w)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (z q : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hz : IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u z) (hq : IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u q)
    (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hout : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, z s 0=q s 0) : z=q :=
  actual_trajectory_observability (compartmentMatrix t x)
    (real_full_response_kalman_nonsingular t x r w hr hpos hw hm hx).2 u z q hz hq a b hab hout

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.PhysicalForcedODE

/-! Exact differential and integrated water balance for actual ODE trajectories.
All integrals are real interval integrals, not formal transfer-function symbols. -/
open Matrix MeasureTheory
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def coordinateSumLM (I : Type*) [Fintype I] : (I → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun z := ∑ i, z i
  map_add' z y := by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' c z := by simp [Finset.mul_sum]

def coordinateSumCLM (I : Type*) [Fintype I] : (I → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (coordinateSumLM I)

/-- Exact mass balance for any actual classical trajectory, even for real rates
that are not assumed positive. -/
theorem physical_total_storage_hasDerivAt {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hz : IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u z) (s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v => ∑ i, z v i) (u s-x.1 0*z s 0) s := by
  have h := (coordinateSumCLM (Fin (n+1))).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hz s)
  apply h.congr_deriv
  change (∑ i, ((compartmentMatrix t x)*ᵥz s + u s • (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)) i) = _
  simp only [Pi.add_apply,Finset.sum_add_distrib,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [compartment_total_flux]
  simp [← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

/-- Integrated physical water balance in either time orientation. -/
theorem physical_total_storage_integral_balance {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hz : IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u z) (a s : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, z s i) = (∑ i, z a i) + ∫ v in a..s, (u v-x.1 0*z v 0) := by
  have hzc : Continuous z := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun v => (hz v).continuousAt)
  have hc : Continuous (fun v => u v-x.1 0*z v 0) := by fun_prop
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (fun v _ => physical_total_storage_hasDerivAt t x u z hz v) (hc.intervalIntegrable a s)
  linarith

/-- Equal input and discharge with equal initial total storage give equal actual
storage, not just equality of a symbolic mass-balance equation. -/
theorem equal_discharge_equal_total_storage {n : ℕ} (t v : OrderedTree n) (x y : TreeRates n)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (z q : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hz : IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u z) (hq : IsPhysicalForcedSolution v y u q)
    (a : ℝ) (h0 : (∑ i, z a i)=(∑ i, q a i))
    (hQ : ∀ s, x.1 0*z s 0=y.1 0*q s 0) (s : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, z s i)=(∑ i, q s i) := by
  rw [physical_total_storage_integral_balance t x u hu z hz a s,

/-! Exact control energy identities on a finite interval. Equality means equality
on that interval only; arbitrary values outside it are not spuriously identified. -/
open Matrix MeasureTheory
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def controlEnergy (T : ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ s in 0..T, (u s)^2

lemma controlEnergy_nonneg (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (u : ℝ → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ controlEnergy T u :=
  intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall hT (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)

/-- Zero actual square integral detects a continuous input at every point of
its complete closed time interval, including both endpoints. -/
theorem controlEnergy_zero_iff (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) :
    controlEnergy T u=0 ↔ ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, u s=0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hz s hs
    by_contra hne
    have hp := intervalIntegral.integral_pos hT (hu.pow 2).continuousOn
      (fun v _ => sq_nonneg (u v)) ⟨s,hs,sq_pos_of_ne_zero hne⟩
    change 0 < controlEnergy T u at hp
    rw [hz] at hp
    exact (lt_irrefl 0) hp
  · intro hz
    change (∫ s in 0..T, (u s)^2)=0
    calc
      _ = ∫ s in 0..T, (0 : ℝ) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro s hs
        have hv := hz s (by simpa only [Set.uIcc_of_le hT.le] using hs)
        simp [hv]
      _ = 0 := by simp

/-- Exact Pythagorean expansion of control energy, without a minimization premise. -/
theorem controlEnergy_expansion (T : ℝ) (u v : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hu : Continuous u) (hv : Continuous v) :
    controlEnergy T u = controlEnergy T v +
      2*(∫ s in 0..T, v s*(u s-v s)) + controlEnergy T (fun s => u s-v s) := by
  have h0 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => (v s)^2) volume 0 T :=
    (hv.pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 T
  have h1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => 2*(v s*(u s-v s))) volume 0 T :=
    (continuous_const.mul (hv.mul (hu.sub hv))).intervalIntegrable 0 T
  have h2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => (u s-v s)^2) volume 0 T :=
    ((hu.sub hv).pow 2).intervalIntegrable 0 T
  unfold controlEnergy
  calc
    _ = ∫ s in 0..T, ((v s)^2+2*(v s*(u s-v s)))+(u s-v s)^2 := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s _
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (h0.add h1) h2,
        intervalIntegral.integral_add h0 h1,intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]

/-- Actual integral against a finite exponential signal equals its moment pairing. -/
theorem exponentialSignal_integral_pairing {n : ℕ} (r c : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (T : ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) :
    (∫ s in 0..T, exponentialSignal r c s*u s) =
      ∑ i, c i*(∫ s in 0..T, Real.exp (r i*s)*u s) := by
  have hi (i : Fin (n+1)) : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun s : ℝ => c i*(Real.exp (r i*s)*u s)) volume 0 T := by
    apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
    exact continuous_const.mul ((Real.continuous_exp.comp
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).mul hu)
  calc
    _ = ∫ s in 0..T, ∑ i, c i*(Real.exp (r i*s)*u s) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s _
      simp only [exponentialSignal,Finset.sum_mul]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun i _ => hi i)]
      simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]

end HydrologyTree
