import HydrologyTree.ControlEnergy

/-! The exact unique minimum-energy continuous solution of finite exponential
moment constraints. Both feasibility and the sharp energy/equality statements
are proved from the actual positive integral Gramian. -/
open Matrix MeasureTheory
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {n : ℕ}

def HasExponentialMoments (r d : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (T : ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, (∫ s in 0..T, Real.exp (r i*s)*u s)=d i

def minimumEnergyCoefficients (r d : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (T : ℝ) : Fin (n+1) → ℝ :=
  (exponentialGramian r T)⁻¹*ᵥd

def minimumEnergyInput (r d : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (T : ℝ) : ℝ → ℝ :=
  exponentialSignal r (minimumEnergyCoefficients r d T)

lemma minimumEnergyInput_continuous (r d : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (T : ℝ) :
    Continuous (minimumEnergyInput r d T) := continuous_exponentialSignal _ _

/-- The proposed minimum-energy input satisfies every actual integral constraint. -/
theorem minimumEnergyInput_moments (r d : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) : HasExponentialMoments r d T (minimumEnergyInput r d T) := by
  intro i
  rw [minimumEnergyInput,← exponentialGramian_mulVec,minimumEnergyCoefficients,
    Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _
      (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (exponentialGramian_posDef r hr T hT).det_pos)),
    Matrix.one_mulVec]

/-- The energy is the explicit inverse-Gramian quadratic form in the target moments. -/
theorem minimumEnergyInput_energy (r d : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    controlEnergy T (minimumEnergyInput r d T) = d ⬝ᵥ ((exponentialGramian r T)⁻¹*ᵥd) := by
  change (∫ s in 0..T, (exponentialSignal r (minimumEnergyCoefficients r d T) s)^2) = _
  rw [← exponentialGramian_quadratic]
  have hm : exponentialGramian r T*ᵥminimumEnergyCoefficients r d T=d := by
    ext i
    rw [exponentialGramian_mulVec]
    exact minimumEnergyInput_moments r d hr T hT i
  rw [hm,dotProduct_comm]
  rfl

/-- All feasible residuals are orthogonal to the constructed input in the
actual time-integral inner product. -/
theorem minimumEnergyInput_residual_orthogonal (r d : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (hm : HasExponentialMoments r d T u) :
    (∫ s in 0..T, minimumEnergyInput r d T s*(u s-minimumEnergyInput r d T s))=0 := by
  have hv := minimumEnergyInput_continuous r d T
  have hz (i : Fin (n+1)) :
      (∫ s in 0..T, Real.exp (r i*s)*(u s-minimumEnergyInput r d T s))=0 := by
    have he : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (r i*s)) := by fun_prop
    simp only [mul_sub]
    have hui : IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (r i*s)*u s) volume 0 T :=
      (he.mul hu).intervalIntegrable 0 T
    have hvi : IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (r i*s)*minimumEnergyInput r d T s) volume 0 T :=
      (he.mul hv).intervalIntegrable 0 T
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hui hvi,hm i,minimumEnergyInput_moments r d hr T hT i,sub_self]
  change (∫ s in 0..T, exponentialSignal r (minimumEnergyCoefficients r d T) s*
    (u s-minimumEnergyInput r d T s))=0
  rw [exponentialSignal_integral_pairing r _ T (fun s => u s-minimumEnergyInput r d T s) (hu.sub hv)]
  simp only [hz,mul_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero]

/-- Sharp global energy identity on the entire affine constraint set. -/
theorem minimumEnergyInput_exact_gap (r d : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hm : HasExponentialMoments r d T u) :
    controlEnergy T u = d ⬝ᵥ ((exponentialGramian r T)⁻¹*ᵥd) +
      controlEnergy T (fun s => u s-minimumEnergyInput r d T s) := by
  rw [controlEnergy_expansion T u (minimumEnergyInput r d T) hu (minimumEnergyInput_continuous r d T),
    minimumEnergyInput_residual_orthogonal r d hr T hT u hu hm,
    minimumEnergyInput_energy r d hr T hT]
  ring

/-- The bound holds for ALL continuous feasible controls, not only a sampled
or parameterized family of inputs. -/
theorem minimumEnergyInput_optimal (r d : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hm : HasExponentialMoments r d T u) :
    d ⬝ᵥ ((exponentialGramian r T)⁻¹*ᵥd) ≤ controlEnergy T u := by
  rw [minimumEnergyInput_exact_gap r d hr T hT u hu hm]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (controlEnergy_nonneg T hT.le _)

/-- Complete equality classification: agreement on the whole closed control
interval, with no false uniqueness claim concerning input values outside it. -/
theorem minimumEnergyInput_equality_iff (r d : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u)
    (hm : HasExponentialMoments r d T u) :
    controlEnergy T u = d ⬝ᵥ ((exponentialGramian r T)⁻¹*ᵥd) ↔
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, u s=minimumEnergyInput r d T s := by
  rw [minimumEnergyInput_exact_gap r d hr T hT u hu hm,add_eq_left,
    controlEnergy_zero_iff T hT (fun s => u s-minimumEnergyInput r d T s) (hu.sub (minimumEnergyInput_continuous r d T))]
  simp only [sub_eq_zero]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Exact minimum control energy for actual state transfer, not for assumed
moment constraints. Every feasible classical trajectory is proved to satisfy
those constraints. Equality is classified on the closed control interval. -/
open Matrix MeasureTheory
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma scalarForcedSolution_integral_moment (r k : ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (y0 T : ℝ) :
    scalarForcedSolution r (fun s => k*u s) 0 y0 T =
      Real.exp (-r*T)*(y0+k*(∫ s in 0..T, Real.exp (r*s)*u s)) := by
  simp only [scalarForcedSolution,sub_zero]
  have he : (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (r*s)*(k*u s)) =
      (fun s : ℝ => k*(Real.exp (r*s)*u s)) := by funext s; ring
  rw [he,intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]

/-- An actual scalar endpoint is equivalent to its exact exponential moment. -/
theorem scalarForcedSolution_terminal_iff_moment (r k : ℝ) (hk : k ≠ 0)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (y0 y1 T : ℝ) :
    scalarForcedSolution r (fun s => k*u s) 0 y0 T=y1 ↔
      (∫ s in 0..T, Real.exp (r*s)*u s)=(Real.exp (r*T)*y1-y0)/k := by
  rw [scalarForcedSolution_integral_moment]
  have hc : Real.exp (r*T)*Real.exp (-r*T)=1 := by
    simpa only [sub_zero,mul_comm] using scalarIntegratingFactor_cancel r 0 T
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 := congrArg (fun q : ℝ => Real.exp (r*T)*q) h
    rw [← mul_assoc,hc,one_mul] at h1
    apply (eq_div_iff hk).mpr
    linarith
  · intro h
    rw [h,mul_div_cancel₀ _ hk]
    calc
      _ = (Real.exp (-r*T)*Real.exp (r*T))*y1 := by ring
      _ = y1 := by rw [mul_comm (Real.exp (-r*T)),hc,one_mul]

variable {n : ℕ} {A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ}

/-- Every actual endpoint-feasible trajectory supplies the exact moment
constraints needed by the global variational theorem. -/
theorem actual_terminal_implies_moments (M : RootModalData A)
    (hk : ∀ i, M.amplitudes i ≠ 0) (T : ℝ) (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hz : IsForcedMatrixSolution A (Pi.single 0 1) u z) (h0 : z 0=z0) (hT : z T=z1) :
    HasExponentialMoments M.rates (modalSteeringTarget M T z0 z1) T u := by
  have he : z=modalForcedSolution M u 0 z0 :=
    forcedMatrixSolution_unique A (Pi.single 0 1) u z (modalForcedSolution M u 0 z0) 0
      hz (modalForcedSolution_ode M u hu 0 z0)
      (h0.trans (modalForcedSolution_initial M u 0 z0).symm)
  have hterminal : modalForcedSolution M u 0 z0 T=z1 := (congrFun he T).symm.trans hT
  have ha := congrArg (fun v : Fin (n+1) → ℝ => M.analysis*ᵥv) hterminal
  rw [modalForcedSolution,Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,M.analysis_synth,Matrix.one_mulVec] at ha
  intro i
  have hi := congrFun ha i
  exact (scalarForcedSolution_terminal_iff_moment (M.rates i) (M.amplitudes i) (hk i)
    u ((M.analysis*ᵥz0) i) ((M.analysis*ᵥz1) i) T).mp hi

lemma modalSteeringInput_eq_minimumEnergy (M : RootModalData A) (T : ℝ)
    (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    modalSteeringInput M T z0 z1=minimumEnergyInput M.rates (modalSteeringTarget M T z0 z1) T := rfl

def modalMinimumEnergy (M : RootModalData A) (T : ℝ) (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  modalSteeringTarget M T z0 z1 ⬝ᵥ ((exponentialGramian M.rates T)⁻¹*ᵥmodalSteeringTarget M T z0 z1)

/-- Exact optimum value, attained by the constructed physical steering input. -/
theorem modalSteeringInput_energy (M : RootModalData A) (hr : Function.Injective M.rates)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    controlEnergy T (modalSteeringInput M T z0 z1)=modalMinimumEnergy M T z0 z1 :=
  minimumEnergyInput_energy _ _ hr T hT

/-- The full energy gap identity holds for EVERY actual classical trajectory
with the two endpoints. The moment equations are proved from that trajectory. -/
theorem modal_steering_exact_energy_gap (M : RootModalData A) (hr : Function.Injective M.rates)
    (hk : ∀ i, M.amplitudes i ≠ 0) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hz : IsForcedMatrixSolution A (Pi.single 0 1) u z) (h0 : z 0=z0) (h1 : z T=z1) :

      controlEnergy T (fun s => u s-modalSteeringInput M T z0 z1 s) :=

theorem modal_steering_optimal_and_rigid (M : RootModalData A) (hr : Function.Injective M.rates)
    (hk : ∀ i, M.amplitudes i ≠ 0) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hz : IsForcedMatrixSolution A (Pi.single 0 1) u z) (h0 : z 0=z0) (h1 : z T=z1) :
    modalMinimumEnergy M T z0 z1 ≤ controlEnergy T u ∧
      (controlEnergy T u=modalMinimumEnergy M T z0 z1 ↔

  have hm := actual_terminal_implies_moments M hk T z0 z1 u hu z hz h0 h1
  exact ⟨minimumEnergyInput_optimal _ _ hr T hT u hu hm,
    minimumEnergyInput_equality_iff _ _ hr T hT u hu hm⟩

are minima for the same actual state equation and the same physical endpoints. -/
theorem modalMinimumEnergy_independent_of_witness (M N : RootModalData A)
    (hMr : Function.Injective M.rates) (hMk : ∀ i, M.amplitudes i ≠ 0)
    (hNr : Function.Injective N.rates) (hNk : ∀ i, N.amplitudes i ≠ 0)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (z0 z1 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    modalMinimumEnergy M T z0 z1=modalMinimumEnergy N T z0 z1 := by
  have hMN : modalMinimumEnergy M T z0 z1 ≤ modalMinimumEnergy N T z0 z1 := by
    have h := (modal_steering_optimal_and_rigid M hMr hMk T hT z0 z1
      (modalSteeringInput N T z0 z1) (continuous_exponentialSignal _ _)
      (modalForcedSolution N (modalSteeringInput N T z0 z1) 0 z0)
      (modalForcedSolution_ode N _ (continuous_exponentialSignal _ _) 0 z0)
      (modalForcedSolution_initial N _ 0 z0) (modalSteering_terminal N hNr hNk T hT z0 z1)).1
    rwa [modalSteeringInput_energy N hNr T hT z0 z1] at h
  have hNM : modalMinimumEnergy N T z0 z1 ≤ modalMinimumEnergy M T z0 z1 := by
    have h := (modal_steering_optimal_and_rigid N hNr hNk T hT z0 z1
      (modalSteeringInput M T z0 z1) (continuous_exponentialSignal _ _)
      (modalForcedSolution M (modalSteeringInput M T z0 z1) 0 z0)
      (modalForcedSolution_ode M _ (continuous_exponentialSignal _ _) 0 z0)
      (modalForcedSolution_initial M _ 0 z0) (modalSteering_terminal M hMr hMk T hT z0 z1)).1
    rwa [modalSteeringInput_energy M hMr T hT z0 z1] at h

response; neither modal decomposition nor nonzero amplitudes is assumed. -/
theorem real_full_response_simple_modal_data {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (hx : HasStieltjesRootResponse t x r w) :

      ∀ i, M.amplitudes i ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hP,hF⟩ := (stieltjes_root_response_iff_polynomials t r w hr hpos hw hm x).mp hx
  have hp := real_stieltjes_realization_is_positive t x r w hr hpos hw hm hP hF
  obtain ⟨M,_,hMP,hMF⟩ := physical_root_modal_representation t x (hp.1 0) (fun e => hp.1 e.succ) hp.2

its unique global classical state trajectory, and the exact energy gap for
EVERY continuous competing control with the same physical endpoints. -/
theorem real_full_response_minimum_energy_control {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)

        IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u0 z ∧ z 0=z0 ∧ z T=z1) ∧
      ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous u → ∀ z : ℝ → Fin (n+1) → ℝ,
        IsPhysicalForcedSolution t x u z → z 0=z0 → z T=z1 →
        controlEnergy T u=controlEnergy T u0+controlEnergy T (fun s => u s-u0 s) ∧
        controlEnergy T u0 ≤ controlEnergy T u ∧

  obtain ⟨M,hMr,hMk⟩ := real_full_response_simple_modal_data t x r w hr hpos hw hm hx

  refine ⟨u0,hu0,?_,?_⟩
  · refine ⟨modalForcedSolution M u0 0 z0,?_,?_⟩
    · exact ⟨modalForcedSolution_ode M u0 hu0 0 z0,modalForcedSolution_initial M u0 0 z0,
        modalSteering_terminal M hMr hMk T hT z0 z1⟩
    · intro z hz

        (hz.2.1.trans (modalForcedSolution_initial M u0 0 z0).symm)
  · intro u hu z hz h0 h1

      modalSteeringInput_energy M hMr T hT z0 z1
    rw [hval]
    exact ⟨modal_steering_exact_energy_gap M hMr hMk T hT z0 z1 u hu z hz h0 h1,
      modal_steering_optimal_and_rigid M hMr hMk T hT z0 z1 u hu z hz h0 h1⟩

import HydrologyTree.GraphODETransport
import HydrologyTree.GraphResponseClassification
import HydrologyTree.FullRootLeakTheory
import HydrologyTree.PhysicalMinimumEnergy

/-! Actual continuous-time graph output classification, reachability,
observability and optimal control. A presentation only mediates proved
bijections; the statements use the independent graph's rates and state ODE. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]

def HasGraphContinuousDischargeOutput {n : ℕ} (o : V) (y : GraphRates G) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous u → ∀ z : ℝ → V → ℝ,
    IsGraphForcedSolution o y u z → z 0=0 → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s →
      y.1*z s o=stieltjesLeak r w*(∑ i, w i*scalarForcedSolution (r i) u 0 0 s)

lemma graph_continuous_discharge_transport {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (x : TreeRates n) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :
    HasGraphContinuousDischargeOutput o (graphRateEquiv p x) r w ↔
      HasFullContinuousDischargeOutput p.tree x r w := by
  constructor
  · intro h u hu q hq hq0 s hs
    have hODE : IsGraphForcedSolution o (graphRateEquiv p x) u ((graphTrajectoryEquiv p).symm q) := by
      apply (graph_forced_solution_transport p x u _).mpr
      simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hq
    have h0 : (graphTrajectoryEquiv p).symm q 0=0 := by
      apply (graph_trajectory_zero_iff p _ 0).mp
      simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hq0
    have hh := h u hu _ hODE h0 s hs
    simpa only [graphRateEquiv_leak,graphTrajectoryEquiv_symm_root] using hh
  · intro h u hu z hz hz0 s hs
    have hh := h u hu (graphTrajectoryEquiv p z) ((graph_forced_solution_transport p x u z).mp hz)
      ((graph_trajectory_zero_iff p z 0).mpr hz0) s hs
    simpa only [graphRateEquiv_leak,graphTrajectoryEquiv_root] using hh

/-- Output histories determine the full graph response and hence all previously
proved fiber statements, without additional state or coefficient observations. -/
theorem graph_continuous_discharge_iff_response {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (y : GraphRates G) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    HasGraphContinuousDischargeOutput o y r w ↔ HasGraphStieltjesResponse o y r w := by
  obtain ⟨x,rfl⟩ := (graphRateEquiv p).surjective y
  rw [graph_continuous_discharge_transport,continuous_discharge_output_iff_response p.tree x r w hr hpos hw hm,
    graph_response_transport]

abbrev GraphContinuousDischargeFiber {n : ℕ} (o : V) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) :=
  {y : GraphRates G // HasGraphContinuousDischargeOutput o y r w}

def graphContinuousFiberEquivResponse {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    GraphContinuousDischargeFiber (G := G) o r w ≃ GraphResponseFiber (G := G) o r w where
  toFun y := ⟨y.val,(graph_continuous_discharge_iff_response p y.val r w hr hpos hw hm).mp y.property⟩
  invFun y := ⟨y.val,(graph_continuous_discharge_iff_response p y.val r w hr hpos hw hm).mpr y.property⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

theorem graph_continuous_fiber_exact_card {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    Finite (GraphContinuousDischargeFiber (G := G) o r w) ∧
      Nat.card (GraphContinuousDischargeFiber (G := G) o r w)=n.factorial/(∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount p.tree e.succ) := by
  obtain ⟨hf,hc⟩ := graph_response_fiber_exact_card p r w hr hpos hw hm
  letI := hf
  let E := graphContinuousFiberEquivResponse p r w hr hpos hw hm
  exact ⟨Finite.of_injective E E.injective,(Nat.card_congr E).trans hc⟩

/-- Signed finite-horizon controllability of the actual independent graph system. -/
theorem graph_full_response_controllable {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (y : GraphRates G) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1)
    (hy : HasGraphStieltjesResponse o y r w) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (z0 z1 : V → ℝ) :
    ∃ u : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous u ∧
      ∃! z : ℝ → V → ℝ, IsGraphForcedSolution o y u z ∧ z 0=z0 ∧ z T=z1 := by
  obtain ⟨x,rfl⟩ := (graphRateEquiv p).surjective y
  have hx := (graph_response_transport p x r w).mp hy
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hsol⟩ := real_full_response_controllable p.tree x r w hr hpos hw hm hx T hT
    (graphStateEquiv p z0) (graphStateEquiv p z1)
  exact ⟨u,hu,(graph_two_endpoint_existsUnique_iff p x u T z0 z1).mpr hsol⟩

/-- The sharp energy identity and equality case apply to every actual graph
trajectory meeting the endpoints; no modal constraints are imposed on the user. -/
theorem graph_full_response_minimum_energy {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (y : GraphRates G) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1)
    (hy : HasGraphStieltjesResponse o y r w) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (z0 z1 : V → ℝ) :
    ∃ u0 : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous u0 ∧
      (∃! z : ℝ → V → ℝ, IsGraphForcedSolution o y u0 z ∧ z 0=z0 ∧ z T=z1) ∧
      ∀ u : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous u → ∀ z : ℝ → V → ℝ,
        IsGraphForcedSolution o y u z → z 0=z0 → z T=z1 →
        controlEnergy T u=controlEnergy T u0+controlEnergy T (fun s => u s-u0 s) ∧
        controlEnergy T u0 ≤ controlEnergy T u ∧
        (controlEnergy T u=controlEnergy T u0 ↔ ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, u s=u0 s) := by
  obtain ⟨x,rfl⟩ := (graphRateEquiv p).surjective y
  have hx := (graph_response_transport p x r w).mp hy
  obtain ⟨u0,hu0,hsol,hmin⟩ := real_full_response_minimum_energy_control p.tree x r w hr hpos hw hm hx
    T hT (graphStateEquiv p z0) (graphStateEquiv p z1)
  refine ⟨u0,hu0,(graph_two_endpoint_existsUnique_iff p x u0 T z0 z1).mpr hsol,?_⟩
  intro u hu z hz h0 h1
  exact hmin u hu (graphTrajectoryEquiv p z) ((graph_forced_solution_transport p x u z).mp hz)
    ((graph_trajectory_endpoint_iff p z 0 z0).mpr h0) ((graph_trajectory_endpoint_iff p z T z1).mpr h1)

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.GraphMatrixTransport

/-! Actual graph characteristic/cofactor coefficients and their Frechet
Jacobian. The output coordinate permutation is explicit; no determinant
identity is imposed as a definition or hypothesis. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]

def graphCoefficientMap (n : ℕ) (o : V) (y : GraphRates G) : PathCoefficients n :=
  (cut (n+1) (graphCharacteristic o y),cut n (graphRootCofactor o y))

lemma graphCoefficientMap_transport {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (x : TreeRates n) : graphCoefficientMap n o (graphRateEquiv p x)=physicalCoefficientMap p.tree x := by
  simp only [graphCoefficientMap,graphCharacteristic_transport,graphRootCofactor_transport,
    physicalCoefficientMap]

lemma graphCoefficientMap_eq_comp {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o) :
    graphCoefficientMap n o = fun y => physicalCoefficientMap p.tree ((graphRateEquiv p).symm y) := by
  funext y
  obtain ⟨x,rfl⟩ := (graphRateEquiv p).surjective y
  rw [graphCoefficientMap_transport,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

theorem differentiable_graphCoefficientMap {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o) :
    Differentiable ℝ (graphCoefficientMap n o) := by
  rw [graphCoefficientMap_eq_comp p]
  intro y
  exact (differentiable_physicalCoefficientMap p.tree ((graphRateEquiv p).symm y)).comp y
    (graphRateEquiv p).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt

/-- Ascending actual polynomial coefficients, relabelled by the same proved
coordinate permutation as the actual graph rate vector. -/
def normalizedGraphCoefficients {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (y : GraphRates G) : GraphRates G :=
  graphRateEquiv p (coefficientArrayEquiv n (graphCoefficientMap n o y))

lemma normalizedGraphCoefficients_conjugate {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o) :
    normalizedGraphCoefficients p = fun y =>
      graphRateEquiv p (normalizedPhysicalTree p.tree ((graphRateEquiv p).symm y)) := by
  funext y
  simp only [normalizedGraphCoefficients,graphCoefficientMap_eq_comp p,normalizedPhysicalTree]

/-- Determinant of the actual Frechet derivative after explicit coordinate permutation. -/
def graphCanonicalJacobian {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o) (y : GraphRates G) : ℝ :=
  endJacobian (normalizedGraphCoefficients p) y

theorem graphCanonicalJacobian_transport {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (y : GraphRates G) :
    graphCanonicalJacobian p y=treeCanonicalJacobian p.tree ((graphRateEquiv p).symm y) := by
  have hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (normalizedPhysicalTree p.tree) ((graphRateEquiv p).symm y) :=
    (coefficientArrayEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp _
      (differentiable_physicalCoefficientMap p.tree _)
  rw [graphCanonicalJacobian,normalizedGraphCoefficients_conjugate,
    endJacobian_conjugate (graphRateEquiv p).toContinuousLinearEquiv _ _ hf]
  exact normalizedPhysicalTree_jacobian p.tree _ (differentiable_physicalCoefficientMap p.tree _)

/-- All real graph rates, including zero and negative rates, satisfy the exact
factorization after the proved rate/vertex transport, with one fixed sign. -/
theorem graph_full_coefficient_jacobian {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, (ε=1 ∨ ε= -1) ∧ ∀ y : GraphRates G,
      graphCanonicalJacobian p y=ε * originalTreeRateMonomial p.tree ((graphRateEquiv p).symm y) *
        originalTreeSiblingProduct p.tree ((graphRateEquiv p).symm y) := by
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hformula⟩ := full_tree_standard_jacobian p.tree
  exact ⟨ε,hε,fun y => (graphCanonicalJacobian_transport p y).trans (hformula _)⟩

/-- The independent graph hypotheses themselves supply the presentation needed
by the exact actual-coefficient Jacobian theorem. -/
theorem finite_graph_coefficient_jacobian {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hG : G.IsTree) (o : V) (hN : Fintype.card V=n+1) :
    ∃ p : RootedTreePresentation n G o,
      Differentiable ℝ (graphCoefficientMap (G := G) n o) ∧
      ∃ ε : ℝ, (ε=1 ∨ ε= -1) ∧ ∀ y : GraphRates G,
        graphCanonicalJacobian p y=ε * originalTreeRateMonomial p.tree ((graphRateEquiv p).symm y) *
          originalTreeSiblingProduct p.tree ((graphRateEquiv p).symm y) := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := finite_rooted_tree_presentation n G o hG hN
  exact ⟨p,differentiable_graphCoefficientMap p,graph_full_coefficient_jacobian p⟩

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.GraphODETransport
import HydrologyTree.PhysicalMassODE

/-! Actual mass balance on any finite simple graph, independently of a tree
presentation. Real rates may be signed; positivity is not needed for conservation. -/
open Matrix MeasureTheory
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]

lemma graph_single_column_sum (i j w : V) (r : ℝ) :
    (∑ v : V, (Matrix.single i j r) v w) = if j=w then r else 0 := by
  by_cases h : j=w
  · subst w
    simp [Matrix.single_apply]
  · simp [Matrix.single_apply,h]

lemma graphTransfer_column_sum (y : GraphRates G) (d : G.Dart) (w : V) :
    (∑ v : V, graphTransfer y d v w)=0 := by
  simp only [graphTransfer,Matrix.smul_apply,Matrix.sub_apply,smul_eq_mul,mul_sub,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,graph_single_column_sum,sub_self]

/-- All internal transfers cancel exactly, with only the specified physical leak. -/
theorem graphCompartment_column_sum (o : V) (y : GraphRates G) (w : V) :
    (∑ v : V, graphCompartmentMatrix G o y v w)=if w=o then -y.1 else 0 := by
  simp only [graphCompartmentMatrix,Matrix.sub_apply,Matrix.sum_apply,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [graphTransfer_column_sum,Finset.sum_const_zero,zero_sub,
    Matrix.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,← Finset.mul_sum,graph_single_column_sum]
  by_cases h : w=o
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h,Ne.symm h]

theorem graph_total_flux (o : V) (y : GraphRates G) (s : V → ℝ) :
    (∑ v, (graphCompartmentMatrix G o y *ᵥ s) v) = -y.1*s o := by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul,graphCompartment_column_sum]
  simp

/-- Differential storage balance follows from the independently defined graph ODE. -/
theorem graph_storage_hasDerivAt (o : V) (y : GraphRates G) (u : ℝ → ℝ)
    (z : ℝ → V → ℝ) (hz : IsGraphForcedSolution o y u z) (s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => ∑ v, z t v) (u s-y.1*z s o) s := by
  have h := (coordinateSumCLM V).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hz s)
  apply h.congr_deriv
  change (∑ v, (graphCompartmentMatrix G o y *ᵥ z s+u s • (Pi.single o 1 : V → ℝ)) v)=_
  simp only [Pi.add_apply,Finset.sum_add_distrib,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [graph_total_flux]
  simp [← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

/-- Exact integral storage balance, with either orientation of the time interval. -/
theorem graph_storage_integral_balance (o : V) (y : GraphRates G) (u : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hu : Continuous u) (z : ℝ → V → ℝ) (hz : IsGraphForcedSolution o y u z) (a t : ℝ) :
    (∑ v, z t v) = (∑ v, z a v)+∫ s in a..t, (u s-y.1*z s o) := by
  have hzc : Continuous z := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun s => (hz s).continuousAt)
  have hc : Continuous (fun s => u s-y.1*z s o) := by fun_prop
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (fun s _ => graph_storage_hasDerivAt o y u z hz s) (hc.intervalIntegrable a t)
  linarith

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.GraphDynamicalClassification
import HydrologyTree.GraphCoefficientJacobian
import HydrologyTree.GraphMassBalance

/-! Presentation-free hypotheses for the original graph's actual full-response
fibers, continuous ODE histories and finite-time system properties. -/
open Matrix Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]

/-- The actual graph coefficient derivative is nonsingular at every full target
realization; sign or regularity restrictions on competitors are not assumptions. -/
theorem graph_full_response_regular {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) (y : GraphResponseFiber (G := G) o r w) :
    graphCanonicalJacobian p y.val ≠ 0 := by
  rw [graphCanonicalJacobian_transport]
  exact (real_full_response_forces_positive_regular p.tree
    ((graphResponseFiberEquiv p r w) y).val r w hr hpos hw hm
      ((graphResponseFiberEquiv p r w) y).property).2

/-- Equality of root output on any nonempty open interval determines the entire
actual graph state trajectory under the same forcing and model. -/
theorem graph_full_response_observable {n : ℕ} {o : V} (p : RootedTreePresentation n G o)
    (y : GraphRates G) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i) (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1)
    (hy : HasGraphStieltjesResponse o y r w)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (z q : ℝ → V → ℝ)
    (hz : IsGraphForcedSolution o y u z) (hq : IsGraphForcedSolution o y u q)
    (a b : ℝ) (hab : a<b) (hout : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, z s o=q s o) : z=q := by
  obtain ⟨x,rfl⟩ := (graphRateEquiv p).surjective y
  apply (graphTrajectoryEquiv p).injective
  apply real_full_response_trajectory_observable p.tree x r w hr hpos hw hm
    ((graph_response_transport p x r w).mp hy) u
    (graphTrajectoryEquiv p z) (graphTrajectoryEquiv p q)
    ((graph_forced_solution_transport p x u z).mp hz)
    ((graph_forced_solution_transport p x u q).mp hq) a b hab
  simpa only [graphTrajectoryEquiv_root] using hout

/-- Full actual graph trajectory-fiber classification. The presentation is
constructed from G.IsTree and the cardinality, not required as extra data. -/
theorem finite_graph_continuous_fiber_classification {n : ℕ}
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsTree) (o : V)
    (hN : Fintype.card V=n+1) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1) :
    ∃ p : RootedTreePresentation n G o,
      Nonempty (GraphContinuousDischargeFiber (G := G) o r w ≃ RecursivePoleAllocations p.tree) ∧
      Finite (GraphContinuousDischargeFiber (G := G) o r w) ∧
      Nat.card (GraphContinuousDischargeFiber (G := G) o r w)=
        n.factorial/(∏ e : Fin n, subtreeVertexCount p.tree e.succ) ∧
      ∀ y : GraphContinuousDischargeFiber (G := G) o r w,
        PositiveGraphRates y.val ∧ graphCanonicalJacobian p y.val ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := finite_rooted_tree_presentation n G o hG hN
  obtain ⟨hf,hc⟩ := graph_continuous_fiber_exact_card p r w hr hpos hw hm
  refine ⟨p,⟨(graphContinuousFiberEquivResponse p r w hr hpos hw hm).trans
    (graphResponseRecursiveEquiv p r w hr hpos hw hm)⟩,hf,hc,?_⟩
  intro y
  let v := graphContinuousFiberEquivResponse p r w hr hpos hw hm y
  exact ⟨graph_full_response_positive p r w hr hpos hw hm v,
    graph_full_response_regular p r w hr hpos hw hm v⟩

/-- A presentation built from the graph yields actual well-posedness, arbitrary
positive-horizon signed steering and full finite-window trajectory observability. -/
theorem finite_graph_full_dynamical_properties {n : ℕ}
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsTree) (o : V)
    (hN : Fintype.card V=n+1) (r w : Fin (n+1) → ℝ)
    (hr : Function.Injective r) (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (hm : (∑ i, w i)=1)
    (y : GraphContinuousDischargeFiber (G := G) o r w) :
    PositiveGraphRates y.val ∧
    (∀ u : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous u → ∀ (a : ℝ) (z0 : V → ℝ),
      ∃! z : ℝ → V → ℝ, IsGraphForcedSolution o y.val u z ∧ z a=z0) ∧
    (∀ T : ℝ, 0<T → ∀ z0 z1 : V → ℝ,
      ∃ u : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous u ∧
      ∃! z : ℝ → V → ℝ, IsGraphForcedSolution o y.val u z ∧ z 0=z0 ∧ z T=z1) ∧
    (∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ) (z q : ℝ → V → ℝ), IsGraphForcedSolution o y.val u z →
      IsGraphForcedSolution o y.val u q → ∀ a b : ℝ, a<b →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, z s o=q s o) → z=q) := by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := finite_rooted_tree_presentation n G o hG hN
  have hy := (graph_continuous_discharge_iff_response p y.val r w hr hpos hw hm).mp y.property
  have hp := graph_full_response_positive p r w hr hpos hw hm ⟨y.val,hy⟩
  refine ⟨hp,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · exact fun u hu a z0 => graph_forced_ODE_existsUnique p y.val hp u hu a z0
  · exact fun T hT z0 z1 => graph_full_response_controllable p y.val r w hr hpos hw hm hy T hT z0 z1
  · exact fun u z q hz hq a b hab ho => graph_full_response_observable p y.val r w hr hpos hw hm hy u z q hz hq a b hab ho

end HydrologyTree
